:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: {.col-md-9 .col-md-push-3 role="main" property="mainContentOfPage"}

## [PART I]{.HLabel1}[General Provisions]{.HTitleText1} {#h-987437 .Part}

### [Short Title]{.HTitleText2} {#h-987438 .Subheading}

**[[100.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-100.01 .sectionLabel}** These Regulations
may be cited as the [Canadian Aviation
Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-96-433).

### [Subpart 1 --- Interpretation]{.HTitleText2} {#h-987440 .Subheading}

#### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-987441 .Subheading}

- **[[101.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-101.01
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In these Regulations,

  [[ACAS]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[ACAS]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[Airborne Collision Avoidance
      System]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an aircraft system based on
      transponder signals that operates independently of ground-based
      equipment and is intended to provide aural and visual alerts to a
      flight crew on the risk of collision with an approaching aircraft
      equipped with a transponder; ([ACAS]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"}
      ou [système anticollision embarqué]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Act]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Act]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the [Aeronautics
      Act](/eng/acts/A-2); ([Loi]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[advanced ultra-light aeroplane]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[advanced ultra-light aeroplane]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
      aeroplane that has a type design that is in compliance with the
      standards specified in the manual entitled Design Standards for
      Advanced Ultra-light Aeroplanes; ([avion ultra-léger de type
      évolué]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[aerial work]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[aerial work]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a commercial air service
      other than an air transport service or a flight training
      service; ([travail aérien]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[aerial work zone]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[aerial work zone]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an area, delineated
      in an aerial work zone plan, in which aerial work is being
      conducted and that is over a built-up area of a city or town or
      over or adjacent to an area where persons may assemble; ([zone de
      travail aérien]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[aerial work zone plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[aerial work zone plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a risk
      management plan for proposed aerial work; ([plan de zone de
      travail aérien]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[aerobatic manoeuvre]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[aerobatic manoeuvre]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a manoeuvre
      where a change in the attitude of an aircraft results in a bank
      angle greater than 60 degrees, an abnormal attitude or an abnormal
      acceleration not incidental to normal flying; ([acrobatie
      aérienne]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[aerodrome traffic]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[aerodrome traffic]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means all traffic on the
      movement area of an aerodrome and all aircraft operating at or in
      the vicinity of the aerodrome; ([circulation
      d'aérodrome]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[aeroplane]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[aeroplane]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a power-driven
      heavier-than-air aircraft that derives its lift in flight from
      aerodynamic reactions on surfaces that remain fixed during
      flight; ([avion]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[AGL]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[AGL]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means above ground
      level; ([AGL]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[air operator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[air operator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the holder of an air
      operator certificate; ([exploitant aérien]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[air operator certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[air operator certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      certificate issued under Part VII that authorizes the holder of
      the certificate to operate a commercial air service; ([certificat
      d'exploitation aérienne]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[air route]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[air route]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the airspace identified as
      such within the boundaries or along the tracks specified

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of controlled airspace, in the
        Designated Airspace Handbook, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of uncontrolled airspace, on an
        aeronautical chart; ([route aérienne]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[air show]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[air show]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an aerial display or
      demonstration before an invited assembly of persons by one or more
      aircraft; ([spectacle aérien]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[air time]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[air time]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, with respect to keeping
      technical records, the time from the moment an aircraft leaves the
      surface until it comes into contact with the surface at the next
      point of landing; ([temps dans les airs]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[air traffic advisory services]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[air traffic advisory services]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the
      provision by an ATS unit of aviation safety information, including
      aviation weather information and serviceability reports in respect
      of aerodromes and radio navigation aids, but does not include the
      provision of IFR air traffic control messages; ([services
      consultatifs de la circulation aérienne]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[air traffic control clearance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[air traffic control clearance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
      authorization issued by an air traffic control unit that
      authorizes an aircraft to proceed within controlled airspace in
      accordance with the conditions specified by that
      unit; ([autorisation du contrôle de la circulation
      aérienne]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[air traffic control instruction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[air traffic control instruction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      directive issued by an air traffic control unit for air traffic
      control purposes; ([instructions du contrôle de la circulation
      aérienne]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[air transport service]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[air transport service]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a commercial
      air service that is operated for the purpose of transporting
      persons, personal belongings, baggage, goods or cargo in an
      aircraft between two points; ([service de transport
      aérien]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[aircraft flight manual]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[aircraft flight manual]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a manual,
      requirements for which may be established by the Minister in Part
      V, that contains information in respect of an aircraft; ([manuel
      de vol de l'aéronef]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[airport]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[airport]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an aerodrome in respect of
      which an airport certificate issued under Subpart 2 of Part III is
      in force; ([aéroport]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[airship]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[airship]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a power-driven,
      lighter-than-air aircraft; ([dirigeable]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[airway]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[airway]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the controlled airspace
      identified as such within the boundaries or along the tracks
      specified in the Designated Airspace Handbook; ([voie
      aérienne]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[airworthiness directive]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[airworthiness directive]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
      instruction issued by the Minister or by a civil aviation
      authority responsible for an aeronautical product type design that
      mandates a maintenance or operation action to ensure that an
      aeronautical product conforms to its type design and is in a
      condition for safe operation; ([consigne de
      navigabilité]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[airworthiness limitation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[airworthiness limitation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      limitation applicable to an aeronautical product, in the form of a
      life limit or a maintenance task that is mandatory as a condition
      of the type certificate; ([limite de
      navigabilité]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[airworthy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[airworthy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of an aeronautical
      product, means in a fit and safe state for flight and in
      conformity with its type design; ([en état de
      navigabilité]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[alert height]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[alert height]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the height above a
      runway, based on the flight characteristics of an aircraft and its
      fail-operational automatic landing system, above which a CAT III
      precision approach is to be discontinued and a missed approach
      procedure initiated in the event of a failure of the ground
      equipment or one of the redundant parts of the aircraft automatic
      landing system; ([hauteur d'alerte]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[all-engines-operating take-off distance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[all-engines-operating take-off
      distance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the distance from the start
      of the take-off roll to the point at which the aeroplane reaches
      the height above the runway elevation specified in the
      certification basis of the aeroplane; ([distance de décollage avec
      tous les moteurs opérants]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[all-engines-operating take-off run]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[all-engines-operating take-off run]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
      the distance from the start of the take-off roll to the point
      midway between the lift-off point and the point at which the
      aeroplane reaches the height above the runway elevation specified
      in the certification basis of the aeroplane; ([roulement au
      décollage avec tous les moteurs opérants]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[alternate aerodrome]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[alternate aerodrome]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an aerodrome to
      which a flight may proceed when landing at the intended aerodrome
      of destination becomes inadvisable; ([aérodrome de
      dégagement]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[altimeter setting region]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[altimeter setting region]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the low
      level airspace so specified, and delineated, in the Designated
      Airspace Handbook; ([région de calage
      altimétrique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[appliance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[appliance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any instrument, mechanism,
      equipment, apparatus or accessory that is

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} used, or intended to be used, in operating or
        controlling an aircraft in flight,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} installed in or attached to, or intended to be
        installed in or attached to, the aircraft, and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} not part of the airframe, engine or propeller
        of that aircraft; ([appareillage]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[appropriate frequency]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[appropriate frequency]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the radio frequency specified by an ATS unit
        for use by the pilot-in-command of an aircraft,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the mandatory frequency for use at or in the
        vicinity of an aerodrome for which a mandatory frequency has
        been specified, or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in any case not described in paragraph (a) or
        (b), the frequency specified for an aerodrome or an airspace in
        the Canada Air Pilot or the Canada Flight
        Supplement; ([fréquence appropriée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[apron]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[apron]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a part of an aerodrome, other
      than the manoeuvring area, that is intended to be used for the
      loading and unloading of passengers and cargo, the refuelling,
      servicing, maintenance and parking of aircraft and the movement of
      aircraft, vehicles and persons engaged in services necessary for
      those purposes; ([aire de trafic]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[APU]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[APU]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[auxiliary power
      unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any power unit that delivers
      rotating shaft power or compressed air, or both, and that is not
      intended for direct propulsion of an
      aircraft; ([APU]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou [groupe auxiliaire
      de bord]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[APV]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[APV]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means approach procedure with vertical
      guidance; ([APV]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Arctic Control Area]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Arctic Control Area]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
      SOR/2006-77, s. 1\]]{.Repealed}

  [[ASDA]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[ASDA]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[accelerate-stop distance
      available]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a runway, the
      length of the take-off run available plus, if a stopway is
      provided, the length of the stopway declared available by the
      operator of the aerodrome; ([ASDA]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou
      [distance accélération-arrêt utilisable]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[ASL]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[ASL]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means above sea
      level; ([ASL]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[ATC unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[ATC unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[air traffic control
      unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an ATS unit that provides air
      traffic control services; ([unité ATC]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"}
      ou [unité de contrôle de la circulation aérienne]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[ATS]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[ATS]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[air traffic
      services]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means air traffic control services,
      air traffic advisory services and flight information
      services; ([ATS]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou [services de la
      circulation aérienne]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[ATS operations certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[ATS operations certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      certificate issued under Part VIII that authorizes its holder to
      operate an air traffic control unit or a flight services
      unit; ([certificat d'exploitation des ATS]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[ATS unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[ATS unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[air traffic services
      unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an operational facility that
      provides air traffic services related to the movement of aircraft
      on the manoeuvring area of an aerodrome or to the operation of
      aircraft within airspace and for which an ATS site manual has been
      approved by the Minister under Subpart 1 of Part VIII; ([unité
      ATS]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou [unité des services de la
      circulation aérienne]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[AWOS]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[AWOS]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[automated weather observation
      system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a set of meteorological
      sensors, and associated systems designed to electronically collect
      and disseminate meteorological data; ([AWOS]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"} ou [système automatisé d'observations
      météorologiques]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[AX class]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[AX class]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a classification of
      balloons by size, as established by the Fédération Aéronautique
      Internationale (FAI); ([classe AX]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[balloon]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[balloon]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a non-power-driven
      lighter-than-air aircraft; ([ballon]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[balloon operator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[balloon operator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the holder of a
      special flight operations certificate --- balloons issued under
      section 603.18; ([exploitant de ballons]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[basic ultra-light aeroplane]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[basic ultra-light aeroplane]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
      aeroplane having no more than two seats, designed and manufactured
      to have

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a maximum take-off weight not exceeding 544 kg,
        and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a stall speed in the landing configuration
        (V~so~) of 39 knots (45 mph) indicated airspeed, or less, at the
        maximum take-off weight; ([avion ultra-léger de
        base]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Canada Air Pilot]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Canada Air Pilot]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an aeronautical
      information publication published by NAV CANADA that contains
      information on instrument procedures; ([Canada Air
      Pilot]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Canada Flight Supplement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Canada Flight Supplement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
      aeronautical information publication published under the authority
      of the Minister of Transport and the Minister of National Defence
      that is intended to be used to supplement enroute charts and the
      Canada Air Pilot; ([Supplément de vol-Canada]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[Canadian]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Canadian]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} with respect to the operation of a commercial
        air service for which a licence to operate a domestic service is
        required under the [Canada Transportation
        Act](/eng/acts/C-10.4), has the same meaning as in subsection
        55(1) of the [Canada Transportation Act](/eng/acts/C-10.4), and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} with respect to the operation of any other
        commercial air service, means

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian citizen or a [[permanent
          resident]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in subsection 2(1)
          of the [Immigration and Refugee Protection
          Act](/eng/acts/I-2.5),

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a government in Canada or an agent or
          mandatary of such a government, or

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a corporation or entity that is
          incorporated or formed under the laws of Canada or a province,
          that is controlled in fact by Canadians and of which at least
          75% of the voting interests are owned and controlled by
          Canadians; ([Canadien]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Canadian Domestic Airspace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Canadian Domestic Airspace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the
      airspace specified, and delineated as such, in the Designated
      Airspace Handbook; ([espace aérien intérieur
      canadien]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Canadian Technical Standard Order (CAN-TSO) design approval]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Canadian Technical Standard Order (CAN-TSO) design
      approval]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a document issued by the
      Minister to record the approval of the type design of an appliance
      or a part identified in the document by a model number, by a part
      number or by some other identification unique to the appliance or
      part, and includes a type approval for an aircraft appliance
      issued before October 10, 1996 under section 214 of the Air
      Regulations and a type certificate for an aircraft appliance
      issued before December 1, 2009 under section 511.11 or
      511.21; ([approbation de la conception selon les spécifications
      techniques canadiennes (CAN-TSO)]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[CAN-TSO]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[CAN-TSO]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[Canadian Technical Standard
      Order]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a standard of airworthiness for
      an appliance or a part

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that is published by the Minister, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that is published by a foreign state with which
        Canada has an airworthiness agreement or similar arrangement and
        that is adopted by the Minister and specified in Chapter 537 ---
        Appliances and Parts of the Airworthiness
        Manual; ([CAN-TSO]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou
        [spécifications techniques canadiennes]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[CAT II minima]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[CAT II minima]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of an aerodrome,
      means the minima specified in the Canada Air Pilot for a CAT II
      precision approach to a runway at that aerodrome; ([minimums CAT
      II]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[CAT III minima]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[CAT III minima]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of an
      aerodrome, means the minima specified in the Canada Air Pilot for
      a CAT III precision approach to a runway at that
      aerodrome; ([minimums CAT III]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[category]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[category]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} when used in reference to flight crew
        licensing, the classification of aircraft as an aeroplane, a
        balloon, a glider, a gyroplane, a helicopter or an ultra-light
        aeroplane, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} when used in reference to the certification of
        aircraft, a grouping of aircraft based upon intended use or
        operating limitations such as normal, utility, aerobatic,
        commuter and transport; ([catégorie]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[child restraint system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[child restraint system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any device,
      other than a safety belt, that is designed to restrain, seat or
      position a person and that conforms to the applicable standards of
      airworthiness set out in Chapter 551 --- Aircraft Equipment and
      Installation of the Airworthiness Manual; ([ensemble de retenue
      d'enfant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[class]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[class]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in relation to the classification
      of aeroplanes, means aeroplanes having similar operating
      characteristics to single-engined aeroplanes, multi-engined
      aeroplanes, centre-line thrust aeroplanes, land aeroplanes or sea
      aeroplanes; ([classe]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[co-authority dispatch]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[co-authority dispatch]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the shared
      responsibility of the pilot-in-command and the flight dispatcher
      for all decisions respecting the operational flight plan prior to
      its acceptance by the pilot-in-command, and for the flight
      watch; ([régulation des vols en coresponsabilité]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[command and control link]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[command and control link]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the data
      link between a remotely piloted aircraft and a control station
      that is used in the management of a flight; ([liaison de commande
      et de contrôle]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Commercial Air Service Standards]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Commercial Air Service Standards]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the
      standards published under the authority of the Minister that apply
      in respect of commercial air services operated by air
      operators; ([Normes de service aérien commercial]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[commercial part]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[commercial part]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of an
      aircraft, means a part

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that is not specifically designed or produced
        for use as an aeronautical product,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that is made to a specification or catalogue
        description and marked under an identification scheme of the
        maker, and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} whose failure does not adversely affect the
        continued safe flight and take-off and landing of the
        aircraft; ([pièce commerciale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[company operations manual]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[company operations manual]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a manual
      established by an air operator pursuant to Part VII; ([manuel
      d'exploitation de la compagnie]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[contact approach]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[contact approach]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an approach in
      which the pilot-in-command of an IFR aircraft proceeds to the
      destination aerodrome by following visual references on the
      surface; ([approche contact]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[contracting state]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[contracting state]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a state that is a
      party to the Convention; ([État contractant]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[control area]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[control area]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the controlled airspace
      within Canadian Domestic Airspace that is specified as the Arctic
      Control Area, the Northern Control Area or the Southern Control
      Area in the Designated Airspace Handbook and that extends upwards
      vertically from a specified altitude or a specified
      pressure-altitude; ([région de contrôle]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[control station]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[control station]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the collection of
      facilities and equipment from which a remotely piloted aircraft is
      controlled and monitored; ([poste de contrôle]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[control zone]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[control zone]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the controlled airspace
      that is so specified in the Designated Airspace Handbook and that
      extends upwards vertically from the surface of the earth up to and
      including 3,000 feet AGL, unless otherwise specified in that
      Handbook; ([zone de contrôle]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[controlled aerodrome]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[controlled aerodrome]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an aerodrome at
      which an air traffic control unit is in operation; ([aérodrome
      contrôlé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[controlled airspace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[controlled airspace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an airspace of
      fixed dimensions that is so specified in the Designated Airspace
      Handbook and within which air traffic control service is
      provided; ([espace aérien contrôlé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Convention]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Convention]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Convention on
      International Civil Aviation signed on behalf of Canada at Chicago
      on December 7, 1944, as amended from time to
      time; ([Convention]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[crew member]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[crew member]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person who is assigned
      to duty in an aircraft during flight time, or assigned to duty
      related to the operation of a remotely piloted aircraft system
      during flight time; ([membre d'équipage]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[critical engine]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[critical engine]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the engine the
      failure of which would most adversely affect the performance or
      handling qualities of an aircraft; ([moteur le plus
      défavorable]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[CUSMA]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[CUSMA]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the meaning assigned by the
      definition [[Agreement]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in section 2 of the
      [Canada--United States--Mexico Agreement Implementation
      Act](/eng/acts/C-10.65); ([ACEUM]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[CVFR]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[CVFR]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[controlled VFR
      flight]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a flight conducted under the
      visual flight rules within Class B Airspace and in accordance with
      an air traffic control clearance; ([CVFR]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"} ou [vol VFR contrôlé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[CVR]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[CVR]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[cockpit voice
      recorder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a system that uses a
      combination of microphones and other analog and digital devices to
      record and retain the aural environment of a cockpit as well as
      communications to, from and between flight crew
      members; ([CVR]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou [enregistreur de la
      parole dans le poste de pilotage]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[danger area]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[danger area]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an airspace of fixed
      dimensions that is so specified in the Designated Airspace
      Handbook, within which activities dangerous to the flight of
      aircraft could take place at the times specified in the
      Handbook; ([zone dangereuse]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[dangerous goods]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[dangerous goods]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means dangerous goods as
      defined in section 2 of the [Transportation of Dangerous Goods
      Act, 1992](/eng/acts/T-19.01); ([marchandises
      dangereuses]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[day]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[day]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or
      [[daylight]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the time between the
      beginning of morning civil twilight and the end of evening civil
      twilight; ([jour]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[decision height]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[decision height]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the height specified
      in the Canada Air Pilot or the Restricted Canada Air Pilot at
      which a missed approach procedure is to be initiated during a
      precision approach if the required visual reference necessary to
      continue the approach to land has not been established; ([hauteur
      de décision]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Designated Airspace Handbook]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Designated Airspace Handbook]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the
      manual that contains information in respect of the designation of
      airspace and that is published under the authority of the
      Minister; ([Manuel des espaces aériens désignés]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[elementary work]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[elementary work]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means those tasks that are
      listed as elementary work in the Aircraft Equipment and
      Maintenance Standards; ([travaux élémentaires]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[ELT]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[ELT]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an emergency locator
      transmitter; ([ELT]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[empty weight]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[empty weight]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of an aircraft,
      means the total weight of the following parts or contents that are
      part of, or carried on board, the aircraft, namely,

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the airframe, including the rotor in the case
        of a helicopter or gyroplane,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the power plant,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the fixed ballast,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the unusable fuel,

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the maximum amount of normal operating fluids,
        including oil, power plant coolant, hydraulic fluid, de-icing
        fluid and anti-icing fluid but not including potable water,
        lavatory pre-charge fluid or fluid intended for injection into
        the engines, and

      - [(f)]{.lawlabel} all of the installed equipment; ([masse à
        vide]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[ESCAT plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[ESCAT plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[Emergency Security Control
      of Air Traffic Plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the measures to be
      implemented by Her Majesty in right of Canada in accordance with
      the North American Aerospace Defence Command (NORAD) Agreement in
      the case of an air defence emergency; ([plan
      ESCAT]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou [Plan relatif au contrôle de
      sécurité d'urgence de la circulation aérienne]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[EUBA]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[EUBA]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[emergency underwater breathing
      apparatus]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a self-contained
      supplemental air supply that is designed to prolong the breathing
      capability of a passenger or a crew member during the evacuation
      of a helicopter that has overturned or is sinking after a
      ditching; ([EUBA]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou [dispositif
      respiratoire submersible de secours]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[extended over-water operation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[extended over-water operation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an aircraft other than a
        helicopter, a flight over an area of water located at a
        horizontal distance of more than 50 nautical miles from the
        nearest shoreline, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a helicopter, a flight over an
        area of water located at a horizontal distance of more than 50
        nautical miles from the nearest shoreline or more than 50
        nautical miles from the nearest offshore heliport
        structure; ([survol prolongé d'un plan d'eau]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[FAF]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[FAF]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means final approach
      fix; ([FAF]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[FDR]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[FDR]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[flight data
      recorder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a digital device that uses a
      combination of data providers to collect and record parameters
      that reflect the state and performance of an
      aircraft; ([FDR]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou [enregistreur de
      données de vol]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Federal Aviation Regulations]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Federal Aviation Regulations]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the
      Federal Aviation Regulations published by the Government of the
      United States, as amended from time to time; ([Federal Aviation
      Regulations]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[fit for duty]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[fit for duty]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a person,
      means that their ability to act as a flight crew member of an
      aircraft is not impaired by fatigue, the consumption of alcohol or
      drugs or any mental or physical condition; ([apte au
      travail]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[FL]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[FL]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[flight
      level]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the altitude expressed in
      hundreds of feet, indicated on an altimeter set to 29.92 inches of
      mercury or 1 013.2 millibars; ([FL]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou
      [niveau de vol]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[flight]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flight]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a balloon in free or
      tethered flight, means the period of time between the moment when
      the balloon, including the envelope and basket, leaves a
      supporting surface and the moment it next comes to rest on
      landing; ([vol]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[flight attendant]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flight attendant]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a crew member,
      other than a flight crew member, who has been assigned duties to
      be performed in the interest of the passengers in a
      passenger-carrying aircraft; ([agent de bord]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[flight authority]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flight authority]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a certificate of
      airworthiness, special certificate of airworthiness, flight permit
      or validation of a foreign document attesting to an aircraft's
      fitness for flight, issued under Subpart 7 of Part V, or a foreign
      certificate of airworthiness that meets the requirements of
      Article 31 of the Convention; ([autorité de vol]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[flight crew member]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flight crew member]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a crew member
      assigned to act as pilot or flight engineer of an aircraft during
      flight time; ([membre d'équipage de conduite]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[flight crew member on call]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flight crew member on call]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a flight
      crew member who has been designated by an air operator to be
      available to report for flight duty on notice of one hour or
      less; ([membre d'équipage de conduite en
      disponibilité]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[flight crew member on standby]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flight crew member on standby]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      flight crew member who has been designated by an air operator or
      private operator to remain at a specified location in order to be
      available to report for flight duty on notice of one hour or
      less; ([membre d'équipage de conduite en attente]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[flight deck duty time]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flight deck duty time]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
      SOR/2018-269, s. 1\]]{.Repealed}

  [[flight duty period]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flight duty period]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the period that
      begins when the earliest of the following events occurs and ends
      at engines off or rotors stopped at the end of a flight:

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the flight crew member carries out any duties
        assigned by the private operator or the air operator or
        delegated by the Minister before reporting for a flight,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the member reports for a flight or, if there is
        more than one flight during the flight duty period, reports for
        the first flight,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the member reports for positioning, and

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the member reports as a flight crew member on
        standby; ([période de service de vol]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[flight duty time]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flight duty time]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
      SOR/2018-269, s. 1\]]{.Repealed}

  [[flight following]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flight following]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the monitoring of a
      flight's progress, the provision of any operational information
      that might be requested by the pilot-in-command, and the
      notification of the flight training unit and search and rescue
      authorities if the flight is overdue or missing; ([suivi de
      vol]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[flight information services]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flight information services]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the dissemination of aviation weather
        information and aeronautical information for departure,
        destination and alternate aerodromes along a proposed route of
        flight,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the dissemination of aviation weather
        information and aeronautical information to aircraft in flight,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the acceptance, processing and activation of
        flight plans and flight itineraries and amendments to and
        cancellations of flight plans and flight itineraries,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the exchange of flight plan information with
        domestic or foreign governments or agencies or foreign air
        traffic services units, and

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the dissemination of information concerning
        known ground and air traffic; ([services d'information de
        vol]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[flight inspection]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flight inspection]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the operation of
      an aircraft for the purpose of

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} calibrating air navigation aids,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} monitoring or evaluating the performance of air
        navigation aids, or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} obstacle assessment; ([inspection en
        vol]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[flight itinerary]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flight itinerary]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the information
      required to be filed in the form of a flight itinerary pursuant to
      Division III of Subpart 2 of Part VI; ([itinéraire de
      vol]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[flight plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flight plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the information that is
      required to be filed in the form of a flight plan pursuant to
      Division III of Subpart 2 of Part VI; ([plan de
      vol]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[flight relief facility --- bunk]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flight relief facility --- bunk]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      bunk that meets the requirements of Aerospace Recommended Practice
      ARP4101/3, Crew Rest Facilities, published by the Society of
      Automotive Engineers (SAE), and is configured in accordance with
      the requirements of section 3.2.9 of Aerospace Recommended
      Practice ARP4101, Flight Deck Layout and Facilities, published by
      the SAE; ([poste de repos --- couchette]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[flight relief facility --- seat]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flight relief facility --- seat]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      fully reclining seat that is separated and screened off from the
      passengers and flight deck, that is equipped with a call device, a
      restraint system designed to restrain a sleeping person and
      portable oxygen equipment, and that is not subject to distraction
      from noise generated in the cabin; ([poste de repos ---
      siège]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[flight service station]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flight service station]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
      SOR/2025-98, s. 1\]]{.Repealed}

  [[flight simulation training device]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flight simulation training device]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
      apparatus, including synthetic flight training equipment, that
      replicates or emulates an aircraft or aircraft component for the
      purpose of training and testing; ([dispositif de formation
      simulant le vol]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[flight time]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flight time]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the time from the moment
      an aircraft first moves under its own power for the purpose of
      taking off until the moment it comes to rest at the end of the
      flight; ([temps de vol]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[flight training]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flight training]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a training program
      of ground instruction and airborne training that is conducted in
      accordance with the flight instructor guide and flight training
      manual applicable to the aircraft used; ([entraînement en
      vol]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[flight training service]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flight training service]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a commercial
      air service that is operated for the purpose of conducting flight
      training; ([service d'entraînement en vol]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[flight training unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flight training unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an aeroplane or helicopter, the
        holder of a flight training unit operator certificate, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a glider, balloon, gyroplane or
        ultra-light aeroplane, a person, club, school or other
        organization that conducts flight training; ([unité de formation
        au pilotage]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[flight training unit operator certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flight training unit operator
      certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a certificate issued under
      Subpart 6 of Part IV that authorizes the holder of the certificate
      to operate a flight training service; ([certificat d'exploitation
      d'unité de formation au pilotage]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[flight visibility]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flight visibility]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the visibility
      forward from the cockpit of an aircraft in flight; ([visibilité en
      vol]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[flight watch]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flight watch]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means maintaining current
      information on the progress of a flight and monitoring all factors
      and conditions that might affect the flight; ([surveillance de
      vol]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[FS unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[FS unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[flight services
      unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an ATS unit that provides
      services, other than air traffic control services, for the safe
      movement of aircraft; ([unité FS]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou
      [unité des services de vol]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[glider]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[glider]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a non-power-driven
      heavier-than-air aircraft that derives its lift in flight from
      aerodynamic reactions on surfaces that remain fixed during
      flight; ([planeur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[GNSS]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[GNSS]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means global navigation satellite
      system; ([GNSS]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[ground station]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[ground station]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a location on the
      ground equipped with radio transmitting and receiving equipment
      capable of two-way voice communications with an
      aircraft; ([station au sol]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[ground visibility]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[ground visibility]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of an
      aerodrome, means the visibility at that aerodrome as contained in
      a weather observation reported by

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an air traffic control unit,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an air traffic services unit,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a community aerodrome radio station,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} an AWOS used by the Department of Transport,
        the Department of National Defence or the Atmospheric
        Environment Service for the purpose of making aviation weather
        observations, or

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a radio station that is ground-based and
        operated by an air operator; ([visibilité au
        sol]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[gyroplane]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[gyroplane]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a heavier-than-air
      aircraft that derives its lift in flight from aerodynamic
      reactions on one or more non-power-driven rotors on substantially
      vertical axes; ([autogire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[hang glider]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[hang glider]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a glider that is
      designed to carry not more than two persons and has a launch
      weight of 45 kg (99.2 pounds) or less; ([aile
      libre]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[heading]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[heading]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the direction in which the
      longitudinal axis of an aircraft is pointed, usually expressed in
      true, magnetic or grid degrees from North; ([cap]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[heavier-than-air aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[heavier-than-air aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
      aircraft supported in the atmosphere by lift derived from
      aerodynamic forces; ([aérodyne]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[helicopter]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[helicopter]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a power-driven
      heavier-than-air aircraft that derives its lift in flight from
      aerodynamic reactions on one or more power-driven rotors on
      substantially vertical axes; ([hélicoptère]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[helicopter Class A external load]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[helicopter Class A external load]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
      external load that cannot move freely, cannot be jettisoned and
      does not extend below the landing gear; ([charge externe de classe
      A pour hélicoptère]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[helicopter Class B external load]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[helicopter Class B external load]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
      external load that can be jettisoned and that is not in contact
      with land, water or any other surface; ([charge externe de classe
      B pour hélicoptère]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[helicopter Class C external load]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[helicopter Class C external load]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
      external load that can be jettisoned and that remains in contact
      with land, water or any other surface; ([charge externe de classe
      C pour hélicoptère]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[helicopter Class D external load]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[helicopter Class D external load]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
      external load with a person carried externally or any external
      load, other than a Class A, B or C external load; ([charge externe
      de classe D pour hélicoptère]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[heliport]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[heliport]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an aerodrome in respect of
      which a heliport certificate issued under Subpart 5 of Part III is
      in force; ([héliport]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[high level airspace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[high level airspace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means airspace at or
      above 18,000 feet ASL that is within Canadian Domestic
      Airspace; ([espace aérien supérieur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[high seas]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[high seas]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any body of water, or
      frozen surface thereof, that is not within the territorial waters
      of any state; ([haute mer]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[home base]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[home base]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the location where a
      flight crew member normally commutes to in order to report for a
      flight duty period or positioning; ([base
      d'affectation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[HUD]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[HUD]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means head-up
      display; ([HUD]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[ice]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[ice]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means water that has frozen on a
      surface and includes the condition commonly known as black ice and
      the condition in which compacted snow has turned into a polished
      ice surface; ([glace]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[IFR]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[IFR]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means instrument flight
      rules; ([IFR]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[IFR air traffic control message]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[IFR air traffic control message]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      message that contains an air traffic control clearance or
      instruction, a position report or procedure related to the conduct
      of an IFR flight; ([message IFR du contrôle de la circulation
      aérienne]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[IFR aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[IFR aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an aircraft operating
      in IFR flight; ([aéronef IFR]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[IFR flight]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[IFR flight]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a flight conducted in
      accordance with the instrument flight rules; ([vol
      IFR]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[IMC]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[IMC]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[instrument meteorological
      conditions]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means meteorological conditions
      less than the minima specified in Division VI of Subpart 2 of Part
      VI for visual meteorological conditions, expressed in terms of
      visibility and distance from cloud; ([IMC]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"} ou [conditions météorologiques de vol aux
      instruments]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[infant]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[infant]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person under two years of
      age; ([enfant en bas âge]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[instrument approach]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[instrument approach]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the orderly
      positioning of an IFR aircraft from the enroute phase to a
      position and altitude from which a landing may be completed or a
      missed approach procedure may be initiated; ([approche aux
      instruments]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[instrument approach procedure]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[instrument approach procedure]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in
      respect of an aircraft on an instrument approach to a runway or
      aerodrome, a procedure for an instrument approach determined by
      the pilot-in-command of the aircraft on the basis of the
      information specified in the Canada Air Pilot for an instrument
      approach to that runway or aerodrome or, if no such information is
      specified in the Canada Air Pilot, the information specified in
      the Restricted Canada Air Pilot for an aircraft operated under
      Subpart 6 of Part IV, Subpart 4 of Part VI, or Part
      VII; ([procédure d'approche aux instruments]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[instrument time]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[instrument time]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} instrument ground time,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} actual instrument flight time, or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} simulated instrument flight time; ([temps aux
        instruments]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[invited assembly of persons]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[invited assembly of persons]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any
      number of persons who have been invited, by any means, to attend a
      special aviation event. The term excludes competition judges, the
      holder of a special flight operations certificate, members of a
      certificate holder's staff and members of a participant's support
      team; ([rassemblement de personnes invitées]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[land aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[land aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an aircraft that is
      not capable of normal operations on water; ([aéronef
      terrestre]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[landing]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[landing]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in respect of an aircraft other than an
        airship, the act of coming into contact with a supporting
        surface, and includes the acts immediately preceding and
        following the coming into contact with that surface, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of an airship, the act of bringing
        the airship under restraint, and includes the acts immediately
        preceding and following the bringing of the airship under
        restraint; ([atterrissage]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[large aeroplane]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[large aeroplane]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an aeroplane with an
      MCTOW of more than 5 700 kg (12,566 pounds); ([gros
      avion]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[launch weight]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[launch weight]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the total weight of a
      hang glider or an ultra-light aeroplane when it is ready for
      flight, including any equipment, instruments, fuel or oil, but not
      including

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the weight of the occupants,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the weight of any float equipment to a maximum
        of 34 kg (74.93 pounds), or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the weight of any ballistic parachute
        installation; ([poids au départ]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[LDA]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[LDA]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[landing distance
      available]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the length of a runway at an
      aerodrome that the aerodrome operator declares available and
      suitable for the ground run of an aeroplane that is
      landing; ([LDA]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou [distance
      d'atterrissage utilisable]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[life-limited part]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[life-limited part]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a part that, as a
      condition of the type certificate, may not exceed a specified
      time, or number of operating cycles, in service; ([pièce à vie
      limitée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[light turbulence]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[light turbulence]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means turbulence that
      momentarily causes slight, erratic changes in altitude or attitude
      or turbulence that causes slight, rapid and somewhat rhythmic
      bumpiness without appreciable changes in altitude or
      attitude; ([turbulence légère]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[lighter-than-air aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[lighter-than-air aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
      aircraft supported in the atmosphere by its
      buoyancy; ([aérostat]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[limited supplemental type certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[limited supplemental type
      certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2009-280, s.
      1\]]{.Repealed}

  [[low level airspace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[low level airspace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means airspace below
      18,000 feet ASL that is within Canadian Domestic
      Airspace; ([espace aérien inférieur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[low-visibility procedures]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[low-visibility procedures]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means procedures
      specified for an airport in the Canada Air Pilot that restrict
      aircraft and vehicle operations on the movement area of the
      airport when the runway visual range is less than 1,200
      feet; ([procédures par faible visibilité]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[maintenance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[maintenance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the overhaul, repair,
      required inspection or modification of an aeronautical product, or
      the removal of a component from or its installation on an
      aeronautical product, but does not include

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} elementary work,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} servicing, or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} work performed on an aircraft by the
        manufacturer prior to the issuance of whichever of the following
        documents is issued first:

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a certificate of airworthiness,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a special certificate of airworthiness, or

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} an export airworthiness
          certificate; ([maintenance]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[maintenance release]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[maintenance release]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a certification
      made following the maintenance of an aeronautical product,
      indicating that the maintenance was performed in accordance with
      the applicable provisions of these Regulations and the standards
      of airworthiness; ([certification après
      maintenance]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[maintenance schedule]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[maintenance schedule]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a schedule
      required pursuant to section 605.86 for the performance of the
      inspections and other maintenance required by these
      Regulations; ([calendrier de maintenance]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[major modification]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[major modification]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an alteration to
      the type design of an aeronautical product in respect of which a
      type certificate has been issued that has other than a negligible
      effect on the weight and centre-of-gravity limits, structural
      strength, performance, power plant operation, flight
      characteristics or other qualities affecting its airworthiness or
      environmental characteristics; ([modification
      majeure]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[major repair]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[major repair]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a repair to an
      aeronautical product in respect of which a type certificate has
      been issued, that causes the aeronautical product to deviate from
      the type design defined by the type certificate, where the
      deviation from the type design has other than a negligible effect
      on the weight and centre-of-gravity limits, structural strength,
      performance, power plant operation, flight characteristics or
      other qualities affecting the aeronautical product's airworthiness
      or environmental characteristics; ([réparation
      majeure]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[mandatory frequency]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[mandatory frequency]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a VHF frequency
      specified in the Canada Air Pilot or the Canada Flight Supplement
      for the use of radio-equipped aircraft operating within an MF
      area; ([fréquence obligatoire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[manoeuvring area]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[manoeuvring area]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means that part of an
      aerodrome, other than an apron, that is intended to be used for
      the take-off and landing of aircraft and for the movement of
      aircraft associated with take-off and landing; ([aire de
      manoeuvre]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Manual of All Weather Operations (Categories II and III)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Manual of All Weather Operations (Categories II and
      III)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the manual that contains
      information in respect of the operation of aircraft in various
      weather conditions and that is published under the authority of
      the Minister; ([Manuel d'exploitation tous temps (catégories II et
      III)]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[manufacture]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[manufacture]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the making, assembly and
      fabrication, other than the fabrication of parts as part of a
      repair, of aeronautical products, and includes, in the case of
      newly manufactured aircraft, any work performed on an aircraft
      prior to the issuance of the first certificate of airworthiness or
      export certificate of airworthiness by the
      manufacturer; ([construction]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[manufacturer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[manufacturer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the holder of a type
      certificate for an aeronautical product or, where no type
      certificate has been issued by the Minister, the maker of the
      aeronautical product; ([constructeur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[manufacturer certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[manufacturer certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      certificate issued under Subpart 61 of Part V; ([certificat de
      constructeur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[maximum permissible take-off weight]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[maximum permissible take-off weight]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
      the maximum take-off weight for an aircraft as authorized by the
      state of registry of the aircraft or as provided for in the
      aircraft type certificate; ([masse maximale admissible au
      décollage]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[MCTOW]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[MCTOW]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[maximum certificated take-off
      weight]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the weight identified as such
      in the type certificate of an aircraft; ([MMHD]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"} ou [masse maximale homologuée au
      décollage]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[medical evacuation flight]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[medical evacuation flight]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a flight
      that is carried out for the purpose of facilitating medical
      assistance and on which one or more of the following persons or
      things is transported:

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} medical personnel,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} ill or injured persons,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} human blood products or organs,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} medical supplies; ([vol d'évacuation
        médicale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[MEL]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[MEL]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[minimum equipment
      list]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a document approved by the
      Minister pursuant to subsection 605.07(3) that authorizes an
      operator to operate an aircraft with aircraft equipment that is
      inoperative under the conditions specified therein, and may
      specify certain equipment that must be
      operative; ([MEL]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou [liste
      d'équipement minimal]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[MF area]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[MF area]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an area of specific
      dimensions that consists of the surface area and airspace in the
      vicinity of an uncontrolled aerodrome and

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} to which a mandatory frequency has been
        assigned,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of which the reporting procedures
        specified in Division V of Subpart 2 of Part VI are applicable,
        and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} that is identified as an MF area in the Canada
        Air Pilot or the Canada Flight Supplement; ([zone
        MF]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[minimum descent altitude]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[minimum descent altitude]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the
      altitude ASL, specified in the Canada Air Pilot or the Restricted
      Canada Air Pilot for a non-precision approach, below which descent
      is not to be made until the required visual reference necessary to
      continue the approach to land has been established; ([altitude
      minimale de descente]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[minimum enroute altitude]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[minimum enroute altitude]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
      SOR/2006-77, s. 1\]]{.Repealed}

  [[minimum rest period]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[minimum rest period]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a period during
      which a flight crew member is free from all duties, is not
      interrupted by the air operator or private operator, and is
      provided with an opportunity to obtain not less than eight
      consecutive hours of sleep in suitable accommodation, time to
      travel to and from that accommodation and time for personal
      hygiene and meals; ([période de repos minimale]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[Minister]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Minister]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Minister of
      Transport; ([ministre]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[missed approach procedure]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[missed approach procedure]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the
      procedure to be followed if, for any reason after conducting an
      instrument approach, a landing is not effected; ([procédure
      d'approche interrompue]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[MMEL]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[MMEL]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[master minimum equipment
      list]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a document established by the
      Minister pursuant to subsection 605.07(1) that lists the aircraft
      equipment that is allowed to be inoperative for a particular type
      of aircraft under the conditions specified
      therein; ([MMEL]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou [liste principale
      d'équipement minimal]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[MOCA]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[MOCA]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[minimum obstruction clearance
      altitude]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the altitude ASL that is
      specified on an IFR chart between fixes on an airway, on a fixed
      RNAV route or on an air route and that meets the IFR obstruction
      clearance requirements; ([MOCA]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou
      [altitude minimale de franchissement d'obstacles]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[model aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[model aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2019-11, s.
      1\]]{.Repealed}

  [[model rocket]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[model rocket]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a rocket that

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is equipped with model rocket motors that will
        not generate a total impulse exceeding 160 N.s,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} has a gross weight, including motors, not
        exceeding 1 500 g (3.3 pounds), and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} is equipped with a parachute or other device
        capable of retarding its descent; ([modèle réduit de
        fusée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Mode S transponder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Mode S transponder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the airborne Mode
      S air traffic control (ATC) transponder referred to in
      CAN-TSO-C112; ([transpondeur mode S]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[movement area]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[movement area]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a part of an aerodrome
      that is intended to be used for the surface movement of aircraft,
      and includes the manoeuvring area and aprons; ([aire de
      mouvement]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[night]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[night]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the time between the end of
      evening civil twilight and the beginning of morning civil
      twilight; ([nuit]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[non-piloted aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[non-piloted aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
      SOR/2003-271, s. 1\]]{.Repealed}

  [[non-precision approach]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[non-precision approach]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an instrument
      approach by an aircraft using azimuth information; ([approche de
      non-précision]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Northern Domestic Airspace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Northern Domestic Airspace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the
      airspace so specified, and delineated, in the Designated Airspace
      Handbook; ([espace aérien intérieur du Nord]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[NOTAM]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[NOTAM]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a notice containing
      information concerning the establishment or condition of, or
      change in, any aeronautical facility, service or procedure, or any
      air navigation hazard, the timely knowledge of which is essential
      to personnel concerned with flight
      operations; ([NOTAM]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[obstacle limitation surface]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[obstacle limitation surface]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      surface that establishes the limit to which objects may project
      into an aerodrome's airspace, so that aircraft operations for
      which the aerodrome is intended may be conducted safely, and
      consists of a transitional surface, a take-off surface, an
      approach surface and an outer surface; ([surface de limitation
      d'obstacles]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[offshore operations flight]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[offshore operations flight]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a flight
      that is conducted to or from an offshore location and that is

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a flight in support of offshore oil, gas or
        mineral exploitation,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a sea-pilot transfer flight, or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a search and rescue flight; ([vol
        d'exploitation extracôtière]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[one-engine-inoperative take-off distance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[one-engine-inoperative take-off
      distance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the distance from the start
      of the take-off roll to the point at which the aeroplane reaches
      35 feet above the runway elevation, where failure of the critical
      engine is recognized at V~1~; ([distance de décollage avec un
      moteur inopérant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[one-engine-inoperative take-off run]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[one-engine-inoperative take-off run]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
      the distance from the start of the take-off roll to the point
      midway between the lift-off point and the point at which the
      aeroplane reaches 35 feet above the runway elevation, where
      failure of the critical engine is recognized at V~1~; ([roulement
      au décollage avec un moteur inopérant]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[operator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[operator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of an aircraft, means
      the person that has possession of the aircraft as owner, lessee or
      otherwise; ([utilisateur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[operator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[operator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in respect of an airport or
      heliport, means the holder of the appropriate Canadian aviation
      document that is in force with respect to the airport or heliport
      or the person in charge of the airport or heliport, whether as
      employee, agent or representative of the holder of the Canadian
      aviation document; ([exploitant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[ornithopter]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[ornithopter]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a heavier-than-air
      aircraft supported in flight chiefly by the reactions of the air
      on planes to which a flapping motion is
      imparted; ([ornithoptère]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[overhaul]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[overhaul]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a restoration process that
      includes the disassembly, inspection, repair or replacement of
      parts, reassembly, adjustment, refinishing and testing of an
      aeronautical product, and ensures that the aeronautical product is
      in complete conformity with the service tolerances specified in
      the applicable instructions for continued
      airworthiness; ([révision majeure]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[owner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[owner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of an aircraft or
      remotely piloted aircraft system, means the person who has legal
      custody and control of the aircraft or
      system; ([propriétaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[part design approval]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[part design approval]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a document
      issued by the Minister to record the approval of the design of a
      replacement part, identified by a part number or by some other
      means of identification unique to the part, for use on an
      aeronautical product that is identified by type or
      model; ([approbation de la conception de pièce]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[passenger]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[passenger]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person, other than a
      crew member, who is carried on board an
      aircraft; ([passager]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[PED]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[PED]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[portable electronic
      device]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any lightweight, electrically
      powered electronic device capable of transmitting or producing
      electromagnetic signals; ([PED]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou
      [appareil électronique portatif]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[permanent resident]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[permanent resident]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a permanent
      resident as defined in subsection 2(1) of the Immigration
      Act; ([résident permanent]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[personal flotation device]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[personal flotation device]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
      SOR/2019-49, s. 1\]]{.Repealed}

  [[pilot self-dispatch]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[pilot self-dispatch]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the
      responsibility of the pilot-in-command for all decisions
      respecting the operational flight plan and for the flight
      watch; ([régulation du vol par le pilote]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[positioning]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[positioning]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the transfer of a flight
      crew member from one location to another, at the request of an air
      operator, but does not include travel to or from suitable
      accommodation or the member's lodging; ([mise en
      place]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[powered glider]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[powered glider]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an aeroplane that,
      with engines inoperative, has the flight characteristics of a
      glider; ([planeur propulsé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[powered parachute aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[powered parachute aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      power-driven heavier-than-air aircraft that derives its lift in
      flight from aerodynamic reactions on surfaces of a flexible
      parachute-type aerofoil; ([aéronef pour parachute entraîné par
      moteur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[precision approach]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[precision approach]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an instrument
      approach by an aircraft using azimuth and glide path
      information; ([approche de précision]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[primary structure]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[primary structure]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a structure that
      carries flight, ground or pressure loads; ([structure
      primaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[private aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[private aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an aircraft that is
      registered as a private aircraft pursuant to sections 202.16 and
      202.17; ([aéronef privé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[private operator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[private operator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the holder of a
