      private operator registration document; ([exploitant
      privé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[private operator certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[private operator certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
      SOR/2014-131, s. 1\]]{.Repealed}

  [[private operator registration document]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[private operator registration
      document]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a document issued under
      subsection 604.04(2); ([document d'enregistrement d'exploitant
      privé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[protective breathing equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[protective breathing equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
      equipment designed to cover the eyes, nose and mouth of the
      wearer, or the nose and mouth where accessory equipment is
      provided to protect the eyes, and to protect the wearer from the
      effects of smoke, carbon dioxide or other harmful
      gases; ([inhalateur protecteur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[quick-donning mask]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[quick-donning mask]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an oxygen mask
      that can be secured by a person using one hand on the person's
      face within five seconds, and that provides an immediate supply of
      oxygen; ([masque à mise rapide]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[registered aerodrome]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[registered aerodrome]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an aerodrome
      registered by the Minister pursuant to Subpart 1 of Part
      III; ([aérodrome enregistré]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[remotely piloted aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[remotely piloted aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      navigable aircraft, other than a balloon, rocket or kite, that is
      operated by a pilot who is not on board; ([aéronef
      télépiloté]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[remotely piloted aircraft system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[remotely piloted aircraft system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or
      [[RPAS]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a set of configurable elements
      consisting of a remotely piloted aircraft, its control station,
      the command and control links and any other system elements
      required during flight operation; ([système d'aéronef
      télépiloté]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou [SATP]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[repair]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[repair]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the rectification of
      deficiencies in an aeronautical product or the restoration of an
      aeronautical product to an airworthy
      condition; ([réparation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[repair design approval]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[repair design approval]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a document,
      including a repair design certificate issued before December 1,
      2009 under section 513.11 or 513.22, issued by the Minister to
      record the approval of

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a repair design in respect of a repair to an
        aeronautical product identified in the document by a serial
        number, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a repair process in respect of a repair to an
        aeronautical product or any of its components, identified in the
        document by a serial number, by a part number or by some other
        identification unique to the component; ([approbation de la
        conception de réparation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[repair design certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[repair design certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
      SOR/2009-280, s. 1\]]{.Repealed}

  [[reportable service difficulty]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[reportable service difficulty]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      service difficulty that affects or that, if not corrected, is
      likely to affect the safety of an aircraft, its occupants or any
      other person; ([difficulté en service à signaler]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[required inspection]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[required inspection]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an inspection of
      an aeronautical product that is required by a maintenance
      schedule, an airworthiness limitation or an airworthiness
      directive, except where the airworthiness directive specifies that
      the inspection may be performed by a flight crew
      member; ([inspection obligatoire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[required take-off distance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[required take-off distance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the
      one-engine-inoperative take-off distance or 115 per cent of the
      all-engines-operating take-off distance, whichever is
      greater; ([distance de décollage exigée]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[required take-off run]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[required take-off run]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the
      one-engine-inoperative take-off run or 115 per cent of the
      all-engines-operating take-off run, whichever is
      greater; ([roulement au décollage exigé]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[required visual reference]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[required visual reference]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of
      an aircraft on an approach to a runway, means that portion of the
      approach area of the runway or those visual aids that, when viewed
      by the pilot of the aircraft, enable the pilot to make an
      assessment of the aircraft position and rate of change of
      position, in order to continue the approach and complete a
      landing; ([référence visuelle requise]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[rest period]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[rest period]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the continuous period
      during which a flight crew member is off duty, excluding the
      travel time to or from suitable accommodation provided by a
      private operator or air operator; ([période de
      repos]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[restricted airspace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[restricted airspace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means airspace of
      fixed dimensions that is so specified in the Designated Airspace
      Handbook and within which the flight of aircraft is restricted in
      accordance with certain conditions specified in that
      Handbook; ([espace aérien réglementé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Restricted Canada Air Pilot]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Restricted Canada Air Pilot]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
      aeronautical information publication published by NAV CANADA that
      contains information on restricted instrument procedures; ([Canada
      Air Pilot restreint]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[RNAV]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[RNAV]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[area
      navigation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a method of navigation that
      allows an aircraft to follow a flight path that is within a
      navigational aid's range or the capabilities of a self-contained
      navigation system or that is within a combination of these ranges
      and capabilities; ([RNAV]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou
      [navigation de surface]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[rocket]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[rocket]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a projectile that contains
      its own propellant and that depends for its flight on a reaction
      set up by the release of a continuous jet of rapidly expanding
      gases; ([fusée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[runway visibility]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[runway visibility]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the distance along
      a runway over which a person can see and recognize a visibility
      marker or lights having an intensity of more or less 1,000
      candelas; ([visibilité sur la piste]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[RVR]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[RVR]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[runway visual
      range]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the range over which the pilot
      of an aircraft on the centre line of a runway can expect to see
      the runway surface markings or the lights delineating the runway
      or identifying that centre line; ([RVR]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"} ou [portée visuelle de piste]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[RVR A]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[RVR A]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a runway, means RVR
      detection equipment that is located adjacent to the runway
      threshold; ([RVR « A »]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[RVR B]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[RVR B]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a runway, means RVR
      detection equipment that is located adjacent to the runway
      mid-point; ([RVR « B »]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[RVSM airspace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[RVSM airspace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[Reduced Vertical
      Separation Minimum airspace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means airspace
      where a vertical separation minimum of 1,000 feet applies, whose
      horizontal and vertical limits are

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in respect of Canadian airspace, specified in
        the Designated Airspace Handbook, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of foreign airspace, designated or
        otherwise recognized by the competent aviation authority of the
        foreign country; ([espace aérien RVSM]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"} ou [espace aérien à espacement minimum vertical
        réduit]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[safety belt]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[safety belt]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a personal restraint
      system consisting of either a lap strap or a lap strap combined
      with a shoulder harness; ([ceinture de sécurité]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[safety management system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[safety management system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      documented process for managing risks that integrates operations
      and technical systems with the management of financial and human
      resources to ensure aviation safety or the safety of the
      public; ([système de gestion de la sécurité]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[safety pilot]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[safety pilot]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a pilot who acts as a
      lookout for another pilot operating an aircraft in simulated
      instrument flight; ([pilote de sécurité]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[SCATANA plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[SCATANA plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[Security Control of Air
      Traffic and Navigation Aids Plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
      SOR/2002-352, s. 1\]]{.Repealed}

  [[SCDA non-precision approach]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[SCDA non-precision approach]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
      stabilized constant-descent-angle non-precision
      approach; ([approche de non-précision SCDA]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[scheduled maintenance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[scheduled maintenance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any
      maintenance performed at predetermined intervals pursuant to these
      Regulations, a maintenance schedule or an airworthiness
      directive; ([maintenance planifiée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[seaplane]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[seaplane]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an aeroplane that is
      capable of normal operations on
      water; ([hydravion]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[serviceable]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[serviceable]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of an aircraft or
      aircraft part, means fit and safe for flight; ([en état de
      service]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[service difficulty]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[service difficulty]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a failure or
      malfunction of, or defect in, an aeronautical
      product; ([difficulté en service]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[servicing]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[servicing]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of an aeronautical
      product, means cleaning, lubricating and the replenishment of
      fluids not requiring the disassembly of the product; ([entretien
      courant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[shoulder harness]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[shoulder harness]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any device that is
      used to restrain the upper torso of a person and that consists of
      a single diagonal upper torso strap or dual upper torso
      straps; ([ceinture-baudrier]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[sightseeing operation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[sightseeing operation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means aerial work in
      the course of which passengers are disembarked at the point of
      departure; ([excursion aérienne]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[small aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[small aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an aeroplane having a
      maximum permissible take-off weight of 5 700 kg (12,566 pounds) or
      less, or a helicopter having a maximum permissible take-off weight
      of 2 730 kg (6,018 pounds) or less; ([petit
      aéronef]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[small remotely piloted aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[small remotely piloted
      aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2025-70, s.
      1\]]{.Repealed}

  [[smoke]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[smoke]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a person, has the
      same meaning as in subsection 2(1) of the [Non-smokers' Health
      Act](/eng/acts/N-23.6); ([fumer]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Southern Domestic Airspace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Southern Domestic Airspace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means that
      airspace so specified, and delineated, in the Designated Airspace
      Handbook; ([espace aérien intérieur du Sud]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[special aviation event]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[special aviation event]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an air show,
      a low level air race, an aerobatic competition, a fly-in or a
      balloon festival; ([manifestation aéronautique
      spéciale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[special VFR flight]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[special VFR flight]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a VFR flight
      authorized by an air traffic control unit that is conducted within
      a control zone under VMC in accordance with Division VI of Subpart
      2 of Part VI; ([vol VFR spécial]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[specialty air services]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[specialty air services]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means aerial
      mapping, aerial surveying, aerial photography, forest fire
      management, fire fighting, aerial advertising, glider towing,
      parachute jumping, aerial construction, heli-logging, aerial
      sightseeing, flight training, aerial inspection and surveillance
      and aerial spraying services; ([services aériens
      spécialisés]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Standard 621]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Standard 621]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Obstacle Marking
      and Lighting Standard of the General Operating and Flight Rules
      Standards, published by the Department of Transport; ([norme
      621]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[standard of airworthiness]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[standard of airworthiness]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of
      the design, manufacture or maintenance of an aeronautical product,
      means the description, in terms of a minimum standard, of the
      properties and attributes of the configuration, material and
      performance or physical characteristics of that aeronautical
      product, and includes the procedures to ascertain compliance with
      or to maintain that minimum standard, as specified in Part
      V; ([norme de navigabilité]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[standard part]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[standard part]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of an aircraft,
      means a part manufactured in conformity with a specification that

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is established, published and maintained by an
        organization setting consensus standards or by a government
        agency, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} includes design, manufacturing, test and
        acceptance criteria and identification requirements; ([pièce
        standard]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[standard pressure region]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[standard pressure region]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means all of the
      Canadian Domestic Airspace not within the altimeter setting
      region; ([région d'utilisation de la pression
      standard]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[station]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[station]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a facility used for
      providing aeronautical information or
      services; ([station]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[stopway]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[stopway]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a rectangular area on the
      ground at the end of a runway in the direction of take-off and
      having the same width as the runway, prepared as a suitable area
      for stopping an aeroplane in the case of a rejected
      take-off; ([prolongement d'arrêt]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[suitable accommodation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[suitable accommodation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      single-occupancy bedroom that is subject to a minimal level of
      noise, is well ventilated and has facilities to control the levels
      of temperature and light or, where such a bedroom is not
      available, an accommodation that is suitable for the site and
      season, is subject to a minimal level of noise and provides
      adequate comfort and protection from the elements; ([poste de
      repos approprié]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[supplemental type certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[supplemental type certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      document, including a limited supplemental type approval and a
      supplemental type approval issued before October 10, 1996 under
      section 214 of the Air Regulations and a limited supplemental type
      certificate issued before December 1, 2009 under section 513.11 or
      513.22, issued by the Minister to record the approval of a change
      to the type design of

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an aeronautical product identified in the
        document by a single serial number,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} several aeronautical products of the same type
        or model, approved under a single type certificate and
        identified in the document by their serial numbers, or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} several aeronautical products of differing
        types or models, approved under separate type certificates and
        identified in the document; ([certificat de type
        supplémentaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[surface]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[surface]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any ground or water,
      including the frozen surface thereof; ([surface]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[take-off]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[take-off]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in respect of an aircraft other than an
        airship, the act of leaving a supporting surface, and includes
        the take-off run and the acts immediately preceding and
        following the leaving of that surface, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of an airship, the act of freeing
        the airship from restraint, and includes the acts immediately
        preceding and following the freeing of that airship from
        restraint; ([décollage]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[TAWS]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[TAWS]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[Terrain Awareness Warning
      System]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an aircraft system that is
      intended to provide a flight crew with both aural and visual
      alerts to aid in preventing controlled flight into terrain,
      obstacles or water; ([TAWS]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou
      [système d'avertissement et d'alarme d'impact]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[terminal control area]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[terminal control area]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means controlled
      airspace that is established in the vicinity of a major aerodrome
      and within which an air traffic control service is provided based
      on the airspace classification; ([région de contrôle
      terminal]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[tethered flight]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[tethered flight]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a balloon,
      means flight while the balloon is attached to a supporting surface
      by a restraining device; ([vol captif]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[TODA]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[TODA]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[take-off distance
      available]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a runway, the
      length of the take-off run available plus, if a clearway is
      provided, the length of the clearway declared available by the
      operator of the aerodrome; ([TODA]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou
      [distance de décollage utilisable]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[TORA]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[TORA]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[take-off run
      available]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the length of a runway
      declared available and suitable by the operator of the aerodrome
      for the ground run of an aeroplane during
      take-off; ([TORA]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou [distance de
      roulement utilisable au décollage]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[track]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[track]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the projection on the earth's
      surface of the path of an aircraft, the direction of which path at
      any point is usually expressed in true, magnetic or grid degrees
      from North; ([route]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[transponder airspace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[transponder airspace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means controlled
      airspace consisting of the airspace referred to in section 601.03,
      within which the aircraft equipment requirements prescribed in
      section 605.35 apply; ([espace aérien à utilisation de
      transpondeur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[transport category aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[transport category aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
      aeroplane certified pursuant to Chapter 525 of the Airworthiness
      Manual or an equivalent foreign airworthiness standard, or a
      helicopter certified pursuant to Chapter 529 of the Airworthiness
      Manual or an equivalent foreign airworthiness standard; ([aéronef
      de catégorie transport]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[true Mach number]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[true Mach number]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the ratio of the
      true air speed of an aircraft to the local speed of sound at the
      flight altitude; ([nombre de Mach vrai]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[TSO-C112]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[TSO-C112]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2009-280, s.
      1\]]{.Repealed}

  [[TSO-C118]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[TSO-C118]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2009-280, s.
      1\]]{.Repealed}

  [[TSO-C119a]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[TSO-C119a]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2009-280, s.
      1\]]{.Repealed}

  [[TSO-C119b]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[TSO-C119b]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2009-280, s.
      1\]]{.Repealed}

  [[type]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[type]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} when used in reference to personnel licensing,
        a specific make and model of aircraft, including modifications
        thereto that do not change its handling or flight
        charateristics, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} when used in reference to the certification of
        aircraft, a classification of aircraft having similar design
        characteristics; ([type]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[type certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[type certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a document, including a type approval issued
        before October 10, 1996 under section 214 of the Air
        Regulations, issued by the Minister to certify that the type
        design of an aircraft, aircraft engine or propeller identified
        in the document meets the applicable standards for that
        aeronautical product recorded in the type certificate data
        sheets, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a document issued by the foreign airworthiness
        authority having jurisdiction over the type design of an
        aeronautical product that is equivalent to a document referred
        to in paragraph (a) and that has been accepted by the Minister
        for the purpose of issuing a certificate of
        airworthiness; ([certificat de type]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[type design]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[type design]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the drawings and specifications, and a listing
        of those drawings and specifications that are necessary to
        define the design features of an aeronautical product in
        compliance with the standards applicable to the aeronautical
        product,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the information on dimensions, materials and
        manufacturing processes that is necessary to define the
        structural strength of an aeronautical product,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the approved sections of the aircraft flight
        manual, where required by the applicable standards of
        airworthiness,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the airworthiness limitations section of the
        instructions for continued airworthiness specified in the
        applicable chapters of the Airworthiness Manual; and

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} any other data necessary to allow, by
        comparison, the determination of the airworthiness and, where
        applicable, the environmental characteristics of later
        aeronautical products of the same type or model; ([définition de
        type]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[UHF]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[UHF]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means ultra-high
      frequency; ([UHF]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[ultra-light aeroplane]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[ultra-light aeroplane]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an advanced
      ultra-light aeroplane or a basic ultra-light aeroplane; ([avion
      ultra-léger]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[unforeseen operational circumstance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[unforeseen operational circumstance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
      an event, such as unforecast adverse weather, or an equipment
      malfunction or air traffic control delay, that is beyond the
      control of an air operator or private operator; ([circonstance
      opérationnelle imprévue]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[unmanned air vehicle]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[unmanned air vehicle]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
      SOR/2019-11, s. 1\]]{.Repealed}

  [[UTC]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[UTC]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Coordinated Universal
      Time; ([UTC]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[vessel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[vessel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any ship, boat or other
      floating structure, other than an aircraft, used for navigation on
      water; ([navire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[VFR]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[VFR]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means visual flight
      rules; ([VFR]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[VFR aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[VFR aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an aircraft operating
      in VFR flight; ([aéronef VFR]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[VFR flight]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[VFR flight]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a flight conducted in
      accordance with the visual flight rules; ([vol
      VFR]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[VFR OTT]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[VFR OTT]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means VFR over-the-top; ([VFR
      OTT]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[VHF]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[VHF]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means very high
      frequency; ([VHF]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[visibility marker]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[visibility marker]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a dark object of
      suitable dimensions for use as a reference in evaluating runway
      visibility; ([balise de visibilité]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[visibility report]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[visibility report]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a report that may
      include runway visibility, ground visibility and RVR; ([compte
      rendu de la visibilité]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[VMC]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[VMC]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[visual meteorological
      conditions]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means meteorological conditions
      equal to or greater than the minima specified in Division VI of
      Subpart 2 of Part VI, expressed in terms of visibility and
      distance from cloud. ([VMC]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou
      [conditions météorologiques de vol à vue]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[wake turbulence]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[wake turbulence]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the turbulent air
      behind an aircraft caused by any of the following:

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} wing-tip vortices,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} rotor-tip vortices,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} jet engine thrust stream,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} rotor downwash,

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} prop wash. ([turbulence de
        sillage]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Unless otherwise indicated in these Regulations, any
  reference to a classification, standard, procedure or other
  specification that is incorporated by reference is a reference to that
  classification, standard, procedure or specification as amended from
  time to time.

### [Subpart 2 --- Application]{.HTitleText2} {#h-987825 .Subheading}

#### [Application]{.HTitleText3} {#h-987826 .Subheading}

**[[102.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-102.01 .sectionLabel}** These Regulations
do not apply in respect of

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} military aircraft of Her Majesty in right of Canada
  when they are being manoeuvred under the authority of the Minister of
  National Defence;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} military aircraft of a country other than Canada, to
  the extent that the Minister of National Defence has exempted them
  from the application of these Regulations pursuant to subsection
  5.9(2) of the Act;

- [(b.1)]{.lawlabel} remotely piloted aircraft that are operated indoors
  or underground; or

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} rockets, hovercraft or wing-in-ground-effect
  machines, unless otherwise indicated in these Regulations.

### [Subpart 3 --- Administration and Compliance]{.HTitleText2} {#h-987831 .Subheading}

#### [Division I]{.HTitleText3}[[\[Repealed, SOR/2019-119, s. 2\]]{.Repealed}]{.HTitleText3} {#h-987832 .Subheading}

**[[103.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-103.01 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed,
SOR/2019-119, s. 2\]]{.Repealed}

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-103.01-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 103.01"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Division II --- Compliance]{.HTitleText3} {#h-987839 .Subheading}

##### [Inspection of Aircraft, Requests for Production of Documents and Prohibitions]{.HTitleText4} {#h-987840 .Subheading}

- **[[103.02]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-103.02
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The owner or operator of an aircraft
  shall, on reasonable notice given by the Minister, make the aircraft
  available for inspection in accordance with the notice.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Every person who

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is the holder of a Canadian aviation document,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is the owner, operator or pilot-in-command of an
    aircraft in respect of which a Canadian aviation document, technical
    record or other document is kept, or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} has in possession a Canadian aviation document,
    technical record or other document relating to an aircraft or a
    commercial air service

  shall produce the Canadian aviation document, technical record or
  other document for inspection in accordance with the terms of a demand
  made by a peace officer, an immigration officer or the Minister.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} No person shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} lend a Canadian aviation document to any person who
    is not entitled to it by these Regulations, or allow any such person
    to use a Canadian aviation document; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} mutilate, alter or render illegible a Canadian
    aviation document.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, [[other
  document]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes all writings, papers and other
  records made, held or maintained by the owner, operator or
  pilot-in-command of an aircraft for the purpose of recording any
  action, activity, performance or use of the aircraft or any activity
  of the owner, operator or crew members in respect of that aircraft,
  whether or not the documents are required by law to be made, held or
  maintained.

##### [Return of Canadian Aviation Documents]{.HTitleText4} {#h-987852 .Subheading}

**[[103.03]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-103.03 .sectionLabel}** Where a Canadian
aviation document has been suspended or cancelled, the person to whom it
was issued shall return it to the Minister immediately after the
effective date of the suspension or cancellation.

##### [Record Keeping]{.HTitleText4} {#h-987854 .Subheading}

**[[103.04]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-103.04 .sectionLabel}** Recording
systems, including computer records and microfiche, that do not comprise
entries on paper may be used to comply with the record-keeping
requirements of these Regulations if

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} measures are taken to ensure that the records
  contained in the recording systems are protected, by electronic or
  other means, against inadvertent loss or destruction and against
  tampering; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a copy of the records contained in the recording
  systems can be printed on paper and provided to the Minister on
  reasonable notice given by the Minister.

**\[103.05 reserved\]**

#### [Division III --- Canadian Aviation Documents]{.HTitleText3} {#h-987859 .Subheading}

##### [Notices of Refusal to Issue, Amend or Renew and Notices of Suspension or Cancellation]{.HTitleText4} {#h-987860 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2004-131, s. 1

\]
:::

- **[[103.06]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-103.06
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A notice issued by the Minister
  pursuant to subsections 6.9(1) and (2) of the Act shall include

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a description of the particulars of the alleged
    contravention;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where the Minister has decided to suspend the
    Canadian aviation document, a statement of the duration of the
    suspension; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a statement that a request for review by the
    Tribunal does not operate as a stay of the suspension or
    cancellation but that an application may be made in writing to the
    Tribunal, pursuant to subsection 6.9(4) of the Act, to stay the
    suspension or cancellation until the review of the decision of the
    Minister has been concluded.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A notice issued by the Minister pursuant to
  subsections 7(1) and (2) of the Act shall include

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the effective date of the
    suspension;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the conditions under which the
    suspension is terminated; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a statement that a request for review by the
    Tribunal does not operate as a stay of the suspension.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} A notice issued by the Minister pursuant to
  subsections 7.1(1) and (2) of the Act shall include

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where the Minister has decided to suspend or cancel
    a Canadian aviation document, a statement of the effective date of
    the suspension or cancellation;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where the Minister has decided to suspend the
    Canadian aviation document, a statement of the duration of the
    suspension or the conditions under which the suspension is
    terminated; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a statement that a request for review by the
    Tribunal does not operate as a stay of the suspension, cancellation
    or refusal to renew.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} A notice issued by the Minister under subsection
  6.71(2) of the Act informing an applicant or an owner or operator of
  an aircraft, aerodrome, airport or other facility of the Minister's
  decision made under subsection 6.71(1) of the Act to refuse to issue
  or amend a Canadian aviation document in respect of the aircraft,
  aerodrome, airport or other facility shall be in the form set out in
  Schedule I to this Subpart.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2004-131, s. 2
:::

##### [Administrative Grounds for Suspension, Cancellation or Refusal to Renew]{.HTitleText4} {#h-987879 .Subheading}

**[[103.07]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-103.07 .sectionLabel}** In addition to
the grounds referred to in sections 6.9 to 7.1 of the Act, the Minister
may suspend, cancel or refuse to renew a Canadian aviation document
where

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the Canadian aviation document has been voluntarily
  surrendered to the Minister by its holder;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Canadian aviation document has been mutilated,
  altered, or rendered illegible;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the aircraft in respect of which the Canadian
  aviation document was issued has been destroyed or withdrawn from use;
  or

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the commercial air service, other service or
  undertaking in respect of which the Canadian aviation document was
  issued has been discontinued.

#### [Division IV --- Designated Provisions]{.HTitleText3} {#h-987885 .Subheading}

##### [Designated Provisions]{.HTitleText4} {#h-987886 .Subheading}

- **[[103.08]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-103.08
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The provisions set out in column I
  of Schedule II to this Subpart are hereby designated as provisions the
  contravention of which may be dealt with under, and in accordance with
  the procedure set out in, sections 7.7 to 8.2 of the Act.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The amounts set out in column II of Schedule II to
  this Subpart are the maximum amounts payable in respect of a
  contravention of the designated provisions set out in column I.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} A notice issued to a person by the Minister under
  subsection 7.7(1) of the Act shall specify

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the particulars of the alleged contravention;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that the person on or to whom the notice is served
    or sent has the option of paying the amount specified in the notice
    or filing a request for a review with the Tribunal of the alleged
    contravention or the amount of the penalty;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} that payment of the amount specified in the notice
    will be accepted by the Minister in satisfaction of the amount of
    the penalty for the alleged contravention and that no further
    proceedings under Part I of the Act will be taken against the person
    on or to whom the notice in respect of that contravention is served
    or sent;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} that, if the person on or to whom the notice is
    served or sent files a request for a review with the Tribunal, that
    person will be provided with an opportunity consistent with
    procedural fairness and natural justice to present evidence before
    the Tribunal and make representations in relation to the alleged
    contravention; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} that, if the person on or to whom the notice is
    served or sent fails to pay the amount specified in the notice and
    fails to file a request for a review with the Tribunal within the
    prescribed period, that person will be deemed to have committed the
    contravention set out in the notice.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2004-131, s. 3
:::

#### [Division V --- Preservation and Return of Evidence or Aircraft]{.HTitleText3} {#h-987898 .Subheading}

##### [Preservation and Return of Evidence]{.HTitleText4} {#h-987899 .Subheading}

**[[103.09]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-103.09 .sectionLabel}** Where the
Minister seizes anything pursuant to paragraph 8.7(1)(c) of the Act, the
Minister shall

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} mark it in a clearly identifiable manner;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} take reasonable care to preserve it until it is
  required to be produced as evidence; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} return it to the person from whom it was seized
  within 90 days after the seizure, where

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} there is no dispute as to who is lawfully entitled
    to possession of the thing seized,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the return is not likely to affect aviation
    safety, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the continued detention of the thing seized is
    not required for the purposes of an investigation, hearing or other
    similar proceeding.

##### [Preservation and Return of Aircraft]{.HTitleText4} {#h-987907 .Subheading}

**[[103.10]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-103.10 .sectionLabel}** Where the
Minister detains an aircraft pursuant to paragraph 8.7(1)(d) of the Act,
the Minister shall

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} take reasonable care to preserve it; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} return it to the person who had custody of it when it
  was detained or to the person who is lawfully entitled to possession
  of it, where the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that the
  aircraft

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} will not be operated, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} is airworthy or will be rendered airworthy prior
    to operation and will not be operated in an unsafe manner.

##### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText4} {#h-987913 .Subheading}

**[[103.11]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-103.11 .sectionLabel}** Nothing in these
Regulations shall be construed as requiring the Minister to make repairs
or modifications to anything seized or detained pursuant to paragraph
8.7(1)(c) or (d) of the Act.

#### [Division VI --- Definition of [[Principal]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}]{.HTitleText3} {#h-987915 .Subheading}

##### [Definition of [[Principal]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}]{.HTitleText4} {#h-987916 .Subheading}

**[[103.12]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-103.12 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes
of paragraphs 6.71(1)(c) and 7.1(1)(c) of the Act,
[[principal]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in respect of an air operator,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} any person who is employed or contracted by the air
    operator on a full- or part-time basis as the operations manager,
    the chief pilot or the person responsible for the maintenance
    control system, or any person who occupies an equivalent position,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any person who exercises control over the air
    operator as an owner, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the accountable executive appointed by the air
    operator under section 106.02;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a private operator,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} any person who is employed or contracted by the
    private operator on a full- or part-time basis as the operations
    manager, maintenance manager or chief pilot, or any person who
    occupies an equivalent position, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any person who exercises control over the private
    operator as an owner;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} in respect of an approved maintenance organization,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} any person who is employed or contracted by the
    approved maintenance organization on a full- or part-time basis as
    the person responsible for maintenance,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any person who exercises control over the approved
    maintenance organization as an owner; and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the accountable executive appointed by the
    approved maintenance organization under section 106.02;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} in respect of an approved training organization,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} any person who is responsible for the quality
    control system, or any person who occupies an equivalent position,
    and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any person who exercises control over the approved
    training organization as an owner;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a flight training unit,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the chief flight instructor,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any person who is employed or contracted by the
    flight training unit on a full- or part-time basis as the person
    responsible for the maintenance control system,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} any person who exercises control over the flight
    training unit as an owner, and

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the accountable executive appointed by the flight
    training unit under section 106.02;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a manufacturer of aeronautical
  products,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} any person who is responsible for the quality
    control system, or any person who occupies an equivalent position,
    and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any person who exercises control over the
    manufacturer as an owner;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a distributor of aeronautical products,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} any person who is responsible for the product
    control system, or any person who occupies an equivalent position,
    and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any person who exercises control over the
    distributor as an owner;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} in respect of an airport,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} any person who is employed or contracted by its
    operator on a full- or part-time basis as the airport manager, or
    any person who occupies an equivalent position,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any person who exercises control over the airport
    as an owner, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the accountable executive appointed by its
    operator under paragraph 106.02(1)(a);

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a provider of air traffic services,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} any person who is employed or contracted by the
    provider of air traffic services on a full- or part-time basis as
    the operations manager, or any person who occupies an equivalent
    position,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any person who exercises control over the provider
    of air traffic services as an owner, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the accountable executive appointed by the
    provider of air traffic services under paragraph 106.02(1)(a); and

- [(j)]{.lawlabel} in respect of an RPAS operator, the accountable
  executive appointed by the RPAS operator under section 106.02.

## [SCHEDULE I]{.scheduleLabel}[(Subsection 103.06(4))]{.OriginatingRef} {#h-987954 .scheduleLabel}
:::

<figure>
<div class="imageGroupcenter">
<img src="/images/SOR-96-433img/SOR-96-433_ef001.png"
alt="Top of form Notice of refusal to issue or amend a Canadian aviation document." />
</div>
</figure>

### [Notice of Refusal to Issue or Amend a Canadian Aviation Document]{.HTitleText1} {#notice-of-refusal-to-issue-or-amend-a-canadian-aviation-document .SchedHeadL1}

Pursuant to section 6.71 of the [Aeronautics Act](/eng/acts/A-2), the
Minister of Transport has decided to refuse to issue or amend the
Canadian aviation document identified below.

  ----------------------------
  Canadian aviation document
  ----------------------------

The grounds for the Minister's decision are set out in Appendix A.

If you wish a review of the Minister's decision by the Transportation
Appeal Tribunal of Canada, you must file a request in writing with the
Tribunal on or before the date that is indicated above. Requests for
review may be filed with the Transportation Appeal Tribunal of Canada,
333 Laurier Avenue West, Room 1201, Ottawa, Ontario K1A 0N5 (tel.: (613)
990-6906).

On receipt of your request, the Tribunal will set a time and place for a
hearing into the Minister's grounds for the decision to refuse to issue
or amend the above-noted Canadian aviation document. You will be
afforded a full opportunity consistent with procedural fairness and
natural justice to present evidence and make representations in relation
to the Minister's grounds before the Tribunal makes its determination.
The Tribunal has prepared a booklet entitled Guide for Applicants, which
you may obtain from the Tribunal.

The particulars set out in this notice are also available in the other
official language from the Transport Canada Regional Office indicated
above.

[For the Minister of Transport]{.FormBlank}

### [Appendix A]{.HTitleText1} {#appendix-a .SchedHeadL1}

- [□]{.lawlabel} Incompetence (par. 6.71(1)(a))

- [□]{.lawlabel} Qualifications or conditions necessary for issuance or
  amendment not met or fulfilled (par. 6.71(1)(b))

- [□]{.lawlabel} Public interest reasons for refusal (par. 6.71(1)(c))

Details of Minister's grounds for the decision indicated above:

- SOR/2004-131, s. 4
- SOR/2015-160, s. 2

### [Subpart 4 --- Charges]{.HTitleText2} {#h-987983 .Subheading}

#### [General]{.HTitleText3} {#h-987984 .Subheading}

##### [Preparatory Actions]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1406398 .Subheading}

**[[104.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-104.01 .sectionLabel}** The charge
imposed for preparatory actions in respect of the issuance, renewal,
amendment or endorsement of a document referred to in column I of
Schedules I to VII to this Subpart is payable, whether or not the
document is issued, renewed, amended or endorsed, and is fixed in
accordance with section 104.02 or calculated in accordance with sections
104.03 and 104.04, as applicable.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-542, s. 1
- [SOR/2023-99, s. 1](#1399343-1406400){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1399343-1406400.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-104.01-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 104.01"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Charges --- Schedules I to IV, VI and VII]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1406401 .Subheading}

**[[104.02]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-104.02 .sectionLabel}** The charge
imposed in respect of the issuance, renewal, amendment or endorsement
or, in the case of a medical certificate, the processing of a document
referred to in column I of Schedules I to IV, VI and VII to this Subpart
is the charge set out in column II.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-542, s. 1
- [SOR/2023-99, s. 1](#1399343-1406403){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1399343-1406403.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-104.02-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 104.02"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Charges --- Schedule V]{.HTitleText4} {#h-987991 .Subheading}

- **[[104.03]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-104.03
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The charge imposed in respect of an
  action or in respect of the issuance, renewal, amendment or
  endorsement of a document referred to in column I of Part I of
  Schedule V to this Subpart is the charge set out in column II.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The charge imposed in respect of an action or in
  respect of the issuance, renewal, amendment or endorsement of a
  document referred to in column I of Part II of Schedule V to this
  Subpart is the amount calculated on the basis of \$105 for each hour
  spent by an employee of the Department of Transport on the processing
  of the application, to a maximum number of hours as set out in column
  II.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The charge imposed in respect of an action or in
  respect of the issuance, renewal, amendment or endorsement of a
  document referred to in column I of Part III of Schedule V to this
  Subpart is the amount determined by adding

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the charge set out in column II; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the total duty time spent by the employees of
    the Department of Transport assigned to the processing of the
    application exceeds 300 hours, the charge calculated on the basis of
    \$105 for each additional hour spent by an employee of the
    Department of Transport on the processing of the application, to a
    maximum number of hours as set out in column III.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsections (2) and (3), the
  maximum numbers of hours set out in column II of Part II or in column
  III of Part III of Schedule V, as applicable, is calculated for the
  period beginning on April 1 of one year and ending on March 31 of the
  next year.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-542, s. 1
- [SOR/2023-99, s. 1](#1399343-1406412){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1399343-1406412.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-104.03-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 104.03"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Processing of Applications --- Additional Charges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-987997 .Subheading}

- **[[104.04]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-104.04
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} When an employee of the Department
  of Transport must travel within Canada under any of the circumstances
  referred to in subsection (2), or outside of Canada, to perform a
  service related to the processing of an application for the issuance,
  renewal, amendment or endorsement of a document, the following charges
  are payable:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an amount equivalent to overtime expenses, as
    calculated in accordance with the appropriate collective agreement,
    for performing the service or travelling to perform the service when
    the total duty time for the day exceeds the employee's normal duty
    time; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an amount equivalent to the transportation,
    lodging, meal and incidental expenses incurred by the employee, as
    calculated in accordance with the rates set out in the National
    Joint Council Travel Directive.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), a charge is
  payable when an employee of the Department of Transport must travel
  within Canada under any of the following circumstances:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the travel is related to previous travel and is
    undertaken at the request of the applicant or for any reason that
    arises exclusively from the applicant; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} at the request of the applicant, the travel is
    undertaken by an employee of the Department of Transport who would
    not otherwise be available under Department of Transport policy.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If travel arrangements are changed at the request of
  the applicant, the following charges are payable:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an amount equivalent to any increase in the cost of
    the travel arrangements, including cancellation or change fees;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an amount equivalent to overtime expenses incurred
    by an employee of the Department of Transport as a result of the
    change in travel arrangements, as calculated in accordance with the
    appropriate collective agreement, for performing the service or
    travelling to perform the service when the total duty time for the
    day exceeds the employee's normal duty time; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an amount equivalent to the transportation,
    lodging, meal and incidental expenses incurred by the employee as a
    result of the change in travel arrangements, as calculated in
    accordance with the rates set out in the National Joint Council
    Travel Directive.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Hours charged under paragraphs (1)(a) and (3)(b) do
  not count towards the annual maximum number of hours referred to in
  subsections 104.03(2) and (3).

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall provide an estimate of the
  expenses on request by the applicant.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-542, s. 1

#### [Payment]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988005 .Subheading}

**[[104.05]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-104.05 .sectionLabel}** Subject to
section 104.06, a charge imposed under this Subpart is payable in
Canadian dollars at the time the service is commenced.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-542, s. 1
:::

##### [Payment --- 30 Days]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1406428 .Subheading}

**[[104.06]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-104.06 .sectionLabel}** The following
charges are payable in Canadian dollars within 30 days after the date
indicated on each invoice presented by the Minister:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a charge imposed in respect of the processing of
  medical certificates referred to in item 21 of Schedule IV to this
  Subpart;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a charge referred to in subsection 104.03(2) or (3);
  and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a charge referred to in section 104.04.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-542, s. 1
- SOR/2011-284, s. 1
- [SOR/2023-99, s. 2](#1399345-1406433){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1399345-1406433.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-104.06-20120219.html "Link to previous version of section 104.06"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Annual Adjustment]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1527442 .Subheading}

- **[[104.06.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-104.06.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The charges set out in the following
  provisions are to be adjusted in each fiscal year on April 1 by the
  percentage change over 12 months in the April All-items Consumer Price
  Index for Canada, as published by Statistics Canada under the
  [Statistics Act](/eng/acts/S-19), for the previous fiscal year:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} paragraph 3(d) of Schedule II to this Subpart;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} items 26 to 31 of Schedule IV to this Subpart;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} item 16 of Schedule VI to this Subpart; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} item 19 of Schedule VII to this Subpart.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A charge is not adjusted by operation of
  subsection (1) in a fiscal year if the percentage change described in
  that subsection for that fiscal year is less than 1%.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If subsection (2) applies with respect to a fiscal
  year, the percentage change is carried forward to the subsequent
  fiscal year. If the combined percentage change is less than 1%, the
  charge is not adjusted for that subsequent fiscal year and the
  combined percentage change is carried forward to the next subsequent
  fiscal year.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 21](#1516859-1527452){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516859-1527452.html"}
:::

##### [Transitional Provisions]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988015 .Subheading}

- **[[104.07]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-104.07
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In the case of a service that was
  commenced but not completed before June 21, 2023, the charge imposed
  as of June 21, 2023 is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in respect of an action or in respect of the
    issuance, renewal, amendment or endorsement of a document referred
    to in column I of Part I of Schedule V to this Subpart, the amount
    payable under section 104.04;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of an action or in respect of the
    issuance, renewal, amendment or endorsement of a document referred
    to in column I of Part II of Schedule V to this Subpart, the amount
    payable under subsection 104.03(2) -- where, for the purposes of
    calculating the total number of hours spent on the processing of the
    application, the number of hours spent is reset to zero as of June
    21, 2023 -- in addition to any amount payable under section 104.04;
    and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in respect of an action or in respect of the
    issuance, renewal, amendment or endorsement of a document referred
    to in column I of Part III of Schedule V to this Subpart, the amount
    payable under paragraph 104.03(3)(b) -- where, for the purposes of
    calculating the total number of hours spent on the processing of the
    application, the number of hours spent is reset to zero as of June
    21, 2023 -- in addition to any amount payable under section 104.04.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty, the charge imposed under
  subsection (1) is in addition to the charges payable under these
  Regulations as they read immediately before June 21, 2023.

::: HistoricalNote

### [Subpart 5 --- Aerial Sightseeing Flights]{.HTitleText2} {#h-988095 .Subheading}

- **[[105.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-105.01
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In this section, [[aerial
  sightseeing flight]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a flight carried out as
  part of a sightseeing operation or any other commercial flight in an
  aircraft conducted for the purpose of sightseeing from the air.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall conduct an aerial sightseeing flight,
  or any portion of an aerial sightseeing flight, in the control zone of
  the Québec/Jean Lesage International Airport unless the flight
  commences at that airport.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/98-20, s. 1
:::

### [Subpart 6 --- Accountable Executive]{.HTitleText2} {#h-988101 .Subheading}

#### [Application]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988102 .Subheading}

**[[106.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-106.01 .sectionLabel}** This Subpart
applies in respect of the following certificates:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} an airport certificate issued under section 302.03;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a flight training unit operator certificate issued
  under section 406.11;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a manufacturer certificate issued under section
  561.03;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} an approved maintenance organization (AMO)
  certificate issued under section 573.02;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} an air operator certificate issued under section
  702.07, 703.07, 704.07 or 705.07;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} an ATS operations certificate issued under section
  801.05; and

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} an RPAS operator certificate issued under section
  901.214.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-173, s. 8
- SOR/2005-348, s. 3
- SOR/2007-290, s. 4
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 34](#1516888-1527476){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516888-1527476.html"}
- [SOR/2025-98, s. 3](#1522524-1524936){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1522524-1524936.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-106.01-20250327.html "Link to previous version of section 106.01"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Appointment and Acceptance]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988112 .Subheading}

- **[[106.02]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-106.02
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The applicant for, or the holder of,
  a certificate referred to in section 106.01 shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} appoint an individual as accountable executive to
    be responsible for operations or activities authorized under the
    certificate and accountable on their behalf for meeting the
    requirements of these Regulations;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} notify the Minister of the name of the person
    appointed; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} ensure that the accountable executive submits to
    the Minister a signed statement that they accept the
    responsibilities of their position within 30 days after their
    appointment.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall be appointed under subsection (1)
  unless they have control of the financial and human resources that are
  necessary for the activities and operations authorized under the
  certificate.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-173, s. 8
:::

#### [Accountability]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988121 .Subheading}

**[[106.03]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-106.03 .sectionLabel}** The
responsibility and accountability of the accountable executive appointed
under subsection 106.02(1) are not affected by the existence of

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a person responsible for the maintenance control
  system appointed under paragraph 406.19(1)(a) or 706.03(1)(a);

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a person responsible for maintenance appointed under
  paragraph 573.03(1)(a) or a person responsible for RPAS maintenance
  appointed under subsection 901.220(1);

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} an operations manager referred to in section 702.07,
  703.07, 704.07 or 705.07; or

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} a maintenance manager referred to in section 702.07,
  703.07, 704.07 or 705.07.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-173, s. 8
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 35](#1516890-1527478){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516890-1527478.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-106.03-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 106.03"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [More Than One Certificate]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988129 .Subheading}

**[[106.04]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-106.04 .sectionLabel}** If a certificate
holder is the holder of more than one certificate referred to in section
106.01, only one accountable executive shall be appointed under
paragraph 106.02(1)(a) to be responsible for the operations or
activities authorized under the certificates.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-173, s. 8
- SOR/2007-290, s. 5(F)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-106.04-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 106.04"){.PITLink}
:::

### [Subpart 7 -- Safety Management System Requirements]{.HTitleText2} {#h-988133 .Subheading}

#### [Application]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988134 .Subheading}

- **[[107.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-107.01
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} This Subpart, except paragraph
  107.03(g), applies to an applicant for, or a holder of, one of the
  following certificates:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an approved maintenance organization (AMO)
    certificate issued under section 573.02 authorizing the holder to
    perform maintenance on an aircraft operated under Subpart 5 of Part
    VII; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an air operator certificate issued under section
    705.07.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} This Subpart applies to an applicant for, or a holder
  of, one of the following certificates:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an airport certificate issued under section 302.03;
    and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an ATS operations certificate issued under section
    801.08.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} This Subpart, except sections 107.02 and 107.03, and
  the requirements set out in Subpart 4 of Part VI in respect of the
  safety management system apply to the holder of a private operator
  registration document.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-173, s. 8
- SOR/2007-290, s. 6
- SOR/2014-131, s. 4
- [SOR/2025-98, s. 4](#1522526-1524938){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1522526-1524938.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-107.01-20140529.html "Link to previous version of section 107.01"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Establishing a Safety Management System]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988145 .Subheading}

**[[107.02]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-107.02 .sectionLabel}** The applicant
for, or the holder of, a certificate referred to in subsections
107.01(1) or (2) shall establish and maintain a safety management
system.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-173, s. 8
- SOR/2014-131, s. 5
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-107.02-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 107.02"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Safety Management System]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988149 .Subheading}

**[[107.03]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-107.03 .sectionLabel}** A safety
management system shall include

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a safety policy on which the system is based;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a process for setting goals for the improvement of
  aviation safety and for measuring the attainment of those goals;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a process for identifying hazards to aviation safety
  and for evaluating and managing the associated risks;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} a process for ensuring that personnel are trained and
  competent to perform their duties;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} a process for the internal reporting and analyzing of
  hazards, incidents and accidents and for taking corrective actions to
  prevent their recurrence;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} a document containing all safety management system
  processes and a process for making personnel aware of their
  responsibilities with respect to them;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} a quality assurance program;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} a process for conducting periodic reviews or audits
  of the safety management system and reviews or audits, for cause, of
  the safety management system; and

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} any additional requirements for the safety management
  system that are prescribed under these Regulations.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-173, s. 8
- SOR/2007-290, s. 7
- [SOR/2019-119, s. 4(F)](#1126688-1144125){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1126688-1144125.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-107.03-20080101.html "Link to previous version of section 107.03"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Size]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988162 .Subheading}

**[[107.04]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-107.04 .sectionLabel}** A safety
management system shall be adapted to the size, nature and complexity of
the operations, activities, hazards and risks associated with the
operations of the holder of a document referred to in section 107.01.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-173, s. 8
- SOR/2014-131, s. 6
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-107.04-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 107.04"){.PITLink}
:::

### [Subpart 8 --- \[Reserved\]]{.HTitleText2} {#h-988166 .Subheading}

### [Subpart 9 --- Aircraft under an Agreement for Transfer of Functions and Duties in Accordance with Article 83 *bis* of the Convention]{.HTitleText2} {#h-988167 .Subheading}

#### [Canada as the State of the Operator]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988168 .Subheading}

**[[109.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-109.01 .sectionLabel}** These Regulations
apply to a foreign-registered aircraft operated by a Canadian operator
and to persons performing any functions or duties in respect of the
aircraft if the requirements set out in these Regulations are
specifically included under the terms of an agreement in force between
Canada and another contracting State in accordance with Article 83 *bis*
of the Convention.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-354, s. 2
:::

#### [Canada as the State of Registry]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988172 .Subheading}

**[[109.02]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-109.02 .sectionLabel}** These Regulations
do not apply to a Canadian aircraft operated by a foreign operator or to
persons performing any functions or duties in respect of the aircraft if
the requirements set out in these Regulations are specifically excluded
under the terms of an agreement in force between Canada and another
contracting State in accordance with Article 83 *bis* of the Convention.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-354, s. 2
:::

#### [Surrender of Certificate of Airworthiness]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988176 .Subheading}

- **[[109.03]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-109.03
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If the responsibility set out in
  Article 31 of the Convention to issue or to render valid a certificate
  of airworthiness for a Canadian aircraft is transferred to another
  contracting State in accordance with Article 83 *bis* of the
  Convention, the certificate of airworthiness for that aircraft shall
  cease to have effect upon commencement of the transfer.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The registered owner of the aircraft shall surrender
  the certificate of airworthiness to the Minister within seven days
  after the day on which the registered owner receives a notice from the
  Minister informing the registered owner of the coming into force of an
  agreement entered into in accordance with Article 83 *bis* of the
  Convention.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-354, s. 2
- SOR/2014-286, s. 1
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-109.03-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 109.03"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Reinstatement of the Certificate of Airworthiness]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988182 .Subheading}

**[[109.04]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-109.04 .sectionLabel}** Upon termination
of a transfer to another contracting State, in accordance with Article
83 *bis* of the Convention, of the responsibility to issue or to render
valid a certificate of airworthiness for a Canadian aircraft as set out
in Article 31 of the Convention, the Minister shall reinstate the
certificate of airworthiness if the registered owner of the aircraft
complies with the applicable importation requirements specified in
section 507.07.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-354, s. 2
:::

#### [Notice of Termination of Agreement]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988186 .Subheading}

**[[109.05]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-109.05 .sectionLabel}** If an agreement
for the lease, charter or interchange of an aircraft or any similar
arrangement, subject to an agreement in accordance with Article 83 *bis*
of the Convention, is terminated on a date earlier than the date of
expiration set out in the agreement or arrangement, the Canadian
operator of the aircraft if it is a foreign-registered aircraft or the
registered owner of the aircraft if it is a Canadian aircraft shall
inform the Minister in writing of the actual date of termination within
seven days of its occurrence.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-354, s. 2
:::

#### [Third Party Operation in Canada]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988190 .Subheading}

**[[109.06]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-109.06 .sectionLabel}** If an aircraft
that is subject to an agreement for the lease, charter or interchange of
an aircraft or any similar arrangement is also subject to an agreement
in accordance with Article 83 *bis* of the Convention to which Canada is
not a party and is operated in Canada, any references in these
Regulations to the "State of registry" with respect to the transferred
responsibilities shall be interpreted to read "State of the operator".

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-354, s. 2
:::

#### [Conflicting Provisions]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988194 .Subheading}

**[[109.07]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-109.07 .sectionLabel}** If Canada enters
into an agreement in accordance with Article 83 *bis* of the Convention,
the agreement and the provisions of this Subpart shall take precedence
over any conflicting provisions of these Regulations.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-354, s. 2
- SOR/2014-286, s. 2
:::

[Previous
Version](section-109.07-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 109.07"){.PITLink}
:::

## [Part II --- Aircraft Identification and Registration and Operation of a Leased Aircraft by a Non-Registered Owner]{.HTitleText1} {#h-988198 .Part}

### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText2} {#h-988199 .Subheading}

**[[200.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-200.01 .sectionLabel}** In this Part,

[[aircraft identification plate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[aircraft identification plate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    fireproof plate that is attached to an aircraft pursuant to
    subsection 201.01(2) or (3) and that identifies the aircraft as a
    whole; ([plaque d'identification d'aéronef]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[approval number]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[approval number]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a number assigned by
    the Minister to a manufacturer to identify the manufacturer as a
    manufacturer in respect of which a manufacturing approval has been
    granted in accordance with the applicable standards of
    airworthiness; ([numéro d'agrément]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[certificate of registration]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[certificate of registration]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    certificate of registration issued pursuant to section 202.25 and
    includes a certificate of registration issued by a contracting state
    or a foreign state that has an agreement in force with Canada that
    allows an aircraft that is registered in that foreign state to be
    operated in Canada; ([certificat d'immatriculation]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[commercial aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[commercial aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an aircraft that
    is registered as a commercial aircraft pursuant to sections 202.16
    and 202.17; ([aéronef commercial]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[identification plate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[identification plate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a fireproof plate
    that contains the identification information referred to in section
    201.08, subsection 201.09(2), section 201.10 or subsection
    201.11(2); ([plaque d'identification]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[marks]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[marks]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the nationality mark and the
    registration mark of an aircraft; ([marques]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[nationality mark]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[nationality mark]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a symbol, letter or
    numeral, or a combination thereof, used by a state to indicate the
    nationality of aircraft that are registered in that state; ([marque
    de nationalité]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[registered]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[registered]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of an aircraft, means
    registered pursuant to sections 202.16 and 202.17 or pursuant to the
    laws of a foreign state; ([immatriculé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[registration mark]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[registration mark]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the combination of
    letters or letters and numerals that is issued in respect of an
    aircraft by a state as a registration identification; ([marque
    d'immatriculation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[replica of a military aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[replica of a military aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
    aircraft of any scale that is a duplicate of an original military
    aircraft; ([réplique d'un aéronef militaire]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[special registration mark]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[special registration mark]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a specific
    registration mark requested by the applicant; ([marque
    d'immatriculation spéciale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[state aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[state aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an aircraft that is
    registered as a state aircraft pursuant to sections 202.16 and
    202.17; ([aéronef d'État]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[vintage aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[vintage aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an aircraft that was
    manufactured prior to January 1, 1957. ([aéronef
    d'époque]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2009-280, s. 18
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-200.01-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 200.01"){.PITLink}
:::

### [Application]{.HTitleText2} {#h-988216 .Subheading}

- **[[200.02]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-200.02
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), this Part
  applies in respect of all Canadian aircraft, other than remotely
  piloted aircraft, operated in or outside Canada and section 202.01
  also applies in respect of aircraft, other than remotely piloted
  aircraft, registered in a foreign state while operated in Canada.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subpart 1 does not apply in respect of aircraft that,
  pursuant to subsection 202.13(1), are not required to be registered.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 9](#1045391-1110456){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045391-1110456.html"}
:::
