[Previous
Version](section-200.02-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 200.02"){.PITLink}
:::

**\[200.03 and 200.04 reserved\]**

### [Subpart 1 --- Identification of Aircraft and Other Aeronautical Products]{.HTitleText2} {#h-988221 .Subheading}

#### [Aircraft Identification Plates]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988222 .Subheading}

- **[[201.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-201.01
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Except for an aircraft that is
  operated pursuant to an authorization issued under subsection
  202.14(1), no person shall operate an aircraft in flight unless there
  is an aircraft identification plate attached to the aircraft in
  accordance with this Subpart.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (3), where a person
  manufactures an aircraft or is an aircraft owner that obtains an
  authorization referred to in subsection (6), the manufacturer or
  aircraft owner, as the case may be, shall attach to the aircraft an
  aircraft identification plate that contains the information required
  by subsection (4)

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an aircraft other than an
    ultra-light aeroplane or a balloon, to the structure of the aircraft
    in a place where it is visible to a person on the ground or to a
    person at the main entrance or rearmost entrance door;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an ultra-light aeroplane, in a
    position near the pilot seat where it is readily visible; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a balloon, to the lower or upper
    girdle of the envelope in a place where it is readily visible prior
    to inflation.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where the configuration of an aircraft precludes the
  attachment of an aircraft identification plate in a location specified
  in subsection (2), the Minister shall, on application in writing by
  the manufacturer or owner of the aircraft, authorize an alternative
  location for the attachment of the aircraft identification plate.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} An aircraft identification plate attached to an
  aircraft shall have the following information permanently etched,
  engraved or stamped on it, namely,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the legal name of the manufacturer at the time of
    the manufacture of the aircraft;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the model designation identified in the type
    certificate or equivalent document;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the type certificate number or equivalent
    designation, if applicable; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the aircraft serial number.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Where an aircraft does not have an aircraft
  identification plate, the owner of the aircraft shall submit an
  application in writing to the Minister, including evidence that
  establishes the identity of the aircraft, for authorization to attach
  an aircraft identification plate to the aircraft.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of an application submitted in accordance
  with subsection (5) that includes evidence that establishes the
  identity of the aircraft, the Minister shall issue a written
  authorization to the owner that permits the owner to attach an
  aircraft identification plate to the aircraft.

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} Where an authorization is issued by the Minister
  pursuant to subsection (6), the owner of the aircraft shall attach an
  aircraft identification plate to the aircraft in accordance with
  subsection (2) or (3), as applicable.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2000-405, s. 2
- SOR/2003-271, s. 2
- [SOR/2022-246, s. 4](#1380114-1380740){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1380114-1380740.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-201.01-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 201.01"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Modifications]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988240 .Subheading}

**[[201.02]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-201.02 .sectionLabel}** Where a person
modifies an aircraft in accordance with approved data, as that term is
defined in section 571.06 of the Airworthiness Manual, and the
modification results in a change in the model designation as specified
by the manufacturer in the approved data, the person shall, before the
next flight of the aircraft, attach to the aircraft, as near as possible
to the original aircraft identification plate, an additional aircraft
identification plate on which the following information is permanently
etched, engraved or stamped:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name of the person who performed the modification
  and, if that person is an entity, its legal name;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the new model designation described in the
  supplemental type certificate or equivalent document;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the supplemental type certificate number or
  equivalent designation; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the aircraft serial number.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2000-405, s. 3
:::

#### [Removal, Replacement and Attachment of, and Alteration of Information on, Aircraft Identification Plates]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988248 .Subheading}

- **[[201.03]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-201.03
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (5), no person
  shall, without authorization from the Minister pursuant to subsection
  (3),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} remove or replace an aircraft identification plate;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} attach to an aircraft an aircraft identification
    plate that was attached to another aircraft; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} alter the information on an aircraft identification
    plate.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where the owner of an aircraft wishes to perform one
  of the actions referred to in subsection (1), the owner shall submit
  an application in writing to the Minister, including evidence that
  establishes the identity of the aircraft, for authorization to perform
  that action.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of an application submitted pursuant to
  subsection (2) that includes evidence that establishes the identity of
  the aircraft, the Minister shall issue a written authorization to the
  owner of the aircraft that permits the owner to perform the action in
  respect of which the authorization was sought.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Where an authorization is issued by the Minister
  pursuant to subsection (3), the owner of the aircraft shall perform
  the authorized action before the next flight of the aircraft.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} A person may, without authorization from the
  Minister, remove an aircraft identification plate from an aircraft for
  the purpose of performing work on the aircraft.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} Any person who removes an aircraft identification
  plate from an aircraft for the purpose of performing work on the
  aircraft shall, immediately after completing the work, re-attach the
  aircraft identification plate in accordance with subsection 201.01(2)
  or (3) or section 201.02, as applicable.

#### [Loss or Theft of or Damage to an Aircraft Identification Plate]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988259 .Subheading}

- **[[201.04]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-201.04
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where an aircraft identification
  plate is lost, stolen or damaged, the owner of the aircraft shall
  submit an application in writing to the Minister, including evidence
  that establishes the identity of the aircraft, for authorization to
  attach a replacement aircraft identification plate to the aircraft.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of an application submitted pursuant to
  subsection (1) that includes evidence that establishes the identity of
  the aircraft, the Minister shall issue a written authorization to the
  owner of the aircraft that permits the owner to replace the lost,
  stolen or damaged aircraft identification plate.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where an authorization is issued by the Minister
  pursuant to subsection (2), the owner of the aircraft shall, before
  the next flight of the aircraft, attach the replacement aircraft
  identification plate to the aircraft in accordance with subsection
  201.01(2) or (3) or section 201.02, as applicable.

#### [Identification of Engines, Propellers, Life-limited Components, Appliances, Parts, Balloon Baskets and Burner Assemblies]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988264 .Subheading}

- **[[201.05]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-201.05
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall operate an aircraft
  in flight unless each engine, propeller, life-limited component,
  appliance, part, balloon basket, or burner assembly for a balloon is
  identified in accordance with sections 201.06 to 201.11.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections 201.10(4) and (5), the
  identification information required under sections 201.08 to 201.11
  shall be permanently etched, engraved or stamped directly on the
  aeronautical product or on an identification plate securely attached
  to it.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2009-280, s. 19
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-201.05-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 201.05"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Engine Identification]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988270 .Subheading}

- **[[201.06]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-201.06
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The manufacturer of an aircraft
  engine or an aircraft engine module shall place thereon, in accordance
  with subsections (2) and 201.05(2), the identification information
  required by section 201.08.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Identification information or an identification plate
  that contains such information shall be placed on an aircraft engine
  or on an aircraft engine module in an accessible location where it is
  not likely to become damaged, destroyed, lost or detached during
  normal operation or in an accident.

#### [Propeller Identification]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988274 .Subheading}

- **[[201.07]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-201.07
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The manufacturer of a fixed pitch
  propeller, a propeller blade or a propeller hub shall place thereon,
  in accordance with subsections (2) and 201.05(2), the identification
  information required by section 201.08.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Identification information or an identification plate
  that contains such information shall be placed on a fixed pitch
  propeller, a propeller blade or a propeller hub in an accessible
  location where it is not likely to become damaged, destroyed, lost or
  detached during normal operation or in an accident.

#### [Information Relating to Aircraft Engines and Propellers]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988278 .Subheading}

**[[201.08]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-201.08 .sectionLabel}** The
identification information that shall be placed on an aircraft engine,
aircraft engine module, fixed pitch propeller, propeller blade and
propeller hub is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name of the manufacturer and, if the manufacturer
  is an entity, its legal name;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturer's model designation as described in
  the type certificate or equivalent document;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the type certificate number or equivalent
  designation;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the aeronautical product serial number; and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an aircraft engine, the power rating
  established for the engine by the manufacturer.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2000-405, s. 4
:::

#### [Life-limited Component Identification]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988287 .Subheading}

- **[[201.09]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-201.09
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The manufacturer of a component for
  which a life limitation has been established by type design shall
  place thereon, in accordance with subsection 201.05(2), the
  identification information referred to in subsection (2).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The identification information that shall be placed
  on a component is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the part number of the component or an equivalent
    series of identifying characters; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the serial number of the component or an equivalent
    series of identifying characters.

#### [Appliance and Part Identification]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988293 .Subheading}

- **[[201.10]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-201.10
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (4) and (5),
  the manufacturer of an appliance or a part --- including a part
  approved through the issuance of a part design approval --- shall
  place on it, in the manner specified in subsection 201.05(2), the
  following identification information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name, trademark or symbol identifying the
    manufacturer and, if the manufacturer is an entity, its legal name;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturer's approval number; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the part number of the appliance or part.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (4) and (5), the manufacturer
  of an appliance or a part for which a Canadian Technical Standard
  Order (CAN-TSO) design approval has been issued under section 521.109
  shall place on it, in the manner specified in subsection 201.05(2),
  the following additional identification information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturer's address;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name, type or model designation of the
    appliance or part, if any;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the serial number or the date of manufacture of the
    appliance or part;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the letters "CAN-TSO" followed by the applicable
    CAN-TSO number; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} any additional markings required by the applicable
    CAN-TSO.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (4) and (5), the manufacturer
  of an appliance or a part for which a type certificate has been issued
  by the Minister shall place on it, in the manner specified in
  subsection 201.05(2), the following additional identification
  information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturer's address;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name, type or model designation of the
    appliance or part, if any;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the serial number or the date of manufacture of the
    appliance or part; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the type certificate designation or a reference to
    the applicable standard of airworthiness.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} The manufacturer of an auxiliary power unit shall, in
  the manner specified in subsection 201.05(2), place the identification
  information specified in subsection (1) on the unit in an accessible
  location where it is not likely to become damaged, destroyed, lost or
  detached during normal operation or in an accident.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} If an appliance or a part is too small or if it is
  otherwise impractical to place on it some or all of the information
  required by subsection (1), (2) or (3), the information that cannot be
  placed on the appliance or part shall be placed on its container or on
  the authorized release certificate referred to in section 561.10 of
  Standard 561 --- Standard for Approved Manufacturers.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2000-405, s. 5
- SOR/2009-280, s. 20
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-201.10-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 201.10"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Balloon Basket and Burner Assembly Identification]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988314 .Subheading}

- **[[201.11]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-201.11
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The manufacturer of a balloon basket
  or a burner assembly for a balloon shall place thereon, in accordance
  with subsection 201.05(2), the identification information referred to
  in subsection (2).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The identification information that shall be placed
  on a balloon basket and on a burner assembly is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name of the manufacturer and, if the
    manufacturer is an entity, its legal name;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the part number of the basket or the burner
    assembly or an equivalent series of identifying characters; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the serial number of the basket or the burner
    assembly or an equivalent series of identifying characters.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2000-405, s. 6
:::

#### [Removal and Replacement of Identification Plates and Alteration of Identification Information on Aeronautical Products Other Than Aircraft]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988323 .Subheading}

- **[[201.12]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-201.12
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall remove or replace an
  identification plate attached to an aeronautical product that is not
  an aircraft or alter the identification information that is required
  by section 201.06, 201.07, 201.09, 201.10 or 201.11 to be on an
  aeronautical product that is not an aircraft unless a written
  application is submitted to the Minister, including evidence that
  establishes the identity of the aeronautical product, and a written
  authorization is issued by the Minister pursuant to subsection (4).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a person who

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} removes an identification plate from an
    aeronautical product that is not an aircraft for the purpose of
    performing work on the aeronautical product; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} removes or replaces an identification plate or
    alters the identification information on an aeronautical product
    that is not an aircraft if the removal, replacement or alteration is
    made necessary by a modification or repair to the aeronautical
    product that is performed in accordance with section 571.06.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Any person who removes or replaces an identification
  plate or alters any identification information under subsection (2)
  shall, before the aeronautical product is used in flight, replace the
  identification plate or alter the identification information in
  accordance with section 201.06, 201.07, 201.09, 201.10 or 201.11, as
  applicable.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of an application referred to in
  subsection (1) that includes evidence that establishes the identity of
  the aeronautical product, the Minister shall issue a written
  authorization to the applicant that permits the applicant to remove or
  replace an identification plate or alter the identification
  information required to be on the aeronautical product pursuant to
  section 201.06, 201.07, 201.09, 201.10 or 201.11.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Where an authorization is issued by the Minister
  pursuant to subsection (4), the applicant shall, before the
  aeronautical product is used in flight, remove or replace the
  identification plate or alter the identification information required
  to be on the aeronautical product pursuant to section 201.06, 201.07,
  201.09, 201.10 or 201.11.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2009-280, s. 21
:::

### [Subpart 2 --- Aircraft Marking and Registration]{.HTitleText2} {#h-988334 .Subheading}

#### [Division I --- Aircraft Marks]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988335 .Subheading}

##### [Requirements for Marks on Aircraft]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988336 .Subheading}

- **[[202.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.01
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), no person
  shall operate an aircraft in Canada unless its marks are visible and
  are displayed

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a Canadian aircraft, in accordance
    with the requirements of the Aircraft Marking and Registration
    Standards; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an aircraft registered in a foreign
    state, in accordance with the laws of that foreign state.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of an application in writing, the Minister
  shall issue a written authorization permitting the operation in Canada
  of an aircraft that does not display its marks if the aircraft is to
  be operated for the purpose of an exhibition, air show, motion picture
  production or television production.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may specify conditions in the
  authorization governing the operation of an aircraft referred to in
  subsection (2) as are necessary for its safe and proper operation.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} No person shall operate an aircraft pursuant to an
  authorization issued under subsection (2) unless the authorization is
  on board and the aircraft is operated in accordance with any
  conditions specified therein.

##### [Application for Issuance or Reservation of a Registration Mark]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988344 .Subheading}

- **[[202.02]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.02
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall, on receipt of an
  application made in accordance with the Aircraft Marking and
  Registration Standards, issue to or reserve a registration mark or a
  special registration mark for an applicant.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A registration mark or a special registration mark
  issued pursuant to subsection (1) is cancelled if the aircraft is not
  registered in Canada within 12 months after the day on which the
  registration mark was issued.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The reservation of a registration mark or a special
  registration mark pursuant to subsection (1) expires 12 months after
  the day on which the mark was reserved.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} A registration mark or a special registration mark
  that is reserved under subsection (1) may be applied to an aircraft
  that is registered on a foreign register but shall be kept covered
  until the mark is issued to that aircraft.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2000-405, s. 7
:::

##### [Aircraft Marks]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988352 .Subheading}

- **[[202.03]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.03
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), the
  nationality mark in respect of a Canadian aircraft is the letter "C"
  and the registration mark in respect of the aircraft is a combination
  of four letters specified by the Minister.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (3) and (4), where an aircraft
  was registered in Canada before January 1, 1974 or is a vintage
  aircraft,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the nationality mark in respect of the aircraft is
    the letters "CF" and the registration mark in respect of the
    aircraft is a combination of three letters specified by the
    Minister; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the nationality mark in respect of the aircraft is
    the letter "C" and the registration mark in respect of the aircraft
    is a combination of four letters specified by the Minister.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where the owner of an aircraft, other than a vintage
  aircraft, that has the letters "CF" as its nationality mark and a
  combination of three letters as its registration mark repaints the
  aircraft, the owner shall, prior to operating the aircraft, change the
  nationality mark to the letter "C" and the registration mark to the
  letter "F" followed by the combination of three letters.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Where the owner of an aircraft changes its marks
  under subsection (3) or the owner of a vintage aircraft changes its
  nationality mark from "C" to "CF" or from "CF" to "C", followed by the
  appropriate registration mark, the owner shall, before operating the
  aircraft, notify the Minister in writing of the change.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of the notice, the Minister shall change
  the marks accordingly in the Canadian Civil Aircraft Register and
  issue a new registration certificate to reflect the change.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-119, s. 5](#1126690-1144131){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1126690-1144131.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-202.03-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 202.03"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Removal or Change of Marks after Issuance of Continuing Registration]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988360 .Subheading}

- **[[202.04]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.04
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a continuing certificate of
  registration has been issued in respect of an aircraft under paragraph
  202.25(1)(d), no person shall remove the marks that are displayed on
  the aircraft unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the aircraft is permanently withdrawn from service;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the aircraft is being exported from Canada;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the aircraft is undergoing or has undergone a
    transfer of legal custody and control to a person who is not
    qualified to be the registered owner of a Canadian aircraft;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} it is necessary to remove the marks for a
    maintenance operation;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the marks are removed and repainted on the aircraft
    under subsection 202.03(3) or (4);

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the Minister requests that the marks be removed
    under section 202.61;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the Minister requests that the marks be removed
    because they are unseemly or embarrassing;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the Minister authorizes the removal of the marks
    under subsection 202.01(2); or

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the Minister permits the change of the marks under
    subsection (3).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a continuing certificate of registration has been
  issued in respect of an aircraft under paragraph 202.25(1)(d), the
  owner may write to the Minister for permission to change the marks.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of a request to change marks, the Minister
  shall permit the change if the owner continues to meet the
  requirements of these Regulations.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2000-405, s. 8
- SOR/2003-271, s. 3
:::

##### [Variance from the Specifications for Marks for Former Military Aircraft and Replicas]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988376 .Subheading}

- **[[202.05]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.05
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where an aircraft is a former
  military aircraft or a replica of a military aircraft, the Minister
  shall, on receipt of an application in accordance with the Aircraft
  Marking and Registration Standards, authorize an alternative size,
  location or colour for the display of its marks.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where, pursuant to subsection (1), the Minister
  authorizes an alternative size, location or colour for the display of
  the marks of an aircraft, the marks shall be displayed accordingly.

##### [Alternative Mark Size or Location]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988380 .Subheading}

- **[[202.06]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.06
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where the structural configuration
  of an aircraft precludes its marks from being displayed in accordance
  with section 202.01 or 202.07, the Minister shall, on receipt of an
  application in accordance with the Aircraft Marking and Registration
  Standards, authorize an alternative size or one or more alternative
  locations for the display of its marks.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where, pursuant to subsection (1), the Minister
  authorizes an alternative size or one or more alternative locations
  for the display of the marks of an aircraft, the marks shall be
  displayed accordingly.

##### [Use of Marks Assigned to a Manufacturer]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988384 .Subheading}

- **[[202.07]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.07
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where a manufacturer operates an
  aircraft within Canada for the purpose of a production test flight, a
  customer acceptance flight or a flight undertaken to complete the
  manufacturing process or to export the aircraft, in accordance with an
  authorization issued by the Minister pursuant to subsection 202.14(1),
  the manufacturer shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} affix the marks once to each side of the aircraft
    fuselage or cabin by a means, such as paint or decals, that

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} ensures that the marks will not be detached or
      erased while the aircraft is in operation, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} allows the marks to be removed after the
      operation;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} prior to the operation of the aircraft, inform the
    Minister in writing of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the marks that have been affixed to the aircraft,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturer's model designation, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the serial number of the aircraft; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} after the completion of the operation of the
    aircraft for the purpose specified in this subsection,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} remove the marks, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} notify the Minister in writing of their removal.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), the Minister may
  reserve a block of marks for a manufacturer.

**\[202.08 to 202.12 reserved\]**

#### [Division II --- Aircraft Registration]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988399 .Subheading}

##### [Registration of Aircraft --- General]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988400 .Subheading}

- **[[202.13]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.13
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} This section does not apply in
  respect of an aircraft that is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a hang glider; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a parachute.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Except as otherwise authorized under subsection
  202.14(1) or 202.43(1), no person shall operate an aircraft in Canada
  unless it is registered in Canada, in a contracting state or in a
  foreign state that has an agreement in force with Canada that allows
  an aircraft that is registered in that foreign state to be operated in
  Canada.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2000-405, s. 9
- SOR/2003-271, s. 4
:::

##### [Aircraft Manufacturers]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988408 .Subheading}

- **[[202.14]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.14
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of an application in
  writing, the Minister shall issue a written authorization permitting
  the operation in Canada of an aircraft that is not registered and in
  the authorization may specify conditions governing the operation of
  the aircraft as necessary for its safe and proper operation, where

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the aircraft was manufactured in Canada;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the aircraft is operated by the manufacturer;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the aircraft is operated within Canada for the
    purpose of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a production test flight,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a customer acceptance flight, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a flight undertaken to complete the
      manufacturing process or to export the aircraft;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a registration mark has been reserved in respect of
    the aircraft pursuant to subsection 202.02(1);

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the aircraft displays its marks in accordance with
    section 202.01 or 202.07; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturer is qualified to be the registered
    owner of a Canadian aircraft pursuant to section 202.15.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may specify conditions in the
  authorization governing the operation of the aircraft referred to in
  subsection (1) as are necessary for its safe and proper operation.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} No person shall operate an aircraft pursuant to an
  authorization issued under subsection (1) unless the aircraft is
  operated in accordance with any conditions specified in the
  authorization.

##### [Qualifications to Be Registered Owner of a Canadian Aircraft]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988422 .Subheading}

- **[[202.15]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.15
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), any
  Canadian is qualified to be the registered owner of a Canadian
  aircraft.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No individual is qualified to be the registered owner
  of a Canadian aircraft unless the individual is at least 16 years of
  age.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} An entity that is not Canadian but is incorporated or
  formed under the laws of Canada or a province is qualified to be the
  registered owner of a private Canadian aircraft where

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the entity provides the Minister with a certified
    copy of the entity's certificate of incorporation or other
    equivalent document issued under the laws of Canada or a province
    pursuant to which the entity was incorporated or formed;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the entity meets the requirements, specified in the
    Aircraft Marking and Registration Standards, respecting the keeping
    and preservation of records;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the entity meets the reporting requirements
    specified in the Aircraft Marking and Registration Standards; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} while the aircraft is registered in Canada, the
    flight time accumulated in Canada by the aircraft is not less than
    60 per cent of the flight time accumulated by the aircraft at the
    end of each six-month period.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2021-152, s. 1\]]{.Repealed}

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Where an entity that is qualified to be the
  registered owner of an aircraft pursuant to subsection (3) ceases to
  meet the requirements set out in paragraphs (3)(b) to (d), the
  aircraft's certificate of registration is cancelled.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2021-152, s. 1](#1301999-1308380){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1301999-1308380.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-202.15-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 202.15"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Registration Requirements]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988433 .Subheading}

**[[202.16]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.16 .sectionLabel}** The Minister, on
receipt of an application in accordance with the Aircraft Marking and
Registration Standards, shall register an aircraft where the owner of
the aircraft

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} is qualified to be the registered owner of a Canadian
  aircraft pursuant to section 202.15; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} meets the requirements set out in those standards.

##### [Types of Registration]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988437 .Subheading}

- **[[202.17]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.17
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (3) and (4),
  the Minister shall register an aircraft as

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a state aircraft;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a commercial aircraft; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a private aircraft.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall register an aircraft with

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a provisional registration if the aircraft is not
    registered in Canada or in a foreign state and is to be operated for
    the purpose of importing it into Canada or for the purpose of
    transporting it from one location in Canada to another location in
    Canada;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a temporary registration if the documentation,
    record entries and other administrative steps necessary to grant a
    continuing registration cannot be completed immediately;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a continuing registration if the documentation,
    record entries and other administrative steps necessary to grant a
    continuing registration can be completed immediately; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} an interim registration if the requirements of
    subsection 202.36(1) or (4) are satisfied.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall register an aircraft as a state
  aircraft if it is a civil aircraft that is owned by and exclusively
  used in the service of a government in Canada.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall register an aircraft as a
  commercial aircraft if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} it is to be operated under Subpart 2, 3, 4 or 5 of
    Part VII or pursuant to an authorization issued under section
    203.03; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} it is an aeroplane or helicopter that is to be
    operated pursuant to a flight training unit operator certificate
    issued under Subpart 6 of Part IV.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2000-405, s. 10
:::

##### [Identity for Registration Purposes --- Aircraft]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988454 .Subheading}

**[[202.18]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.18 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose
of the registration in Canada of an aircraft, other than a balloon,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the fuselage, hull or an alternative structure of the
  aircraft establishes its identity; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} where the fuselage, hull or an alternative structure
  of the aircraft is scrapped, the aircraft is deemed to be destroyed.

##### [Identity for Registration Purposes --- Balloons]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988458 .Subheading}

**[[202.19]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.19 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose
of the registration in Canada of a balloon,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the envelope of the balloon establishes its identity;
  and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} where the envelope of a balloon is scrapped, the
  balloon is deemed to be destroyed.

**\[202.20 to 202.24 reserved\]**

#### [Division III --- Certificates of Registration]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988463 .Subheading}

##### [Issuance of a Certificate of Registration]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988464 .Subheading}

- **[[202.25]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.25
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where the Minister registers an
  aircraft, the Minister shall issue to the registered owner of the
  aircraft

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a provisional certificate of registration if the
    aircraft has a provisional registration;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a temporary certificate of registration if

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the documentation, record entries and other
      administrative steps necessary to issue a continuing registration
      cannot be completed immediately, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the Minister intends to replace a continuing
      certificate of registration pursuant to section 202.27 or amend or
      replace a certificate of registration pursuant to subsection
      202.28(1), but the documentation, record entries and other
      administrative steps necessary to amend or replace the certificate
      cannot be completed immediately;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an interim certificate of registration if the
    aircraft is deemed to be registered with an interim registration
    pursuant to subsection 202.36(1) or (4); or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} except in the circumstances described in
    subparagraph (b)(ii), a continuing certificate of registration if
    the aircraft has a continuing registration.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where the Minister issues a temporary certificate of
  registration, the Minister may specify in the temporary certificate of
  registration a date on which the temporary registration expires.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} A temporary certificate of registration expires or is
  cancelled, as the case may be, on the earliest of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the date specified in the temporary certificate of
    registration,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the last day of the three-month period following
    the day on which the temporary certificate of registration was
    issued,

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the day on which there is a change in the legal
    custody and control of the aircraft, and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the day on which a continuing certificate of
    registration is issued in respect of the aircraft.

##### [Carrying Certificate of Registration on Board the Aircraft]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988479 .Subheading}

**[[202.26]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.26 .sectionLabel}** No person shall
operate an aircraft in Canada, other than an aircraft referred to in
subsection 202.43(1), or a Canadian aircraft outside Canada unless the
certificate of registration issued in respect of the aircraft is carried
on board the aircraft.

##### [Certificate of Registration Lost or Destroyed]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988481 .Subheading}

**[[202.27]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.27 .sectionLabel}** The Minister
shall replace a lost or destroyed certificate of registration of a
Canadian aircraft on receipt of a written application from the
registered owner where the registered owner continues to meet the
registration requirements referred to in section 202.16.

##### [Amendment or Replacement of Certificate of Registration]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988483 .Subheading}

- **[[202.28]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.28
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may request the return
  of a certificate of registration of a Canadian aircraft from the
  registered owner for the purpose of amending it or for the purpose of
  replacing it.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where the Minister requests the return of a
  certificate of registration pursuant to subsection (1), the registered
  owner shall return it to the Minister within seven days after the day
  on which the request is received.

**\[202.29 to 202.34 reserved\]**

#### [Division IV --- Transfer of Legal Custody and Control]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988488 .Subheading}

##### [General]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988489 .Subheading}

- **[[202.35]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.35
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to Subpart 3, where the
  registered owner of a Canadian aircraft transfers any part of the
  legal custody and control of the aircraft, the certificate of
  registration of the aircraft is cancelled.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where the registered owner of a Canadian aircraft
  transfers any part of the legal custody and control of the aircraft,
  the registered owner shall, by not later than seven days after the
  transfer, notify the Minister of the transfer in writing.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Division, an owner has legal
  custody and control of a Canadian aircraft when the owner has complete
  responsibility for the operation and maintenance of the aircraft.

##### [Interim Registration]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988494 .Subheading}

- **[[202.36]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.36
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), where any
  part of the legal custody and control of a Canadian aircraft is
  transferred and the new owner meets the requirements referred to in
  section 202.16, the aircraft is deemed to be registered with an
  interim registration in the name of the new owner.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where any part of the legal custody and control of an
  aircraft referred to in subsection (1) is transferred for a second
  time, the aircraft is not deemed to be registered with an interim
  registration in the name of the new owner even if the new owner meets
  the requirements referred to in section 202.16.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The interim registration of an aircraft referred to
  in subsection (1) expires on the earliest of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the last day of the three-month period following
    the date of the transfer of any part of the legal custody and
    control of the aircraft,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the day on which there is a further transfer of any
    part of the custody and control of the aircraft, and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the day on which a continuing certificate of
    registration is issued in respect of the aircraft.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Where there is a change in the registered owner's
  name, address or other information contained in the continuing
  certificate of registration, the aircraft is deemed to be registered
  with an interim registration if the requirements specified in the
  Aircraft Marking and Registration Standards are met.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} The interim registration of an aircraft referred to
  in subsection (4) expires on the earliest of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the last day of the three-month period following
    the date of the change or amendment,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the day on which there is a transfer of any part of
    the legal custody and control of the aircraft, and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the day on which a continuing certificate of
    registration is issued in respect of the aircraft.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} An interim certificate of registration may not be
  transferred.

##### [Provisional Registration of an Aircraft]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988508 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2000-405, s. 11

\]
:::

- **[[202.37]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.37
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If an aircraft is not registered in
  Canada or in a foreign state, no person shall operate it for the
  purpose of importing it into Canada or for the purpose of transporting
  it from one location in Canada to another location in Canada unless
  the person first obtains a provisional certificate of registration in
  accordance with the Aircraft Marking and Registration Standards in
  respect of the aircraft.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may specify in a provisional certificate
  of registration conditions governing the operation of the aircraft as
  necessary for its safe and proper operation, and the destination to
  which and the date or dates on which the aircraft may be operated.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} A provisional certificate of registration expires or
  is cancelled, as the case may be, when the aircraft

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} arrives at the destination set out in the
    provisional certificate of registration or, if the provisional
    certificate of registration specifies that a test flight shall be
    performed, when the test flight is completed;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is operated on a date that is not specified in the
    provisional certificate of registration; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} is operated in a manner that is contrary to any
    condition specified in the provisional certificate of registration.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2000-405, s. 12
:::

##### [Exporting an Aircraft]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988520 .Subheading}

**[[202.38]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.38 .sectionLabel}** Where a Canadian
aircraft is sold or leased to a person who is not qualified under
section 202.15 to be the registered owner of a Canadian aircraft and the
aircraft is not in Canada at the time of its sale or lease or it is
understood by the vendor or lessor, as the case may be, that the
aircraft is to be exported, the vendor or lessor shall

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} remove the Canadian marks from the aircraft and, if
  applicable, the aircraft address from the Mode S transponder and from
  the other avionics equipment of the aircraft at the time of the sale
  or lease;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} notify the Minister in writing, within seven days
  after the sale or lease, of the date of

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the sale or lease,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the exportation, if applicable,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the removal of the Canadian marks, and

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the removal of the aircraft address from the Mode
    S transponder and from the other avionics equipment of the aircraft,
    if applicable;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} provide the Minister with a copy of all of the
  agreements that relate to the transfer of any part of the legal
  custody and control of the aircraft resulting from the sale or lease;
  and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} return to the Minister the certificate of
  registration of the aircraft.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2000-405, s. 13
:::

**\[202.39 to 202.41 reserved\]**

#### [Division V --- Operation of Foreign Aircraft]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988533 .Subheading}

##### [Period of Time Present in Canada]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988534 .Subheading}

- **[[202.42]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.42
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section 203.03, no person
  shall operate in Canada an aircraft that is registered in a foreign
  state that has been present in Canada for a total of 90 days or more
  in the immediately preceding twelve-month period unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the foreign state is a contracting state;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the operator of the aircraft is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the foreign state,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} an individual who is not a Canadian citizen or a
      permanent resident but is a citizen or subject of the foreign
      state, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} an entity that is incorporated or otherwise
      formed under the laws of the foreign state; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if the operator of the aircraft is an entity
    described in subparagraph (b)(iii), the aircraft is operated in
    Canada

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in accordance with an air operator certificate,
      or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in any operation other than an operation that
      would require a private operator certificate if the aircraft were
      registered in Canada.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of calculating the 90-day period,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the aircraft is present in Canada for any part
    of a calendar day, that part shall be counted as one day; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an aircraft is deemed to be present in Canada as
    soon as it enters Canadian airspace.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-271, s. 5
:::

##### [Aircraft Registered in a Foreign State]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988550 .Subheading}

- **[[202.43]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.43
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where an aircraft is registered in a
  foreign state that is not a contracting state or is not a state that
  has an agreement in force with Canada that allows an aircraft that is
  registered in that state to be operated in Canada, the Minister may,
  in writing, authorize the operation of the aircraft in Canada, and in
  the authorization may specify conditions governing the operation of
  the aircraft as necessary for its safe and proper operation.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall operate an aircraft pursuant to an
  authorization issued under subsection (1) unless the authorization is
  on board and the aircraft is operated in accordance with any
  conditions specified in the authorization.

**\[202.44 and 202.45 reserved\]**

#### [Division VI --- Aircraft Information]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988555 .Subheading}

##### [Location of an Aircraft]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988556 .Subheading}

- **[[202.46]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.46
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may request that the
  owner of an aircraft inform the Minister, in writing, of the location
  of the aircraft and whether or not the aircraft is serviceable.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where the Minister makes a request pursuant to
  subsection (1), the owner shall comply with the request by not later
  than seven days after receiving it.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where, pursuant to subsection (1), the owner of an
  aircraft informs the Minister that the aircraft is not serviceable,
  the owner shall inform the Minister

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an aircraft that will be returned to
    service, of the place at which and the estimated date on which it
    will be returned to service; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an aircraft that is permanently
    withdrawn from service, of whether or not the aircraft has been or
    will be disposed of and the manner of disposal.

**\[202.47 to 202.50 reserved\]**

#### [Division VII --- Registered Owners]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988564 .Subheading}

##### [Change of Name or Address]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988565 .Subheading}

**[[202.51]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.51 .sectionLabel}** Where the name or
address of a registered owner of a Canadian aircraft changes, the
registered owner shall, by not later than seven days after the change,
notify the Minister in writing of the change.

##### [Loss of Qualification to Be Registered Owner]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988567 .Subheading}

**[[202.52]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.52 .sectionLabel}** Every registered
owner of a Canadian aircraft shall, within seven days after any change
in circumstances as a result of which the owner is no longer qualified
to be the registered owner of the aircraft under section 202.15, notify
the Minister in writing of the change.

**\[202.53 to 202.56 reserved\]**

#### [Division VIII --- Cancellation of Certificate of Registration]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988570 .Subheading}

##### [Conditions Where Certificate of Registration Is Cancelled]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988571 .Subheading}

- **[[202.57]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.57
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In addition to the circumstances set
  out in subsections 202.15(5), 202.35(1), 202.37(3) and 202.58(2) and
  sections 202.59 and 202.60, the certificate of registration of a
  Canadian aircraft is cancelled where

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an individual who is a registered owner of the
    aircraft dies;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an entity that is a registered owner of the
    aircraft is wound up, dissolved or amalgamated with another entity;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the lease termination date specified in the most
    recent lease received by the Minister and submitted in connection
    with an application for the registration of an aircraft referred to
    in section 202.16 is extended and the Minister is not informed of
    that fact in writing within seven days after that lease termination
    date;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a registered owner ceases to be qualified to be a
    registered owner of the aircraft under section 202.15; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} except in the case of an aircraft undergoing
    restoration or an ultra-light aeroplane, the aircraft has not been
    operated in flight during the last five years.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where the document pursuant to which a registered
  owner of an aircraft has legal custody and control of the aircraft
  ceases to be in effect, the certificate of registration of the
  aircraft is cancelled unless the registered owner

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} retains legal custody and control of the aircraft
    after the document ceases to be in effect; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} submits to the Minister, within seven days after
    the day on which the document ceases to be in effect,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} notification of the fact that the document is no
      longer in effect, specifying the day on which it ceased to be in
      effect, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a copy of the new document under which the
      registered owner retains legal custody and control of the
      aircraft.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2000-405, s. 14
:::

##### [Notification Regarding Destroyed or Missing Aircraft]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988586 .Subheading}

- **[[202.58]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.58
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every registered owner of a Canadian
  aircraft shall, within seven days after becoming aware of the fact
  that any of the following events has occurred, notify the Minister in
  writing if the aircraft

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is destroyed;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is permanently withdrawn from use;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} is missing and the search for the aircraft is
    terminated; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} has been missing for 60 days or more.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where an event referred to in subsection (1) has
  occurred, the certificate of registration of the aircraft is
  cancelled.

##### [Ultra-light Aeroplanes]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988594 .Subheading}

- **[[202.59]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.59
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a basic ultra-light aeroplane
  that is registered is no longer a basic ultra-light aeroplane, its
  certificate of registration is cancelled.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If an advanced ultra-light aeroplane that is
  registered is no longer an advanced ultra-light aeroplane, its
  certificate of registration is cancelled.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2000-405, s. 15
:::

##### [Misrepresentation or Fraudulent Documentation]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988600 .Subheading}

**[[202.60]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.60 .sectionLabel}** Where there is
misrepresentation or fraudulent documentation in the application for
registration of a Canadian aircraft, the certificate of registration is
cancelled.

##### [Removal of Marks]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988602 .Subheading}

**[[202.61]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.61 .sectionLabel}** Where the
certificate of registration of a Canadian aircraft expires or is
cancelled, the Minister may request the owner or last registered owner
to remove the Canadian marks from the aircraft and, where the Minister
so requests, the owner or last registered owner, as applicable, shall
remove the Canadian marks within seven days after the day on which the
request is received.

##### [Notification That Marks Are Removed]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988604 .Subheading}

**[[202.62]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.62 .sectionLabel}** No person shall
fraudulently notify the Minister that the Canadian marks on an aircraft
have been removed.

##### [Removal of Name and Address from the Canadian Civil Aircraft Register]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988606 .Subheading}

**[[202.63]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.63 .sectionLabel}** Where a
continuing or temporary certificate of registration issued in respect of
an aircraft expires or is cancelled, the Minister shall remove from the
Canadian Civil Aircraft Register the name and address of the person
under whose name the aircraft was registered.

##### [Removal of Aircraft Particulars from the Canadian Civil Aircraft Register]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988608 .Subheading}

**[[202.64]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.64 .sectionLabel}** If the
certificate of registration of an aircraft is cancelled, the Minister
may remove all the particulars in respect of the aircraft from the
Canadian Civil Aircraft Register if any part of the legal custody and
control of the aircraft is transferred to a person who is not qualified
to be the registered owner of a Canadian aircraft under section 202.15
or if subsection 202.58(1) or section 202.59 applies.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2000-405, s. 16
:::

**\[202.65 to 202.68 reserved\]**

#### [Division IX --- Canadian Civil Aircraft Register]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988613 .Subheading}

##### [Publication of Register]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988614 .Subheading}

- **[[202.69]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.69
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall establish,
  maintain and publish a register of aircraft, to be known as the
  Canadian Civil Aircraft Register, in which there shall be entered, in
  respect of each Canadian aircraft for which a continuing or temporary
  certificate of registration has been issued,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of each registered owner;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the registration mark issued pursuant to section
    202.02; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} such other particulars concerning the aircraft as
    the Minister considers necessary for registration, inspection and
    certification purposes.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may publish information that has been
  entered in the Canadian Civil Aircraft Register in respect of a
  Canadian aircraft.

**\[202.70 to 202.72 reserved\]**

#### [Division X --- Notice to Owners]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988622 .Subheading}

##### [Two or More Persons As Owners]{.HTitleText4} {#h-988623 .Subheading}

**[[202.73]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202.73 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes
of this Subpart, where two or more persons are the registered owners of
a Canadian aircraft, a request, notice or document is duly given to each
registered owner of the aircraft if the request, notice or document is
given to the person who, pursuant to the Aircraft Marking and
Registration Standards, has been identified as the nominee for that
purpose, at the last address for that person recorded in the Canadian
Civil Aircraft Register.

**\[202.74 to 202.77 reserved\]**

### [Subpart 3 --- Operation of a Leased Aircraft by a Non-Registered Owner]{.HTitleText2} {#h-988626 .Subheading}

#### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988627 .Subheading}

**[[203.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-203.01 .sectionLabel}** In this Subpart,

[[Canadian air operator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Canadian air operator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes the holder of
    a flight training unit operator certificate and the holder of a
    private operator registration document; ([exploitant aérien
    canadien]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[lease]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[lease]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an agreement in respect of the
    operation of an aircraft that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} specifies a commencement and a termination date,

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} gives the lessee legal custody and control, and
      the right to exclusive possession and use, of the aircraft during
      its term, and

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} may include provisions respecting the operation
      of the aircraft for hire or reward; ([location]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

[[leasing operation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[leasing operation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the operation of an
    aircraft pursuant to this Subpart; ([utilisation d'aéronefs
    loués]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[operator certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[operator certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes an air
    operator certificate, a flight training unit operator certificate
    and a private operator registration document. ([certificat
    d'exploitation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-120, s. 1
- SOR/2000-405, s. 17
- SOR/2014-131, s. 7
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-203.01-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 203.01"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Application]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988638 .Subheading}

- **[[203.02]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-203.02
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} This Subpart applies to the
  following persons in respect of the operation of a leased aircraft by
  the lessee if the aircraft is registered in the name of the lessor:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian air operator that leases a Canadian
    aircraft from another Canadian air operator;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a foreign air operator that leases a Canadian
    aircraft from a Canadian air operator that is operating under Part
    IV, VI or VII;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian air operator that is operating under
    Part IV, VI or VII and that leases an aircraft registered in a
    foreign state; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a foreign air operator that leases a Canadian
    aircraft from a Canadian aircraft manufacturer.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} This Subpart does not apply in respect of the
  operation of a private aircraft.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-120, s. 1
- SOR/2000-405, s. 18
:::

#### [Leasing Operations --- General]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988648 .Subheading}

- **[[203.03]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-203.03
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person who is not the registered
  owner of an aircraft shall operate the aircraft as part of a leasing
  operation without an authorization issued pursuant to subsection (2)
  unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the lessor and the lessee each hold a Canadian
    operator certificate issued in respect of the aircraft type to be
    operated;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the lessee is qualified to be the registered owner
    of a Canadian aircraft;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the maintenance control system referred to in
    section 406.35 or 706.02 and the maintenance schedule approved by
    the Minister under subsection 605.86(2) are, during the term of the
    lease, equivalent for the lessor and the lessee;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the crew members of the aircraft are employed by
    the lessee; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the registered owner informs the Minister in
    writing, no later than seven days after the term of the lease
    commences, of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the registration mark, manufacturer model
      designation and serial number of the aircraft,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the names, addresses and telephone numbers, and
      facsimile numbers, if any, of the registered owner and the lessee,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the Canadian operator certificate number and
      the approved maintenance organization certificate numbers of the
      lessor and the lessee,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the commencement and termination dates of the
      lease,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} the name of the person who is responsible for the
      maintenance of the aircraft during the term of the lease, and

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} the address of the main maintenance base for the
      aircraft.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section 203.08, the Minister shall, on
  receipt of an application from a Canadian air operator that conforms
  with the Standards Respecting the Operation of a Leased Aircraft by a
  Non-Registered Owner and that includes evidence that establishes that
  the Canadian air operator meets those standards, issue a written
  authorization to the Canadian air operator permitting the operation of
  a Canadian or foreign aircraft by the Canadian air operator, or the
  operation of a Canadian aircraft by a foreign operator, as part of a
  leasing operation, and shall specify in the authorization those
  conditions governing the operation that are necessary to ensure
  aviation safety.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} An authorization issued pursuant to subsection (2)
  expires on the earliest of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the date on which the lease is terminated,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the date specified by the Minister in the
    authorization,

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the date on which the certificate of registration
    of the aircraft is cancelled,

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the date on which the operator certificate is
    suspended or cancelled, and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the date on which there is a change in any of the
    information that was submitted in support of the application
    referred to in subsection (2) and on which the issuance of the
    authorization was based.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Where an authorization is required under
  subsection (1) and has been issued under subsection (2), no person
  shall operate a leased aircraft unless the authorization is carried on
  board.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} If a leasing advisory is provided to the Minister
  under subsection (1), no person shall operate a leased aircraft unless
  a copy of the advisory is carried on board.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-120, s. 1
- SOR/2000-405, s. 19
- SOR/2005-341, s. 3
:::

#### [Leasing Operations --- International]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988673 .Subheading}

- **[[203.04]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-203.04
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall operate a leased
  aircraft if one of the lessor and the lessee of the aircraft is not a
  Canadian, unless the Minister and the civil aviation authority of the
  state of the lessor or the lessee have consented to such operation.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall operate an aircraft under the
  circumstances referred to in subsection (1) in a third state, other
  than Canada and the state of the lessor or the lessee, except in
  accordance with the laws of the third state.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-120, s. 1
:::

#### [Registration of Leased Aircraft]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988679 .Subheading}

**[[203.05]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-203.05 .sectionLabel}** The certificate
of registration of a leased Canadian aircraft operated pursuant to
section 203.03 remains valid despite any change in the legal custody and
control of the aircraft that takes place

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} at the commencement or termination of the lease; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} where the Minister has issued an authorization
  pursuant to subsection 203.03(2), at any other time during the term of
  the lease that is specified in the authorization.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-120, s. 1
- [SOR/2021-152, s. 19(E)](#1302038-1308413){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1302038-1308413.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-203.05-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 203.05"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Forwarding of Airworthiness Directives]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988685 .Subheading}

- **[[203.06]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-203.06
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where an authorization has been
  issued pursuant to subsection 203.03(2) in respect of a Canadian
  aircraft, the registered owner of the aircraft shall, immediately on
  receipt of the authorization, forward to the lessee all airworthiness
  directives that apply to the aircraft.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where an authorization has been issued pursuant to
  subsection 203.03(2) in respect of an aircraft registered in a foreign
  state, the Canadian lessee shall ensure that the aircraft conforms
  with all applicable airworthiness directives.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-120, s. 1
:::

#### [Maximum Number of Leased Aircraft]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988691 .Subheading}

- **[[203.07]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-203.07
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No Canadian air operator shall,
  pursuant to section 203.03, operate a number of leased aircraft
  registered in a foreign state that exceeds 25 per cent of the total
  number of aircraft registered to that Canadian air operator, rounded
  to the next highest whole number.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No Canadian air operator shall, pursuant to section
  203.03, lease to foreign air operators a number of aircraft that
  exceeds 25 per cent of the total number of Canadian aircraft
  registered to that Canadian air operator, rounded to the next highest
  whole number.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-120, s. 1
:::

#### [Limits on Period of Operation under Authorization]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988697 .Subheading}

**[[203.08]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-203.08 .sectionLabel}** No authorization
shall be issued to a Canadian air operator pursuant to subsection
203.03(2) with respect to the operation of an aircraft registered in a
foreign state that would result in

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the Canadian air operator being issued with one or
  more such authorizations in respect of aircraft registered in a
  foreign state for 24 months or more during any period of 30
  consecutive months; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the aircraft being the subject of one or more such
  authorizations issued to a Canadian air operator for 24 months or more
  during any period of 30 consecutive months.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-120, s. 1
:::

#### [Submission of Signed Lease]{.HTitleText3} {#h-988703 .Subheading}

**[[203.09]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-203.09 .sectionLabel}** A Canadian air
operator that has been issued with an authorization by the Minister
pursuant to subsection 203.03(2) shall, within seven days after the day
on which the authorization was issued, submit to the Minister a signed
copy of the lease.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-120, s. 1
:::

## [Part III --- Aerodromes, Airports and Heliports]{.HTitleText1} {#h-988707 .Part}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2007-87, s. 4

\]
:::

### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText2} {#h-988710 .Subheading}

**[[300.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-300.01 .sectionLabel}** In this Part,

[[aerodrome standards and recommended practices publications]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[aerodrome standards and recommended practices
    publications]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the following documents,
    namely,

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} Procedures for the Certification of Aerodromes as
      Airports,

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} Aerodrome Standards and Recommended Practices,
      and

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} Heliport and Helideck Standards and Recommended
      Practices; ([publications sur les normes et pratiques recommandées
      pour les aérodromes]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[aeronautical information publications]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[aeronautical information publications]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
    the following documents:

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} AIP Canada,

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} AIP Canada Supplements,

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} Canada Air Pilot,

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} Restricted Canada Air Pilot,

    - [(e)]{.lawlabel} AIRAC Canada,

    - [(f)]{.lawlabel} VFR Navigation Charts,

    - [(g)]{.lawlabel} VFR Terminal Area Charts,

    - [(h)]{.lawlabel} Canada Flight Supplement,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} Water Aerodrome Supplement,

    - [(j)]{.lawlabel} Enroute Charts -- High and Low Altitude,

    - [(k)]{.lawlabel} ICAO Type A Obstacle Charts, and

    - [(l)]{.lawlabel} Designated Airspace Handbook; ([publications
      d'information aéronautique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[aircraft emergency]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[aircraft emergency]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a situation that
    could result in damage to an aircraft at an airport or aerodrome or
    injury to the persons on board the aircraft; ([aéronef en état
    d'urgence]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[airport certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[airport certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a certificate
    issued pursuant to section 302.03; ([certificat
    d'aéroport]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[airport operations manual]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[airport operations manual]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the manual
    referred to in section 302.08 and includes any amendments to the
    manual that are approved pursuant to subsection 302.03(2); ([manuel
    d'exploitation d'aéroport]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[airside]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[airside]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2003-58, s.
    1\]]{.Repealed}

[[closed marking]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[closed marking]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a cross-shaped marking
    that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} has the form and, subject to subsection
      301.04(4), the dimensions set out in Schedule I to Subpart 1, and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} subject to subsection 301.04(8), is in a single
      contrasting colour, white on runways and yellow on taxiways, that
      is visible from an aircraft flying at an altitude of 300 m (1,000
      feet) above the marking; ([marque de zone fermée]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

[[fixed]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[fixed]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a light, means having a
    constant luminous intensity when the light is observed from a fixed
    point; ([fixe]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[marker]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[marker]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an object displayed above
    ground level for the purpose of indicating an obstacle or
    obstruction or delineating a boundary; ([balise]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[marking]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[marking]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a symbol or group of symbols
    displayed on the surface of a movement area for the purpose of
    conveying aeronautical information; ([marque]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[movement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[movement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of an aircraft, means a
    take-off or landing at an airport or aerodrome;
    ([mouvement]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[obstacle limitation surface]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[obstacle limitation surface]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
    SOR/2011-285, s. 3\]]{.Repealed}

[[operator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[operator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the person in charge of an
    aerodrome, and includes an employee, agent or other authorized
    representative of that person; ([exploitant]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[public way]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[public way]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any road, path or sidewalk
    maintained for the use of members of the public; ([voie
    publique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[RESA]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[RESA]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[runway end safety
    area]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an area, adjacent to or on a runway
    that is intended to reduce the severity of damage to an aeroplane in
    the event that the aeroplane undershoots or overruns the
    runway; ([RESA]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou [aire de sécurité
    d'extrémité de piste]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[Water Aerodrome Supplement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Water Aerodrome Supplement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    publication concerning water aerodromes that is intended to be used
    to supplement enroute charts and the Canada Air Pilot. ([Supplément
    hydroaérodromes]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})
