##### [Issuance and Endorsement of Flight Crew Permits, Licences and Ratings]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990286 .Subheading}

- **[[401.06]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.06
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section 6.71 of the Act,
  the Minister shall, on receipt of an application submitted in the form
  and manner specified in the personnel licensing standards, issue a
  flight crew permit or licence to the applicant or endorse the
  applicant's flight crew permit or licence with a rating if the
  applicant provides documentation to the Minister that establishes

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the applicant's citizenship;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that the applicant meets the applicable
    requirements set out in the personnel licensing standards in respect
    of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} minimum age,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} medical fitness,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} knowledge,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} experience, and

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} skill; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} that the applicant has successfully completed,
    within the applicable period specified in the personnel licensing
    standards preceding the date of application for the permit, licence
    or rating, a flight test in accordance with the personnel licensing
    standards.

- [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} An application shall also include

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a licence or a permit, one
    photograph of the applicant that meets the requirements of
    subsection 421.06(3) of the personnel licensing standards; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a licence, documentation
    establishing that the applicant demonstrated, by means of an
    evaluation, their ability to speak and understand English or French,
    or both, at the operational or expert level in accordance with the
    language proficiency scale set out in the table to subsection
    421.06(4) of the personnel licensing standards.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The certification of additional privileges on a
  permit or licence expires at the end of the period specified on the
  licence or permit or on receipt of a new permit or licence granting
  those privileges, whichever is earlier.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall extend the validity period of a
  flight instructor rating for a period of not more than 90 days
  beginning on the day on which the rating would otherwise expire, if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the application for extension of the rating is made
    while the rating is still valid; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the applicant demonstrates that there has been no
    reasonable opportunity to renew the rating within the 90 days before
    the day on which the rating would otherwise expire.

::: HistoricalNote

##### [Validation of Foreign Licences]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990306 .Subheading}

- **[[401.07]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.07
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section 6.71 of the Act,
  if the holder of a foreign flight crew licence issued by a contracting
  state other than Canada meets the applicable requirements set out in
  the personnel licensing standards and does not reside in Canada, the
  Minister shall, on receipt of an application submitted in the form and
  manner set out in those standards, issue a foreign licence validation
  certificate to the holder of the licence.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall, in accordance with the personnel
  licensing standards, specify in a foreign licence validation
  certificate the privileges that may be exercised by the holder of the
  certificate.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-49, s. 6
- SOR/2008-140, s. 3
:::

:::

##### [Personal Logs]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990312 .Subheading}

- **[[401.08]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.08
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every applicant for, and every
  holder of, a flight crew permit, licence or rating shall maintain a
  personal log in accordance with subsection (2) and with the personnel
  licensing standards for the documentation of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} experience acquired in respect of the issuance of
    the flight crew permit, licence or rating; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} recency.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A personal log that is maintained for the purposes
  referred to in paragraphs (1)(a) and (b) shall contain the holder's
  name and the following information in respect of each flight:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the date of the flight;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the type of aircraft and its registration mark;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the flight crew position in which the holder acted;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the flight conditions with respect to day, night,
    VFR and IFR;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a flight in an aeroplane or
    helicopter, the place of departure and the place of arrival;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a flight in an aeroplane, all of the
    intermediate take-offs and landings;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the flight time;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a flight in a glider, the method of
    launch used for the flight; and

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a flight in a balloon, the method of
    inflation used for the flight.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} No person shall make an entry in a personal log
  unless the person

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is the holder of the log; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} has been authorized to make the entry by the holder
    of the log.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-49, s. 7
:::

##### [Credits towards Requirements for a Flight Crew Permit, Licence or Rating]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990332 .Subheading}

**[[401.09]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.09 .sectionLabel}** The Minister
shall, in accordance with the personnel licensing standards, credit the
flight time acquired by a person in acting as a flight crew member
towards the issuance of the person's flight crew permit or licence or
the endorsement of the person's flight crew licence or permit with a
rating.

**[[401.10]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.10 .sectionLabel}** \[Reserved,
SOR/2014-15, s. 3\]

##### [Airline Transport Licence --- Training Program and Recording of Time]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990335 .Subheading}

- **[[401.11]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.11
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall record in a personal
  log the flight time acquired by a co-pilot while acting as
  pilot-in-command under supervision, unless the flight time

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} was acquired in accordance with an airline
    transport pilot licence training program approved by the Minister
    pursuant to subsection (2) and carried out in accordance with the
    personnel licensing standards; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is recorded in the personal log in accordance with
    the personnel licensing standards.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall approve a training program
  referred to in paragraph (1)(a) if the applicable requirements set out
  in the personnel licensing standards are met.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/98-530, s. 2
:::

##### [Validity of Flight Crew Permits and Licences]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990343 .Subheading}

- **[[401.12]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.12
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A flight crew permit or licence that
  is issued in the form of a booklet label is not valid unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the label is affixed in an aviation document
    booklet;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the booklet number displayed on the label matches
    the number of the booklet; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the booklet is signed by the holder.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The validity period of a flight crew permit or
  licence that is issued in the form of a booklet label starts on the
  day on which it is issued and ends on the expiry date of the aviation
  document booklet in which it is affixed.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The expiry date of an aviation document booklet that
  has a flight crew permit affixed in it but does not have a flight crew
  licence affixed in it is the first day of the 121st month following
  the day on which the booklet was issued.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} The expiry date of an aviation document booklet that
  has a flight crew licence affixed in it is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the first day of the 121st month following the day
    on which the booklet was issued, if the application for the licence
    included documentation establishing that the holder demonstrated an
    expert level ability during their language proficiency evaluation;
    or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the first day of the 121st month following the day
    on which the holder's language proficiency evaluation was conducted,
    if the application for the licence included documentation
    establishing that the holder demonstrated an operational level
    ability during the evaluation.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2021-152, s. 4\]]{.Repealed}

::: HistoricalNote

  ajax-after="1126722-1144187.html"}

:::

#### [Division II --- Testing]{.HTitleText3} {#h-990363 .Subheading}

##### [Examination Prerequisites]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990364 .Subheading}

- **[[401.13]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.13
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Prior to taking a written
  examination, an applicant for a flight crew permit, licence or rating
  shall meet the prerequisites for the examination set out in the
  personnel licensing standards with respect to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} medical fitness;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} identification;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a recommendation from the flight instructor who is
    responsible for the training of the applicant; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} experience.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The applicant for a flight crew permit, licence or
  rating must be sufficiently competent in one of the official languages
  to be able to read the examination questions and to write the answers
  without assistance.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-49, s. 8
:::

##### [Flight Test Prerequisites]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990374 .Subheading}

**[[401.14]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.14 .sectionLabel}** Prior to taking a
flight test, an applicant for a flight crew permit, licence or rating
shall meet the prerequisites for the test set out in the personnel
licensing standards with respect to

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} medical fitness;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} identification;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a recommendation from the flight instructor who is
  responsible for the training of the applicant;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} experience; and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} for applicants for a commercial pilot licence ---
  aeroplane or helicopter, knowledge.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2006-352, s. 7
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-401.14-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 401.14"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Conduct of a Flight Test]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990383 .Subheading}

**[[401.15]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.15 .sectionLabel}** No person shall
conduct a flight test required for the issuance or renewal of a flight
crew permit or licence or for the endorsement of a flight crew permit or
licence with a rating unless

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the person

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} is designated by the Minister to conduct the flight
    test, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} meets the requirements of section 425.21 of
    Standard 425 --- Flight Training; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the flight test is conducted in accordance with

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} Subpart 8, in the case of an aeroplane or
    helicopter, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the personnel licensing standards, in any other
    case.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-49, s. 9
- SOR/2005-319, s. 2
- SOR/2011-284, s. 4
- [SOR/2019-119, s. 47](#1126798-1144339){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1126798-1144339.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-401.15-20120219.html "Link to previous version of section 401.15"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Failure of a Flight Test]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990393 .Subheading}

**[[401.16]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.16 .sectionLabel}** Where an
applicant has failed a flight test, the applicant shall complete the
remedial requirements specified in the personnel licensing standards
prior to being retested.

##### [Failure of a Flight Test for a Rating Renewal]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990395 .Subheading}

- **[[401.17]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.17
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where, during a flight test, the
  holder of a rating fails to meet the requirements specified in the
  personnel licensing standards for the lowest class of that rating, the
  Minister shall suspend the rating.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where, during a flight test for a flight instructor
  rating, the holder of a rating fails to meet the requirements
  specified in the personnel licensing standards for renewal of the
  rating but meets the requirements for a lower class of that rating the
  Minister shall endorse the holder's licence with the lower class of
  that rating.

##### [Examiner's Endorsement of Personal Log --- Gliders and Balloons]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990399 .Subheading}

- **[[401.18]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.18
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where the applicant for a pilot
  licence --- glider successfully completes the flight test required for
  the licence, the flight test examiner shall so endorse the applicant's
  personal log, recording therein the method of launch that was used for
  the flight test and any other information specified in the personnel
  licensing standards.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where the holder of a pilot licence --- glider
  demonstrates, in accordance with the personnel licensing standards,
  additional methods of launch to an instructor who holds a flight
  instructor rating --- glider, the instructor shall so endorse the
  holder's personal log, recording therein the additional methods of
  launch used.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where an applicant for a pilot licence --- balloon
  successfully completes the flight test required for the licence, the
  flight test examiner shall so endorse the applicant's personal log,
  recording therein the method of inflation that was used for the flight
  test and any other information specified in the personnel licensing
  standards.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Where the holder of a pilot licence --- balloon
  demonstrates, in accordance with the personnel licensing standards,
  additional methods of inflation to an instructor who holds a flight
  instructor rating --- balloon, the instructor shall so endorse the
  holder's personal log, recording therein the additional methods of
  inflation used.

#### [Division III --- Student Pilot Permits]{.HTitleText3} {#h-990405 .Subheading}

##### [Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990406 .Subheading}

- **[[401.19]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.19
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The holder of a student pilot permit
  may act as pilot-in-command of an aircraft of the category for which
  the permit is endorsed if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the flight is conducted for the purpose of the
    holder's flight training;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the flight is conducted in Canada;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the flight is conducted under day VFR;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the flight is conducted under the direction and
    supervision of a person qualified to provide training toward the
    permit, licence or rating for which the pilot-in-command experience
    is required; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} no passenger is carried on board.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite paragraph (1)(c), the holder of a student
  pilot permit who is enrolled in an integrated course may act as
  pilot-in-command during a flight that is conducted under day or night
  VFR.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2014-15, s. 4
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-401.19-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 401.19"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Division IV --- Pilot Permits]{.HTitleText3} {#h-990417 .Subheading}

##### [Gyroplanes --- Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990418 .Subheading}

**[[401.20]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.20 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
pilot permit --- gyroplane may, under VFR, act as

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} pilot-in-command of a gyroplane of a type for which
  the permit is endorsed with a rating; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} pilot-in-command or co-pilot of an aircraft for the
  sole purpose of the holder's flight training or flight test where

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of flight training,

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} it is conducted under the direction and
      supervision of a flight instructor qualified in accordance with
      section 425.21 of Standard 425 --- Flight Training, and

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} no passenger is carried on board, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a flight test,

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} it is conducted in accordance with section
      401.15, and

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} no passenger is carried on board.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-49, s. 10
- SOR/2011-284, s. 5
- SOR/2014-15, s. 5
- [SOR/2019-119, s. 47](#1126798-1144341){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1126798-1144341.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-401.20-20140413.html "Link to previous version of section 401.20"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Ultra-light Aeroplanes --- Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990430 .Subheading}

**[[401.21]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.21 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
pilot permit --- ultra-light aeroplane may, under day VFR,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} act as pilot-in-command of an ultra-light aeroplane
  with no other person on board;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} act as pilot-in-command of an ultra-light aeroplane
  with one other person on board if

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the holder's permit is endorsed with a
    passenger-carrying rating,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the ultra-light aeroplane has no restrictions
    against carrying another person, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the holder has completed training, including dual
    instruction and solo flight, on the class of ultra-light aeroplane
    being operated;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} act as pilot-in-command of an ultra-light aeroplane
  with one other person on board if the other person is a holder of a
  pilot licence or permit, other than a student pilot permit, that
  allows them to act as pilot-in-command of an ultra-light aeroplane; or

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} act as pilot-in-command of an aircraft for the sole
  purpose of the holder's flight training or flight test if

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of flight training,

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} it is conducted under the direction and
      supervision of a flight instructor qualified in accordance with
      section 425.21 of Standard 425 --- Flight Training, and

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} no other person is carried on board, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a flight test,

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} it is conducted in accordance with section
      401.15, and

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} no passenger is carried on board.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-49, s. 11
- SOR/2005-319, s. 3
- SOR/2011-284, s. 6
- SOR/2014-15, s. 6
- [SOR/2019-119, s. 47](#1126798-1144343){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1126798-1144343.html"}
:::

[Previous
Version](section-401.21-20140413.html "Link to previous version of section 401.21"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Recreational --- Aeroplanes --- Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990447 .Subheading}

**[[401.22]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.22 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
pilot permit --- recreational --- aeroplane may, under day VFR, act as

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} pilot-in-command of an aeroplane of a class and type
  in respect of which the permit is endorsed with a rating where

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the aeroplane is a single-engined aeroplane that is
    not a high-performance aeroplane,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the aeroplane is designed, or is authorized by a
    type certificate, to carry a maximum of four persons, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} no more than one passenger is carried on board;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} pilot-in-command of an ultra-light aeroplane; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} pilot-in-command or co-pilot of any aircraft for the
  sole purpose of the holder's flight training or flight test where

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of flight training,

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} it is conducted under the direction and
      supervision of a flight instructor qualified in accordance with
      section 425.21 of Standard 425 --- Flight Training, and

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} no passenger is carried on board, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a flight test,

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} it is conducted in accordance with section
      401.15, and

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} no passenger is carried on board.

::: HistoricalNote

- SOR/2011-284, s. 7
- SOR/2014-15, s. 7

##### [Recreational --- Helicopters --- Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990463 .Subheading}

**[[401.23]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.23 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
pilot permit --- recreational --- helicopter may, under day VFR, act as

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} pilot-in-command of a helicopter of a type specified
  in the personnel licensing standards in respect of which the permit is
  endorsed with a rating where

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the helicopter is a single-engined helicopter,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} no more than one passenger is carried on board;
    and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} no external loads are carried; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} pilot-in-command or co-pilot of any aircraft for the

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of flight training,

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} it is conducted under the direction and

      section 425.21 of Standard 425 --- Flight Training, and

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} no passenger is carried on board, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a flight test,

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} it is conducted in accordance with section
      401.15, and

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} no passenger is carried on board.

#### [Division V --- Pilot Licence]{.HTitleText3} {#h-990478 .Subheading}

##### [Gliders --- Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990479 .Subheading}

**[[401.24]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.24 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
pilot licence --- glider may, under day VFR, act as

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} pilot-in-command of a glider in which no passenger is
  carried on board;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} pilot-in-command of a glider in which passengers are
  carried on board where

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the glider is launched by a method of launch
    endorsed by the holder of a flight instructor rating --- glider in
    the holder's personal log pursuant to subsection 401.18(1) or (2),
    and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the method of launch has been used by the holder
    for not less than three previous solo flights; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} pilot-in-command or co-pilot of any aircraft for the
  sole purpose of the holder's flight training or flight test where

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of flight training,

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} it is conducted under the direction and
      supervision of a flight instructor qualified in accordance with
      section 425.21 of Standard 425 --- Flight Training, and

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} no passenger is carried on board, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a flight test,

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} it is conducted in accordance with section
      401.15, and

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} no passenger is carried on board.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-49, s. 14
- SOR/2011-284, s. 9
- SOR/2014-15, s. 9

##### [Balloons --- Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990494 .Subheading}

**[[401.25]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.25 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
pilot licence --- balloon may, under VFR,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} act as pilot-in-command or co-pilot of a balloon that
  is inflated by a method of inflation endorsed by the holder of a
  flight instructor rating --- balloon in the holder's personal log
  pursuant to subsection 401.18(3) or (4) and that is of a type for
  which the licence is endorsed with a rating;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} act as pilot-in-command or co-pilot of any aircraft
  for the sole purpose of the holder's flight training or flight test
  where

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of flight training,

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} it is conducted under the direction and
      supervision of a flight instructor qualified in accordance with
      section 425.21 of Standard 425 --- Flight Training, and

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} no passenger is carried on board, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a flight test,

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} it is conducted in accordance with section
      401.15, and

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} no passenger is carried on board; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} conduct a take-off in a balloon within a built-up
  area of a city or town where the holder complies with section 602.13
  and the applicable requirements set out in the personnel licensing
  standards.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-49, s. 15

- SOR/2014-15, s. 10

  ajax-after="1126798-1144351.html"}
:::

**[[401.26]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.26 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a

      section 425.21 of Standard 425 --- Flight Training, and

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} no passenger is carried on board, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a flight test,

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} it is conducted in accordance with section
      401.15, and

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} no passenger is carried on board.

##### [Aeroplanes and Helicopters --- Reimbursement of Costs Incurred in respect of a Flight]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990533 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2005-320, s. 4(F)

\]
:::

- **[[401.28]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.28
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The holder of a private pilot
  licence shall not act as the pilot-in-command of an aeroplane or
  helicopter for hire or reward unless the conditions set out in
  subsection (2), (3), (4) or (5), as applicable, are met.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The holder of a private pilot licence may receive
  reimbursement for costs incurred in respect of a flight if the holder

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is the owner or operator of the aircraft;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} conducts the flight for purposes other than hire or
    reward;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} carries passengers only incidentally to the
    purposes of the flight; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} receives a reimbursement that

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} is provided only by the passengers referred to in
      paragraph (c), and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} is for the purpose of sharing the costs of fuel,
      oil and fees charged against the aircraft in respect of the
      flight, as applicable.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The holder of a private pilot licence may receive
  reimbursement from the holder's employer for costs incurred in respect
  of a flight if the holder

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is employed on a full-time basis by the employer
    for purposes other than flying;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} conducts the flight on the employer's business and
    the flight is incidental to the execution of the holder's duties;
    and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} receives a reimbursement that

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an aircraft owned by the holder,
      is paid at a rate based on distance travelled or number of hours
      flown and that does not exceed the total of the holder's direct
      operating costs and the fees charged against the aircraft in
      respect of the flight, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a rental aircraft, does not
      exceed the total of the holder's rental costs, direct operating
      costs and the fees charged against the aircraft in respect of the
      flight.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} The holder of a private pilot licence may receive
  reimbursement from a charitable, not-for-profit or public security
  organization in respect of a flight conducted by the holder as a
  volunteer for that organization if the reimbursement

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an aircraft owned by the holder, is
    paid at a rate based on distance travelled or number of hours flown
    and does not exceed the total of the holder's direct operating costs
    and the fees charged against the aircraft in respect of the flight;
    or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a rental aircraft, does not exceed
    the total of the holder's rental costs, direct operating costs and
    the fees charged against the aircraft in respect of the flight.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} The holder of a private pilot licence who is a
  farmer, as defined in section 700.01, may conduct aerial work
  involving the dispersal of products for agricultural purposes for hire
  or reward if the holder

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} does not hold an air operator certificate;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} owns the aircraft that is used to disperse the
    products;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} has at least 150 hours of flight time as
    pilot-in-command, including at least 25 hours of flight time in the
    type of aircraft being used;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} ensures that no more than the minimum number of
    crew members needed to disperse the products is on board the
    aircraft;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} ensures that the dispersal takes place within 25
    miles of the centre of the holder's farm; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} ensures that no dispersal is conducted within a
    control zone without the authority of the appropriate air traffic
    control unit.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-320, s. 4
:::

**\[401.29 reserved\]**

#### [Division VII --- Commercial Pilot Licence]{.HTitleText3} {#h-990564 .Subheading}

##### [Aeroplanes --- Privileges and Requirements]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990565 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2006-352, s. 8

\]
:::

- **[[401.30]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.30
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (3), the
  holder of a commercial pilot licence --- aeroplane may, by day or
  night,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} exercise the privileges of a private pilot licence
    --- aeroplane;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} exercise the privileges of a VFR OTT rating;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} while engaged in providing a commercial air service
    by means of an aeroplane of a class and type in respect of which the
    licence is endorsed with ratings, act as

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} pilot-in-command of the aeroplane, if the minimum
      flight crew document for the aeroplane specifies a minimum flight
      crew of one pilot, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} co-pilot of the aeroplane;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} if qualified as a flight instructor in accordance
    with section 425.21 of Standard 425 --- Flight Training, conduct
    flight instruction; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} exercise private pilot licence --- aeroplane
    privileges until the end of the medical validity period specified
    for the private pilot licence.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where an applicant meets the requirements specified
  in the personnel licensing standards in respect of a commercial pilot
  licence --- aeroplane except the night flight time requirements, the
  Minister shall issue to the applicant a commercial pilot licence ---
  aeroplane endorsed for daylight flying only.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} No holder of a commercial pilot licence --- aeroplane
  whose licence is endorsed with a daylight-flying-only restriction
  shall exercise the privileges set out in paragraphs (1)(a) and (c) by
  night.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall remove the daylight-flying-only
  restriction if an applicant meets the night flight time requirements
  of the personnel licensing standards.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-49, s. 18
- SOR/2003-129, s. 7
- SOR/2005-320, s. 5
- SOR/2006-352, s. 9
- SOR/2011-284, s. 13
- [SOR/2019-119, s. 47](#1126798-1144357){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1126798-1144357.html"}
:::

##### [Helicopters --- Privileges and Requirements]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990582 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2006-352, s. 10

- **[[401.31]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.31
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (3), the
  holder of a commercial pilot licence --- helicopter may, by day or
  night,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} exercise the privileges of a private pilot licence
    --- helicopter;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} while engaged in providing a commercial air service
    by means of a helicopter of a type in respect of which the licence
    is endorsed with ratings, act as

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} pilot-in-command of the helicopter, if the
      minimum flight crew document for the helicopter specifies a

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if qualified as a flight instructor in accordance

    flight instruction; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} exercise private pilot licence --- helicopter

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where an applicant meets the requirements specified
  in the personnel licensing standards for a commercial pilot licence
  --- helicopter except the night flight time requirements, the Minister
  shall issue to the applicant a commercial pilot licence --- helicopter
  endorsed for daylight flying only.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} No holder of a commercial pilot licence ---
  helicopter whose licence is endorsed with a daylight-flying-only
  restriction shall exercise the privileges set out in paragraphs (1)(a)
  and (b) by night.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall remove the daylight-flying-only
  restriction if an applicant meets the night flight time requirements
  of the personnel licensing standards.

#### [Division VII.1 --- Multi-crew Pilot Licence]{.HTitleText3} {#h-990598 .Subheading}

##### [Aeroplanes --- Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990599 .Subheading}

- **[[401.32]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.32
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The holder of a multi-crew pilot
  licence --- aeroplane may act as co-pilot of a turbine-powered
  aeroplane that is operated day or night, under VFR, VFR OTT or IFR, if
  the aeroplane

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is a transport category aircraft;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is an aeroplane for which a minimum flight crew
    document has been issued that specifies a minimum flight crew of two
    pilots;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} is of a type in respect of which the holder's
    licence is endorsed with a rating; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} is operated under subpart 4 of Part VI or under
    Part VII.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The holder of a multi-crew pilot licence ---
  aeroplane may act as pilot-in-command of any aircraft for the purpose
  of the holder's flight training if the flight training is conducted in
  accordance with section 401.19.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2014-15, s. 13
:::

**\[401.33 reserved\]**

#### [Division VIII --- Airline Transport Pilot Licence]{.HTitleText3} {#h-990610 .Subheading}

##### [Aeroplanes --- Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990611 .Subheading}

- **[[401.34]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.34
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), the
  holder of an airline transport pilot licence --- aeroplane may
  exercise the privileges of a private pilot licence --- aeroplane and a
  commercial pilot licence --- aeroplane.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The holder of an airline transport pilot licence ---
  aeroplane endorsed with a Group 1 instrument rating may, while engaged
  in providing a commercial air service by means of an aeroplane of a
  class and type in respect of which the licence is endorsed with a
  rating, act as

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} pilot-in-command of the aeroplane, if the minimum
    flight crew document for that aeroplane specifies a minimum flight
    crew of two pilots; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} co-pilot of the aeroplane.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-49, s. 20
:::

##### [Helicopters --- Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990619 .Subheading}

- **[[401.35]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.35
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The holder of an airline transport
  pilot licence --- helicopter may

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} exercise the privileges of a private pilot licence
    --- helicopter and a commercial pilot licence --- helicopter; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} while engaged in providing a commercial air service
    by means of a helicopter of a type for which the licence is endorsed
    with ratings, act as pilot-in-command or co-pilot of the helicopter.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where an applicant meets the requirements specified
  in the personnel licensing standards for an airline transport pilot
  licence --- helicopter except the night and instrument flight time
  requirements, the Minister shall issue to the applicant an airline
  transport pilot licence --- helicopter restricted to aerial work only.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-320, s. 7
:::

**\[401.36 reserved\]**

#### [Division IX --- Flight Engineer Licence]{.HTitleText3} {#h-990628 .Subheading}

##### [Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990629 .Subheading}

- **[[401.37]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.37
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The holder of a flight engineer
  licence may

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} act as flight engineer in an aircraft of a type for
    which the licence is endorsed with a rating; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} act as flight engineer in any aircraft for the sole
    purpose of the holder's flight training or competency check if

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the flight training is conducted under the
      supervision of a person qualified to give flight engineer
      training, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the competency check is conducted by a person
      qualified to conduct the check.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A holder of a flight engineer licence who supervises
  other holders of flight engineer licences may conduct flight training
  and competency checks in respect of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the issuance of a flight engineer licence;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the endorsement of a flight engineer licence with
    an aircraft type rating;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the endorsement of a commercial pilot licence ---
    aeroplane or an airline transport pilot licence --- aeroplane with a
    second officer rating; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the endorsement of a licence with an aircraft type
    rating for second officer privileges, if the licence has a second
    officer rating.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-320, s. 8
- [SOR/2021-152, s. 20(F)](#1302048-1308436){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1302048-1308436.html"}
:::

#### [Division X --- Aeroplane Class Ratings]{.HTitleText3} {#h-990643 .Subheading}

##### [Rating]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990644 .Subheading}

**[[401.38]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.38 .sectionLabel}** The Minister
shall endorse the following permits and licences with an aeroplane class
rating if the applicant for the rating meets the requirements referred
to in section 401.06:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} private pilot licence --- aeroplane;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} commercial pilot licence --- aeroplane;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} airline transport pilot licence --- aeroplane; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} pilot permit --- recreational --- aeroplane.

##### [Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990650 .Subheading}

**[[401.39]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.39 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
permit or licence that has been endorsed with an aeroplane class rating
may exercise the privileges of the permit or licence in the class of
aeroplane for which the permit or licence is endorsed.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2002-111, s. 1
:::

#### [Division XI --- Aircraft Type Ratings]{.HTitleText3} {#h-990654 .Subheading}

##### [Blanket and Individual Type Ratings]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990655 .Subheading}

**[[401.40]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.40 .sectionLabel}** The Minister
shall endorse the permits and licences specified in the personnel
licensing standards with a blanket aircraft type rating or an individual
type rating if the applicant for the rating meets the requirements
referred to in section 401.06.

##### [Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990657 .Subheading}

**[[401.41]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.41 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
permit or licence that has been endorsed with a blanket aircraft type
rating or an individual type rating may exercise the privileges of the
permit or licence in the blanket aircraft type or individual aircraft
type for which the permit or licence is endorsed.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2002-111, s. 2
:::

#### [Division XII --- Night Rating]{.HTitleText3} {#h-990661 .Subheading}

##### [Rating]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990662 .Subheading}

**[[401.42]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.42 .sectionLabel}** The Minister
shall endorse the following permits and licences with a night rating if
the applicant for the rating meets the requirements referred to in
section 401.06:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} private pilot licence --- aeroplane;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} private pilot licence --- helicopter;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} pilot licence --- balloon; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} pilot permit --- gyroplane.

##### [Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990668 .Subheading}

**[[401.43]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.43 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
permit or licence that has been endorsed with a night rating may
exercise the privileges of the permit or licence by night.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2002-111, s. 3
:::

#### [Division XIII --- VFR Over-the-Top Rating]{.HTitleText3} {#h-990672 .Subheading}

##### [Rating]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990673 .Subheading}

**[[401.44]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.44 .sectionLabel}** The Minister
shall endorse the following licences with a VFR OTT rating if the
applicant for the rating meets the requirements referred to in section
401.06:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} private pilot licence --- aeroplane;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} private pilot licence --- helicopter;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} commercial pilot licence --- helicopter; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} airline transport pilot licence --- helicopter.

##### [Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990679 .Subheading}

**[[401.45]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.45 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
licence that has been endorsed with a VFR OTT rating may exercise the
privileges of the licence in VFR OTT flight in accordance with section
602.116.

#### [Division XIV --- Instrument Rating]{.HTitleText3} {#h-990681 .Subheading}

##### [Rating]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990682 .Subheading}

- **[[401.46]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.46
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall endorse the
  following licences with an instrument rating if the applicant for the
  rating meets the requirements referred to in section 401.06:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} pilot licence --- aeroplane; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} pilot licence --- helicopter.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where the Minister has endorsed a licence with an
  instrument rating, the Minister shall endorse the licence with the
  group of aircraft in respect of which the privileges may be exercised.

##### [Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990688 .Subheading}

**[[401.47]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.47 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
licence endorsed with an instrument rating may exercise

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the privileges of the licence under IFR in accordance
  with Part VI, Subpart 2, Division VII in respect of the group of
  aircraft endorsed on the licence; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the privileges accorded by a VFR OTT rating.

SOR/2019-119, s. 16\]

**[[401.49]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.49 .sectionLabel}** \[Reserved,
SOR/2019-119, s. 16\]

##### [Rating]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990698 .Subheading}

**[[401.52]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.52 .sectionLabel}** The Minister
shall endorse the following licences with a second officer rating if the
applicant for the rating meets the requirements referred to in section
401.06:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} commercial pilot licence --- aeroplane;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} airline transport pilot licence --- aeroplane; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} multi-crew pilot licence --- aeroplane.

##### [Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990705 .Subheading}

- **[[401.53]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.53
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The holder of a second officer
  rating may

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} act as second officer in any aeroplane of a type to
    which the rating applies;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} act as second officer in any aeroplane for the sole
    purpose of the holder's own flight training or competency check if

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the flight training is conducted under the
      supervision of a person qualified to give second officer training,
      or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the competency check is conducted by a person
      qualified to conduct the check; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} act as a flight engineer in an aeroplane of a type
    to which the rating applies.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A holder of a second officer rating who supervises
  other holders of second officer ratings may conduct flight training
  and competency checks in respect of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the endorsement of a commercial pilot licence ---
    aeroplane or an airline transport pilot licence --- aeroplane with a
    second officer rating; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the endorsement of a licence with an aircraft type
    rating for second officer privileges, if the holder holds a second
    officer rating.

#### [Division XVI --- Passenger-Carrying Rating --- Ultra-Light Aeroplane]{.HTitleText3} {#h-990719 .Subheading}

##### [Rating]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990720 .Subheading}

**[[401.55]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.55 .sectionLabel}** The Minister
shall endorse a pilot permit --- ultra-light aeroplane with a
passenger-carrying rating if the applicant for the rating meets the
requirements referred to in section 401.06.

##### [Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990724 .Subheading}

**[[401.56]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.56 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
pilot permit --- ultra-light aeroplane endorsed with a
passenger-carrying rating may carry one other person on board an
ultra-light aeroplane if it has no restrictions against carrying another
person.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-319, s. 4
:::

**\[401.57 to 401.60 reserved\]**

#### [Division XVII --- Flight Instructor Ratings --- Aeroplane and Helicopter]{.HTitleText3} {#h-990729 .Subheading}

##### [Rating]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990730 .Subheading}

- **[[401.61]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.61
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall endorse the
  following licences with a Class 1, 2, 3 or 4 flight instructor rating
  --- aeroplane if the applicant for the rating meets the requirements
  referred to in section 401.06:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} commercial pilot licence --- aeroplane; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} airline transport pilot licence --- aeroplane.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall endorse the following licences
  with a Class 1, 2, 3, or 4 flight instructor rating --- helicopter if
  the applicant for the rating meets the requirements referred to in
  section 401.06:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} commercial pilot licence --- helicopter; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} airline transport pilot licence --- helicopter.

##### [Class 4 Supervision Requirement]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990738 .Subheading}

**[[401.62]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.62 .sectionLabel}** Subject to
paragraph 401.69(e), no holder of a Class 4 flight instructor rating ---
aeroplane or a Class 4 flight instructor rating --- helicopter shall
exercise the privileges accorded by that rating unless the holder

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} is conducting the training in accordance with a
  flight training unit operator certificate; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} is under the supervision of a supervising instructor
  of the flight training unit.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-49, s. 22
:::

##### [Class 1 or 2 --- Supervision of the Holder of a Class 4 Flight Instructor Rating --- Aeroplane and Helicopter]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990744 .Subheading}

- **[[401.63]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.63
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where the holder of a Class 1 or
  Class 2 flight instructor rating --- aeroplane supervises the holder
  of a Class 4 flight instructor rating --- aeroplane, the holder of the
  Class 1 or Class 2 rating shall do so in accordance with the personnel
  licensing standards.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where the holder of a Class 1 or Class 2 flight
  instructor rating --- helicopter supervises the holder of a Class 4
  flight instructor rating --- helicopter, the holder of the Class 1 or
  Class 2 rating shall do so in accordance with the personnel licensing
  standards.

##### [Class 4 --- Record Keeping]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990748 .Subheading}

**[[401.64]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.64 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
Class 4 flight instructor rating --- aeroplane or a Class 4 flight
instructor rating --- helicopter shall, in respect of the trainees under
the supervision of the holder, keep records in accordance with the
personnel licensing standards.

##### [Period of Validity]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990750 .Subheading}

**[[401.65]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.65 .sectionLabel}** A Class 1, 2, 3
or 4 flight instructor rating --- aeroplane, a Class 1 or 2 flight
instructor rating --- aeroplane --- aerobatic or a Class 1, 2, 3 or 4
flight instructor rating --- helicopter is valid for the period
specified on the licence in accordance with the personnel licensing
standards.

##### [Renewal of Flight Instructor Rating]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990752 .Subheading}

**[[401.66]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.66 .sectionLabel}** The Minister
shall renew a flight instructor rating in accordance with the personnel
licensing standards if the holder of the rating continues to meet the
requirements for the endorsement of the rating referred to in section
401.06.

##### [Flight Test Records]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990754 .Subheading}

- **[[401.67]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.67
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall establish,
  maintain and evaluate a flight test record for each holder of a flight
  instructor rating --- aeroplane, flight instructor rating ---
  helicopter or flight instructor rating --- aeroplane --- aerobatic in
  accordance with the personnel licensing standards.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where the evaluation of a flight test record done
  pursuant to subsection (1) indicates that follow-up action is
  required, the Minister shall ensure that the follow-up action is
  carried out in accordance with the personnel licensing standards.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2006-352, s. 12
:::
