#### [Division XVIII --- Flight Instructor Rating --- Aeroplane]{.HTitleText3} {#h-990761 .Subheading}

##### [Class 4 --- Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990762 .Subheading}

**[[401.69]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.69 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
Class 4 flight instructor rating --- aeroplane may

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} conduct dual flight instruction in respect of the
  issuance of a pilot permit --- recreational --- aeroplane or pilot
  licence --- aeroplane or the endorsement of a night rating or a VFR
  OTT rating on a pilot licence --- aeroplane;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} authorize a trainee to conduct a solo flight in an
  aeroplane;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} recommend a trainee for a flight test in respect of
  the issuance of a pilot permit --- recreational --- aeroplane or pilot
  licence --- aeroplane;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} recommend a trainee for the endorsement of a night
  rating or a VFR OTT rating on the trainee's pilot licence ---
  aeroplane; and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} exercise the privileges of a flight instructor rating
  --- ultra-light aeroplane without being under the supervision
  prescribed in paragraph 401.62(b).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-49, s. 23
:::

##### [Class 3 --- Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990771 .Subheading}

**[[401.70]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.70 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
Class 3 flight instructor rating --- aeroplane may

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} exercise the privileges of a Class 4 flight
  instructor rating --- aeroplane; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} act as chief flight instructor of a flight training
  unit where there is no other flight instructor for the flight training
  unit.

##### [Class 2 --- Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990775 .Subheading}

**[[401.71]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.71 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
Class 2 flight instructor rating --- aeroplane may

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} exercise the privileges of a Class 3 flight
  instructor rating --- aeroplane;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} supervise the holder of a Class 4 flight instructor
  rating --- aeroplane; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} act as chief flight instructor of a flight training
  unit.

##### [Class 1 --- Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990780 .Subheading}

**[[401.72]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.72 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
Class 1 flight instructor rating --- aeroplane may

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} exercise the privileges of a Class 2 flight
  instructor rating --- aeroplane; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} conduct ground school instruction and flight training
  in respect of the endorsement of a flight instructor rating ---
  aeroplane.

**\[401.73 to 401.76 reserved\]**

#### [Division XIX --- Flight Instructor Rating --- Helicopter]{.HTitleText3} {#h-990785 .Subheading}

##### [Class 4 --- Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990786 .Subheading}

**[[401.77]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.77 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
Class 4 flight instructor rating --- helicopter may

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} conduct dual flight instruction in respect of the
  issuance of a pilot permit --- recreational --- helicopter or pilot
  licence --- helicopter or the endorsement of a night rating or a VFR
  OTT rating on a pilot licence --- helicopter;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} authorize a trainee to conduct a solo flight in a
  helicopter;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} recommend a trainee for a flight test in respect of
  the issuance of a pilot permit --- recreational --- helicopter or
  pilot licence --- helicopter; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} recommend a trainee for the endorsement of a night
  rating or a VFR OTT rating on the trainee's pilot licence ---
  helicopter.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-49, s. 24
:::

##### [Class 3 --- Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990794 .Subheading}

**[[401.78]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.78 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
Class 3 flight instructor rating --- helicopter may exercise the
privileges of a Class 4 flight instructor rating --- helicopter.

##### [Class 2 --- Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990796 .Subheading}

**[[401.79]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.79 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
Class 2 flight instructor rating --- helicopter may

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} exercise the privileges of a Class 3 flight
  instructor rating --- helicopter;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} supervise the holder of a Class 4 flight instructor
  rating --- helicopter; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} act as chief flight instructor of a flight training
  unit.

##### [Class 1 --- Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990801 .Subheading}

**[[401.80]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.80 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
Class 1 flight instructor rating --- helicopter may

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} exercise the privileges of a Class 2 flight
  instructor rating --- helicopter; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} conduct ground school instruction and flight training
  in respect of the endorsement of a licence with a flight instructor
  rating --- helicopter.

#### [Division XX --- Flight Instructor Ratings --- Glider, Balloon and Gyroplane]{.HTitleText3} {#h-990805 .Subheading}

##### [Rating]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990806 .Subheading}

**[[401.81]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.81 .sectionLabel}** The Minister
shall, as appropriate, endorse the following permits and licences with a
flight instructor rating --- glider, balloon or gyroplane if the
applicant for the rating meets the requirements referred to in section
401.06:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} pilot permit --- gyroplane;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} pilot licence --- glider; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} pilot licence --- balloon.

##### [Gliders --- Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990811 .Subheading}

**[[401.82]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.82 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
flight instructor rating --- glider may

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} conduct dual flight instruction in respect of the
  issuance of a pilot licence --- glider;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} conduct dual flight instruction in respect of the
  endorsement of a type rating on a pilot licence --- glider;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} authorize a trainee to conduct solo flight in a
  glider;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} conduct ground school instruction and flight training
  in respect of the endorsement of a pilot licence --- glider with a
  flight instructor rating --- glider;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} conduct a flight test and recommend a trainee for

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the issuance of a pilot licence --- glider,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the endorsement of a pilot licence --- glider with
    a type rating, or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the endorsement of a pilot licence --- glider
    with a flight instructor rating --- glider;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} certify the competency of the holder of a pilot
  licence --- glider to carry passengers in a glider; and

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} endorse a trainee's personal log in respect of
  methods of launch.

##### [Balloons --- Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990823 .Subheading}

**[[401.83]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.83 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
flight instructor rating --- balloon may

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} authorize a trainee to conduct solo flight in a
  balloon;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} conduct ground school instruction and dual flight
  instruction in respect of the endorsement of a pilot licence ---
  balloon with a flight instructor rating --- balloon;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} conduct a flight test and recommend a trainee for

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the issuance of a pilot licence --- balloon, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the endorsement of a pilot licence --- balloon
    with a flight instructor rating --- balloon;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} recommend a trainee for the endorsement of a type
  rating on the trainee's pilot licence --- balloon;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} where the holder's licence is endorsed with a night
  rating,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} conduct dual flight instruction in respect of the
    endorsement of a night rating on a pilot licence --- balloon, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} recommend a trainee for the endorsement of a night
    rating on the trainee's pilot licence --- balloon;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} endorse a trainee's personal log in respect of
  methods of inflation; and

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} conduct dual flight instruction in respect of the
  issuance of a pilot licence --- balloon.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-49, s. 25
:::

##### [Gyroplanes --- Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990838 .Subheading}

**[[401.84]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.84 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
flight instructor rating --- gyroplane may

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} conduct flight instruction in respect of the issuance
  of a pilot permit --- gyroplane or the endorsement of a type rating on
  such a permit;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} authorize a trainee to conduct solo flight in a
  gyroplane;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} recommend a trainee for a flight test in respect of
  the issuance of a pilot permit --- gyroplane;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} recommend a trainee for the endorsement of a type
  rating on the trainee's pilot permit --- gyroplane;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} where the holder's licence is endorsed with a night
  rating,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} conduct flight training in respect of the
    endorsement of a night rating on a pilot permit --- gyroplane, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} recommend a trainee for the endorsement of a night
    rating on the trainee's pilot permit --- gyroplane; and

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} where the holder has acquired the experience and
  qualifications specified in the personnel licensing standards,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} conduct ground school instruction and flight
    training in respect of the endorsement of a flight instructor rating
    --- gyroplane on a pilot permit --- gyroplane,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} recommend a trainee for a flight test for the
    endorsement of a flight instructor rating --- gyroplane on a pilot
    permit --- gyroplane, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} conduct a flight test and recommend a trainee for

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the issuance of a pilot permit --- gyroplane, or

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the endorsement of a pilot permit --- gyroplane
      with a flight instructor rating --- gyroplane.

##### [Period of Validity]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990853 .Subheading}

- **[[401.85]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.85
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Flight instructor ratings --- glider
  and balloon are valid for the period specified on the licence in
  accordance with the personnel licensing standards, if the period does
  not exceed 37 months.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A flight instructor rating --- gyroplane is valid for
  the period specified on the licence in accordance with the personnel
  licensing standards, if the period does not exceed 13 months.

##### [Renewal of Flight Instructor Ratings --- Glider, Balloon and Gyroplane]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990857 .Subheading}

**[[401.86]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.86 .sectionLabel}** The Minister
shall renew a flight instructor rating --- glider, balloon or gyroplane
in accordance with the personnel licensing standards, where the holder
of the rating continues to meet the requirements referred to in section
401.06 for the endorsement of the rating.

#### [Division XXI --- Flight Instructor Rating --- Ultra-Light Aeroplane]{.HTitleText3} {#h-990859 .Subheading}

##### [Rating]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990860 .Subheading}

**[[401.87]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.87 .sectionLabel}** The Minister
shall endorse a pilot permit --- ultra-light aeroplane with a flight
instructor rating --- ultra-light aeroplane if the applicant for the
rating meets the requirements referred to in section 401.06.

##### [Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990862 .Subheading}

**[[401.88]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.88 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
flight instructor rating --- ultra-light aeroplane may

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} operate an ultra-light aeroplane with one other
  person on board if the holder has not less than 10 hours of flight
  time as a pilot of an ultra-light aeroplane with the same control
  configuration and the flight is conducted for the purpose of providing
  dual flight instruction for

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the issuance of a pilot permit --- ultra-light
    aeroplane,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the endorsement of a pilot permit --- ultra-light
    aeroplane with a passenger-carrying rating, or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the endorsement of a pilot permit --- ultra-light
    aeroplane with a flight instructor rating --- ultra-light aeroplane;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} authorize the holder of a student pilot permit ---
  ultra-light aeroplane to conduct a solo flight in an ultra-light
  aeroplane;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} conduct ground school instruction for the endorsement
  of a pilot permit --- ultra-light aeroplane with a flight instructor
  rating --- ultra-light aeroplane;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} certify that an applicant has demonstrated the
  ability to meet the level of competency specified in the personnel
  licensing standards for

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the issuance of a pilot permit --- ultra-light
    aeroplane, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the endorsement of a pilot permit --- ultra-light
    aeroplane with a flight instructor rating --- ultra-light aeroplane;
    and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} recommend an applicant for a flight test for the
  issuance of a passenger-carrying rating.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-319, s. 5
:::

##### [Period of Validity]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990876 .Subheading}

**[[401.89]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.89 .sectionLabel}** A flight
instructor rating --- ultra-light aeroplane is valid for the period
specified on the licence in accordance with the personnel licensing
standards, if the period does not exceed 61 months.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-49, s. 26
:::

##### [Renewal of Flight Instructor Rating --- Ultra-light Aeroplane]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990880 .Subheading}

**[[401.90]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.90 .sectionLabel}** The Minister
shall renew a flight instructor rating --- ultra-light aeroplane in
accordance with the personnel licensing standards where the holder of
the rating continues to meet the requirements referred to in section
401.06 for the endorsement of the rating.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-129, s. 8(E)
:::

#### [Division XXII --- Flight Instructor Rating --- Aeroplane --- Aerobatic]{.HTitleText3} {#h-990884 .Subheading}

##### [Rating]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990885 .Subheading}

**[[401.91]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.91 .sectionLabel}** The Minister
shall endorse a commercial pilot licence --- aeroplane or an airline
transport pilot licence --- aeroplane with a Class 1 or Class 2 flight
instructor rating --- aeroplane --- aerobatic if the applicant for the
rating meets the requirements referred to in section 401.06.

##### [Class 2 Rating --- Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990887 .Subheading}

**[[401.92]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.92 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
Class 2 flight instructor rating --- aeroplane --- aerobatic may

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} conduct flight instruction in the performance of
  aerobatic manoeuvres; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} certify a licensed pilot's personal log with respect
  to competency to perform aerobatic manoeuvres.

##### [Class 1 Rating --- Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990891 .Subheading}

**[[401.93]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.93 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
Class 1 flight instructor rating --- aeroplane --- aerobatic may

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} exercise the privileges of a Class 2 flight
  instructor rating --- aeroplane --- aerobatic;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} provide ground school and flight instruction in
  respect of the endorsement of a licence with a flight instructor
  rating --- aeroplane --- aerobatic; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} recommend a trainee for a flight test in respect of
  the endorsement of the trainee's licence with a flight instructor
  rating --- aeroplane --- aerobatic.

#### [Division XXIII --- Flight Instructor Rating --- Glider --- Aerobatic]{.HTitleText3} {#h-990896 .Subheading}

##### [Rating]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990897 .Subheading}

**[[401.94]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.94 .sectionLabel}** The Minister
shall endorse a licence endorsed with a flight instructor rating ---
glider with a flight instructor rating --- glider --- aerobatic if the
applicant for the flight instructor rating --- glider --- aerobatic
meets the requirements referred to in section 401.06.

##### [Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990899 .Subheading}

**[[401.95]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-401.95 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
flight instructor rating --- glider --- aerobatic may

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} provide, in a glider, flight instruction in the
  performance of aerobatic manoeuvres;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} provide dual flight instruction to the holder of a
  flight instructor rating --- glider in respect of the endorsement of
  the holder's licence with an aerobatic rating --- glider; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} recommend the holder of a flight instructor rating
  --- glider for the endorsement of an aerobatic rating --- glider on
  the holder's licence.

**\[401.96 to 401.99 reserved\]**

### [Subpart 2 --- Air Traffic Controller Licences and Ratings]{.HTitleText2} {#h-990905 .Subheading}

#### [Division I --- General]{.HTitleText3} {#h-990906 .Subheading}

##### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990907 .Subheading}

- **[[402.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-402.01
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In this Subpart, [[proficiency
  check]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an assessment of the operational
  knowledge, skill and judgement of the holder of, or an applicant for,
  an air traffic control licence or rating, with respect to the
  provision of the requisite air traffic services relating to that
  licence or rating at an operational location.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Any reference in this Subpart to the personnel
  licensing standards is a reference to the Personnel Licensing and
  Training Standards respecting Air Traffic Controller Licences and
  Ratings.

##### [Application]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990911 .Subheading}

**[[402.02]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-402.02 .sectionLabel}** This Subpart
applies to persons who hold an air traffic controller licence or who
apply for the issuance of such a licence or the endorsement of such a
licence with a rating.

##### [Issuance and Endorsement of Air Traffic Controller Licences and Ratings]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990913 .Subheading}

- **[[402.03]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-402.03
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section 6.71 of the Act
  and subsections (3) and (4), the Minister shall, on receipt of an
  application submitted in the form and manner specified in the
  personnel licensing standards, issue an air traffic controller licence
  or endorse the applicant's air traffic controller licence with a
  rating where the applicant provides documentation to the Minister that
  establishes

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the applicant's citizenship; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that the applicant meets the applicable
    requirements set out in the personnel licensing standards in respect
    of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} minimum age,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} medical fitness,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} knowledge, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} experience.

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2008-122, s. 2\]]{.Repealed}

- [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} An application shall also include

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} one photograph of the applicant that meets the
    requirements of subsection 422.03(3) of the personnel licensing
    standards; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} documentation establishing that the applicant
    demonstrated, by means of an evaluation, their ability to speak and
    understand English, or both English and French, at the operational
    or expert level in accordance with the language proficiency scale
    set out in the table to subsection 422.03(4) of the personnel
    licensing standards.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may specify in an air traffic controller
  licence any condition in respect of the exercise of the privileges of
  the licence or the privileges of a rating endorsed on the licence, if
  the condition is required to ensure aviation safety, including any
  condition in respect of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the training of the licence holder;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the supervision of the licence holder;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the equipment that the licence holder may use; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the operational location at which the licence
    holder may exercise the privileges of the holder's air traffic
    controller licence.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where air traffic control services are provided at an
  operational location in English only, the Minister shall not endorse
  an air traffic controller licence with a rating for that operational
  location unless the applicant has passed an examination that
  demonstrates that the applicant is sufficiently competent in the use
  of that language to be able to engage in two-way radiocommunication
  involving the exchange of safety and control messages.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Where air traffic control services are provided at an
  operational location in both official languages, the Minister shall
  not endorse an air traffic controller licence with a rating for that
  operational location unless the applicant has passed an examination
  that demonstrates that the applicant is sufficiently competent in the
  use of both official languages to be able to engage in two-way
  radiocommunication involving the exchange of safety and control
  messages.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2008-122, s. 2
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-402.03-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 402.03"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Prohibitions]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990935 .Subheading}

- **[[402.04]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-402.04
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall act as an air
  traffic controller or exercise the privileges of an air traffic
  controller licence unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the person holds an air traffic controller licence
    endorsed with a rating appropriate to the privileges being exercised
    and with the appropriate operational location;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the licence is valid;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the person holds a valid Category 1 or 2 medical
    certificate; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the person can produce the licence and certificate
    when exercising those privileges.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph (1)(a) does not apply to a person who,
  while under supervision, acts as an air traffic controller or
  exercises the privileges of an air traffic controller licence when
  undergoing

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} instruction, training or testing in respect of an
    air traffic controller licence; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} ATC unit familiarization in the course of the
    person's employment.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2010-26, s. 5
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-402.04-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 402.04"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Recency Requirements]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990947 .Subheading}

**[[402.05]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-402.05 .sectionLabel}** The holder of an
air traffic controller licence shall not exercise the privileges of that
licence at an air traffic control unit unless the holder has
successfully completed a proficiency check within the preceding 12
months.

##### [Provisional Licences and Ratings]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990949 .Subheading}

- **[[402.06]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-402.06
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where an applicant for an air
  traffic controller licence or for the endorsement of such a licence
  with a rating meets the applicable requirements set out in the
  personnel licensing standards, the Minister shall, as appropriate,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} issue a provisional air traffic controller licence
    to the applicant endorsed with a rating appropriate to the functions
    to be exercised and with the appropriate operational location; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} endorse the applicant's air traffic controller
    licence with a provisional rating for the appropriate operational
    location.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A provisional air traffic controller licence or
  rating remains in effect until the earlier of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the date of issuance of an air traffic controller
    licence by the Minister pursuant to section 402.03, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a date 90 days after the issuance of the
    provisional air traffic controller licence or the endorsement of an
    air traffic controller licence with a provisional rating.

##### [Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990957 .Subheading}

**[[402.07]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-402.07 .sectionLabel}** The holder of an
air traffic controller licence may, in accordance with Part VIII and the
personnel licensing standards, provide or supervise air traffic control
services to

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} airport traffic at any operational location for which
  the licence is endorsed with an airport control rating;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} aircraft at any operational location for which the
  licence is endorsed with a terminal control rating, an area control
  rating or an oceanic control rating; or

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} airshow traffic at the operational location in
  respect of which a special flight operations certificate has been
  issued by the Minister pursuant to section 603.67.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2025-98, s. 5](#1522528-1524941){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1522528-1524941.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-402.07-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 402.07"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Validity of Air Traffic Controller Licences]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990962 .Subheading}

- **[[402.08]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-402.08
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An air traffic controller licence
  that is issued in the form of a booklet label is not valid unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the label is affixed in an aviation document
    booklet;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the booklet number displayed on the label matches
    the number of the booklet; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the booklet is signed by the holder.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The validity period of an air traffic controller
  licence that is issued in the form of a booklet label starts on the
  day on which it is issued and ends on the expiry date of the aviation
  document booklet in which it is affixed.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The expiry date of an aviation document booklet that
  has an air traffic controller licence affixed in it is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the first day of the sixty-first month following
    the day on which the booklet was issued, if the application for the
    licence included documentation establishing that the holder
    demonstrated an expert level ability during their language
    proficiency evaluation; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the first day of the sixty-first month following
    the day on which the holder's language proficiency evaluation was
    conducted, if the application for the licence included documentation
    establishing that the holder demonstrated an operational level
    ability during the evaluation.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2021-152, s. 6\]]{.Repealed}

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2010-26, s. 6
- [SOR/2021-152, s. 6](#1302009-1308387){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1302009-1308387.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-402.08-20100202.html "Link to previous version of section 402.08"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Language Proficiency Evaluations]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990975 .Subheading}

**[[402.09]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-402.09 .sectionLabel}** If the
documentation included with an application for an air traffic controller
licence that was issued in the form of a booklet label establishes that
the holder demonstrated an operational level ability during their
language proficiency evaluation, the holder shall, for the purposes of
renewing the licence, be evaluated again within the six months preceding
the expiry date of the aviation document booklet in which it is affixed.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2010-26, s. 6
:::

**\[402.10 to 402.15 reserved\]**

#### [Division II --- Training Records]{.HTitleText3} {#h-990980 .Subheading}

##### [Training Records]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990981 .Subheading}

**[[402.16]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-402.16 .sectionLabel}** The manager of an
ATC unit shall

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} maintain, on a form provided by the Minister, a
  training record for each person undergoing training at the ATC unit
  for the purpose of obtaining a rating or operational location
  endorsement in respect of the ATC unit;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} enter the licence number of the training officer or
  supervisor in the training record and certify that any information
  entered in the record is correct by signing and dating the entry and
  any amendment thereto;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} at the request of any person who is undergoing or has
  undergone training at the ATC unit, provide a copy of the person's
  training record to the person; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} at the request of the Minister, provide the Minister
  with a copy of the training record of any person who is undergoing or
  has undergone training at the ATC unit and who holds an air traffic
  controller licence.

**\[402.17 reserved\]**

### [Subpart 3 --- Aircraft Maintenance Engineer Licences and Ratings]{.HTitleText2} {#h-990988 .Subheading}

#### [Division I --- General]{.HTitleText3} {#h-990989 .Subheading}

##### [Application]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990990 .Subheading}

**[[403.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-403.01 .sectionLabel}** This Subpart
applies to

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} holders of an aircraft maintenance engineer (AME)
  licence and applicants for the issuance or renewal of such a licence;
  and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} approved training organizations that provide aircraft
  maintenance training courses, and persons applying to become approved
  training organizations.

##### [Requirement to Hold AME Licence]{.HTitleText4} {#h-990994 .Subheading}

- **[[403.02]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-403.02
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), no person
  shall exercise the privileges of an aircraft maintenance engineer
  (AME) licence unless the person

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} holds an AME licence issued pursuant to this
    Subpart;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} exercises the privileges in accordance with the
    ratings and any limitations endorsed on the licence; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} exercises the privileges in accordance with Part V.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A person who does not meet the conditions specified
  in subsection (1) may sign a maintenance release if the person holds a
  restricted certification authority issued pursuant to Part V.

##### [Issuance and Endorsement of AME Licence]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991001 .Subheading}

**[[403.03]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-403.03 .sectionLabel}** Subject to
section 6.71 of the Act, the Minister shall, on receipt of an
application submitted in the form and manner specified in Chapter 566 of
the Airworthiness Manual, issue an aircraft maintenance engineer (AME)
licence to the applicant or endorse the applicant's AME licence with a
rating, where the applicant provides documentation to the Minister that
establishes

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the applicant's citizenship; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} that the applicant meets the requirements set out in
  Chapter 566 of the Airworthiness Manual in respect of

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} minimum age,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} training,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} knowledge,

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} experience, and

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} skill.

##### [Validity Period of AME Licence]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991010 .Subheading}

**[[403.04]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-403.04 .sectionLabel}** Subject to
section 403.05, an aircraft maintenance engineer (AME) licence is valid
for the period specified in the licence.

##### [Recency Requirements]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991012 .Subheading}

- **[[403.05]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-403.05
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No holder of an aircraft maintenance
  engineer (AME) licence shall exercise the privileges of the licence
  unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the licence was issued within the preceding 24
    months; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the holder of the licence has, for at least six
    months within the preceding 24 months,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} performed aircraft maintenance,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} supervised the performance of aircraft
      maintenance,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} supervised in an executive capacity the
      performance of aircraft maintenance, or

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} served as an aviation maintenance instructor or
      supervised another aviation maintenance instructor in an aircraft
      maintenance training course provided by an approved training
      organization.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The holder of an AME licence who is not in compliance
  with subsection (1) shall regain currency in accordance with the
  standards set out in Chapter 566 of the Airworthiness Manual prior to
  exercising the privileges of the licence.

**\[403.06 and 403.07 reserved\]**

#### [Division II --- Approved Training Organizations]{.HTitleText3} {#h-991023 .Subheading}

##### [Approved Training Organizations]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991024 .Subheading}

- **[[403.08]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-403.08
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall provide aircraft
  maintenance training courses as an approved training organization
  unless the person holds an approved training organization certificate.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall issue an approved training
  organization certificate to a person who

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} makes an application for a certificate; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} meets the standards respecting training courses,
    facilities and instructors that are applicable to the training to be
    provided, as set out in Chapter 566 of the Airworthiness Manual.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall approve a policy manual or a
  training control manual and any amendments to that manual if the
  manual and amendments meet the requirements of Standard 566 ---
  Aircraft Maintenance Engineer Licensing and Training.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-154, s. 3
:::

**\[403.09 to 403.11 reserved\]**

### [Subpart 4 --- Medical Requirements]{.HTitleText2} {#h-991034 .Subheading}

#### [Division I --- General]{.HTitleText3} {#h-991035 .Subheading}

##### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991036 .Subheading}

- **[[404.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-404.01
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In this Subpart,
  [[CAME]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a Civil Aviation Medical Examiner
  appointed by the Minister to conduct medical examinations of
  applicants for the issuance or renewal of medical certificates
  pursuant to subsection 404.04(1).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Any reference in this Subpart to the personnel
  licensing standards is a reference to the Personnel Licensing and
  Training Standards respecting Medical Requirements.

##### [Application]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991040 .Subheading}

**[[404.02]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-404.02 .sectionLabel}** This Subpart
applies to

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} persons who hold or who apply for the issuance or
  renewal of a medical certificate for the purpose of exercising the
  privileges of a permit, licence or rating referred to in section
  404.10; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the physicians referred to in section 404.16.

#### [Division II --- Medical Certificate]{.HTitleText3} {#h-991044 .Subheading}

##### [Requirement to Hold a Medical Certificate]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991045 .Subheading}

- **[[404.03]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-404.03
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall exercise or attempt
  to exercise the privileges of a permit, licence or rating unless the
  person holds a valid medical certificate of a category that is
  appropriate for that permit, licence or rating, as specified in
  section 404.10.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A medical certificate that is issued in the form of a
  booklet label is not valid unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the label is affixed in an aviation document
    booklet;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the booklet number displayed on the label matches
    the number of the booklet; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the booklet is signed by the holder.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2010-26, s. 7
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-404.03-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 404.03"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Issuance, Renewal, Validity Period and Extension of a Medical Certificate]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991054 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2008-140, s. 4

\]
:::

- **[[404.04]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-404.04
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2) and
  subsection 404.05(1), the Minister shall issue or renew a medical
  certificate on receipt of an application therefor if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where the applicant is applying for a medical
    certificate in connection with an application for a student pilot
    permit-aeroplane, pilot permit --- recreational, pilot or student
    pilot permit --- ultra-light aeroplane, a pilot licence --- glider
    or student pilot permit --- glider, the applicant has completed and
    submitted a medical declaration, in accordance with the personnel
    licensing standards, that attests to the fact that the applicant is
    medically fit to exercise the privileges of the permit or licence
    that is applied for; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any case not referred to in paragraph (a), it is
    established, by means of a medical examination conducted by a
    physician referred to in section 404.16, that the applicant meets
    the medical fitness requirements specified in the personnel
    licensing standards.

- [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} A medical certificate is also renewed if it is
  signed, dated and stamped in accordance with paragraph 404.18(a).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} may request an applicant for the issuance or
    renewal of a medical certificate to undergo, before a specified
    date, any medical tests or examinations that are necessary to
    determine whether the applicant meets the medical fitness
    requirements specified in the personnel licensing standards;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} shall not issue or renew a medical certificate
    until the applicant has undergone all of the tests and examinations
    requested by the Minister pursuant to paragraph (a); and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} may suspend, or refuse to issue or renew, the
    applicant's medical certificate if the applicant fails to comply
    with the request referred to in paragraph (a) before the specified
    date.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} request the holder of a medical certificate to
    undergo, before a specified date, any medical tests or examinations
    or provide any additional medical information, as necessary to
    determine whether the holder continues to meet the medical fitness
    requirements specified in the personnel licensing standards; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} suspend, or refuse to renew, the holder's medical
    certificate if the holder fails to comply with the request referred
    to in paragraph (a) before the specified date.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} A medical certificate is subject to any restrictions
  or limitations that have been endorsed on the certificate in
  accordance with subsection 404.05(2).

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} A medical certificate is valid starting on the day on
  which the applicant signs the medical declaration submitted for the
  issuance or renewal of the certificate or on the day on which the
  medical examination for the issuance or renewal of the certificate is
  conducted until the earliest of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the end of the validity period set out in the table
    to subsection (6) for the certificate,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the end of any shorter validity period endorsed on
    the certificate by the Minister, and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the day on which a new medical certificate is
    issued to the holder.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (9), the validity period of a
  medical certificate for a permit, licence or rating that is set out in
  column 1 of the table to this subsection is set out in column 2 if the
  holder of the permit, licence or rating is under 40 years of age and
  in column 3 if the holder of the permit, licence or rating is 40 years
  of age or older.

- [(6.1)]{.lawlabel} The validity period of a medical certificate for a
  commercial pilot licence, a multi-crew pilot licence --- aeroplane and
  an airline transport pilot licence, if the holder of the licence is
  acting as a flight crew member for hire or reward, is 12 months.

- [(6.2)]{.lawlabel} However, the validity period of a medical
  certificate referred to in subsection (6.1) is reduced to 6 months if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the holder of the licence is 40 years of age or
    older and is conducting a single-pilot operation with passengers on
    board; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the holder of the licence is 60 years of age or
    older.

- [(6.3)]{.lawlabel} The holder of a commercial pilot licence or an
  airline transport pilot licence may exercise the privileges of a
  private pilot licence until the end of the applicable validity period
  for the private pilot licence specified in subsection (6).

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} The end of the validity period of a medical
  certificate that is issued or renewed under subsection (1) is
  calculated from the first day of the month following

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the day on which the applicant signs the medical
    declaration submitted for the issuance or renewal of the
    certificate; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the day on which the medical examination for the
    issuance or renewal of the certificate is conducted.

- [(8)]{.lawlabel} The end of the validity period of a medical
  certificate that is renewed in accordance with subsection (1.1) is
  calculated from

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the day on which the preceding validity period ends
    if the medical examination for the renewal of the certificate is
    conducted within 90 days before the end of that validity period; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the first day of the month following the day on
    which the medical examination for the renewal of the certificate is
    conducted if the examination is conducted more than 90 days before
    the end of the preceding validity period.

- [(9)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall endorse a shorter validity period
  on a medical certificate if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a physician referred to in section 404.16
    recommends the shorter validity period in their medical report; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} it is warranted by the results of an assessment
    conducted in accordance with subsection 404.11(1).

- [(10)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (6), the Minister shall extend
  the validity period of a medical certificate for a period of not more
  than 60 days beginning on the day on which the certificate would
  otherwise expire, if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the application for extension of the certificate is
    made while the certificate is still valid; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the applicant demonstrates that there has been no
    reasonable opportunity to undergo a medical examination within the
    90 days before the day on which the certificate would otherwise
    expire.

##### [Medical Standards Flexibility --- Limitations and Restrictions]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991098 .Subheading}

- **[[404.05]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-404.05
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may, in accordance with
  the personnel licensing standards, issue a medical certificate to an
  applicant who does not meet the requirements referred to in subsection
  404.04(1) where it is in the public interest and is not likely to
  affect aviation safety.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where the Minister issues a medical certificate under
  subsection (1), the Minister shall endorse the certificate with any
  limitation or restriction that is necessary to ensure aviation safety.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may amend or remove any limitation or
  restriction referred to in subsection (2) when it is no longer
  required to ensure aviation safety.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may suspend or cancel a medical
  certificate if the applicant fails to comply with any limitation or
  restriction referred to in subsection (2).

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Before issuing a medical certificate under subsection
  (1), the Minister may require an applicant to undergo any practical
  test in respect of the functions of a flight crew member or air
  traffic controller, as appropriate, or any medical examination that is
  necessary to determine whether the applicant meets the medical fitness
  requirements specified in the personnel licensing standards.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of a practical test in respect of
  the functions of a flight crew member, the Minister may designate as a
  testing officer any person who holds

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a flight crew licence endorsed with a flight
    instructor rating that is valid for the category of aircraft to be
    used during the practical test; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a flight crew licence and has the qualifications
    required to conduct the practical test.

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of a practical test in respect of
  the functions of an air traffic controller, the test shall be
  conducted in an actual operational environment under the supervision
  of an Air Traffic Services manager, a regional aviation medical
  officer, an aviation medical officer or a CAME, in accordance with the
  procedures set out in the personnel licensing standards.

##### [Prohibition Regarding Exercise of Privileges]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991109 .Subheading}

- **[[404.06]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-404.06
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (3), no holder
  of a permit, licence or rating shall exercise the privileges of the
  permit, licence or rating if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} one of the following circumstances exists and could
    impair the holder's ability to exercise those privileges safely:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the holder suffers from an illness, injury or
      disability,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the holder is taking a drug, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the holder is receiving medical treatment;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the holder has been involved in an aircraft
    accident that is wholly or partially the result of any of the
    circumstances referred to in paragraph (a);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the holder has entered the thirtieth week of
    pregnancy, unless the medical certificate is issued in connection
    with an air traffic controller licence, in which case the holder may
    exercise the privileges of the permit, licence or rating until the
    onset of labour; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the holder has given birth in the preceding six
    weeks.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No holder of a permit, licence or rating who is
  referred to in paragraph (1)(b), (c) or (d) shall exercise the
  privileges of the permit, licence or rating unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the holder has undergone a medical examination
    referred to in section 404.18; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the medical examiner has indicated on the holder's
    medical certificate that the holder is medically fit to exercise the
    privileges of the permit, licence or rating.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may, in writing, authorize the holder of
  a medical certificate to exercise, under the circumstances described
  in paragraph (1)(a) or (d), the privileges of the permit, licence or
  rating to which the medical certificate relates if such authorization
  is in the public interest and is not likely to affect aviation safety.

**\[404.07 to 404.09 reserved\]**

#### [Division III --- Medical Certificate Requirements]{.HTitleText3} {#h-991124 .Subheading}

##### [Medical Certificate Requirements for Personnel Licences]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991125 .Subheading}

- **[[404.10]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-404.10
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A Category 1 medical certificate is
  required for the following licences:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} commercial pilot licence --- aeroplane or
    helicopter;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} multi-crew pilot licence --- aeroplane;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} airline transport pilot licence --- aeroplane or
    helicopter; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} flight engineer licence.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A Category 1 or 2 medical certificate is required for
  an air traffic controller licence.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} A Category 1 or 3 medical certificate is required for
  the following permits, licences and ratings:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2025-26, s. 18\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} pilot permit --- gyroplane;

  - [(b.1)]{.lawlabel} student pilot permit --- gyroplane or balloon;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} private pilot licence --- aeroplane or helicopter;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} pilot licence --- balloon;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} flight instructor rating --- glider; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} flight instructor rating --- ultra-light aeroplane.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} A Category 1, 3 or 4 medical certificate is required
  for the following permits and licences:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} student pilot permit - aeroplane;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} pilot permit --- recreational;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} student pilot permit or pilot permit ---
    ultra-light aeroplane;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} student pilot permit --- glider;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} pilot licence --- glider; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} student pilot permit --- helicopter.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2007-229, s. 3
- SOR/2014-15, s. 16
- [SOR/2025-26, s. 18](#1511703-1516222){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1511703-1516222.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-404.10-20140413.html "Link to previous version of section 404.10"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Division IV --- Medical Fitness]{.HTitleText3} {#h-991149 .Subheading}

##### [Minister's Assessment]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991150 .Subheading}

- **[[404.11]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-404.11
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall assess any
  medical reports submitted pursuant to paragraph 404.17(b) to determine
  whether an applicant for the issuance or renewal of a medical
  certificate meets the medical fitness requirements set out in the
  personnel licensing standards that are necessary for the issuance or
  renewal of the medical certificate.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall, by personal service or by
  registered mail sent to the applicant at the latest known address of
  the applicant, immediately

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} notify the applicant of the result of an
    assessment, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an application for the renewal of a
    medical certificate, inform the applicant that the Minister will, no
    earlier than 30 days after the date that the applicant receives the
    notification, make a decision pursuant to subsection 7.1(1) of the
    Act, based on the result of the assessment.

##### [Reconsideration of Assessment]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991156 .Subheading}

- **[[404.12]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-404.12
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An applicant for the renewal of a
  medical certificate who is assessed by the Minister as not meeting the
  requirements referred to in subsection 404.11(1) may, within 30 days
  after the date that the applicant receives the notification referred
  to in subsection 404.11(2),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} request the Minister to reconsider the assessment;
    and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} submit additional information to the Minister
    regarding the medical fitness of the applicant in support of the
    request.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where the Minister is requested to reconsider an
  assessment pursuant to subsection (1), the Minister shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} take into consideration any additional information
    regarding the medical fitness of the applicant; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} immediately notify the applicant in writing of the
    result of the reconsideration of the assessment.

**\[404.13 to 404.15 reserved\]**

#### [Division V --- Medical Examiners]{.HTitleText3} {#h-991165 .Subheading}

##### [Authority to Conduct Medical Examinations]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991166 .Subheading}

**[[404.16]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-404.16 .sectionLabel}** No physician
shall conduct a medical examination of an applicant for the issuance or
renewal of a medical certificate unless the physician conducts the
medical examination in the region in which the physician is licensed to
practise and

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the physician is appointed by the Minister as a CAME;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} where the applicant is a regular member of the
  Canadian Armed Forces or an air cadet, the physician is a Canadian
  Armed Forces flight surgeon; or

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} where the applicant resides or is examined in a
  contracting state other than Canada, the physician is authorized by
  the licensing authority of the contracting state to conduct such
  examinations.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2007-229, s. 4
- [SOR/2021-152, s. 18](#1302032-1308408){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1302032-1308408.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-404.16-20071230.html "Link to previous version of section 404.16"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Responsibilities of Medical Examiner]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991173 .Subheading}

**[[404.17]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-404.17 .sectionLabel}** Where a physician
referred to in paragraph 404.16(a) or (b) conducts a medical examination
of an applicant for the issuance or renewal of a medical certificate,
the physician shall

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} conduct the medical examination in accordance with
  the procedures set out in the personnel licensing standards; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} submit a medical report to the Minister that
  specifies the results of the medical examination and contains, if
  warranted by those results, the physician's recommendation that the
  medical certificate be restricted to a validity period that is shorter
  than the validity period set out in the table to subsection 404.04(6)
  for the certificate.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2007-229, s. 5
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-404.17-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 404.17"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Examination for Renewal of a Medical Certificate or for Permission to Continue to Exercise the Privileges of a Permit, Licence or Rating]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991179 .Subheading}

**[[404.18]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-404.18 .sectionLabel}** When the holder
of a medical certificate undergoes a medical examination by a physician
referred to in paragraph 404.16(a) or (b) for the purpose of renewing
his or her certificate or obtaining permission to continue to exercise
the privileges of his or her permit, licence or rating, the physician
shall

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} sign and date the medical certificate and stamp it
  with his or her official stamp indicating that the holder is "fit" and
  return the medical certificate to the holder; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} advise the holder that he or she is "unfit" and
  return the medical certificate to the holder.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-129, s. 9
- SOR/2007-229, s. 6
:::
