### [Subpart 5 --- Flight Training]{.HTitleText2} {#h-991185 .Subheading}

#### [Division I --- General]{.HTitleText3} {#h-991186 .Subheading}

##### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991187 .Subheading}

- **[[405.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-405.01
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In this Subpart, [[Standard 425 ---
  Flight Training]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a publication concerning
  flight training.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Any reference in this Subpart to the personnel
  licensing standards is a reference to Standard 425 --- Flight
  Training.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-119, s. 47](#1126798-1144363){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1126798-1144363.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-405.01-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 405.01"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Application]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991191 .Subheading}

**[[405.02]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-405.02 .sectionLabel}** This Subpart
applies in respect of the conduct of flight training using an aeroplane,
helicopter, glider, balloon, gyroplane or ultra-light aeroplane.

**\[405.03 to 405.10 reserved\]**

#### [Division II --- Flight Training Program]{.HTitleText3} {#h-991194 .Subheading}

##### [Flight Training Program]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991195 .Subheading}

**[[405.11]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-405.11 .sectionLabel}** No person shall
conduct flight training unless the flight training program is in
accordance with the requirements of Subpart 1 in respect of

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the initial issuance of a permit, licence or rating;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the renewal of a rating; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a flight review.

##### [Flight Training Program Approval]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991200 .Subheading}

**[[405.12]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-405.12 .sectionLabel}** Where a syllabus
for a flight training program is not set out in the Personnel Licensing
and Training Standards respecting Flight Crew Permits, Licences and
Ratings, the Minister shall approve a proposed syllabus for a flight
training program if the program meets those standards.

##### [Flight Training Program Outline]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991202 .Subheading}

**[[405.13]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-405.13 .sectionLabel}** A person who
conducts flight training using an aeroplane or helicopter shall provide
to each trainee, at the time of commencing a flight training program
referred to in section 405.11, a flight training program outline that
meets the personnel licensing standards.

##### [Flight Training Program Requirements]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991204 .Subheading}

**[[405.14]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-405.14 .sectionLabel}** Flight training
that is conducted using an aeroplane or helicopter shall be conducted in
accordance with the applicable flight instructor guide and flight
training manual or equivalent document and the applicable training
manual on human factors.

**\[405.15 to 405.20 reserved\]**

#### [Division III --- Personnel and Aircraft]{.HTitleText3} {#h-991207 .Subheading}

##### [Qualifications of Flight Instructors]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991208 .Subheading}

- **[[405.21]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-405.21
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall conduct flight
  training or a flight review unless the person is qualified as a flight
  instructor in accordance with the personnel licensing standards.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If no qualified gyroplane flight instructor is
  available, the Minister shall authorize a person to conduct the
  gyroplane training that has to be acquired to satisfy the experience
  requirement for the issuance of a pilot permit --- gyroplane if the
  authorization is in the public interest and is not likely to affect
  aviation safety and if the person

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} submits a written request to the Minister; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} meets the requirements of paragraph 425.21(2)(d) of
    the personnel licensing standards.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall authorize a person who conducts
  flight training toward the issuance of an aircraft type rating to
  conduct the flight training for a holder of a student pilot permit ---
  gyroplane if the authorization is in the public interest and is not
  likely to affect aviation safety and if the person

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} submits a written request to the Minister; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} meets the requirements of paragraph 425.21(7)(d) of
    the personnel licensing standards.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2025-26, s. 19\]]{.Repealed}

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2025-26, s. 19\]]{.Repealed}

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2006-352, s. 13
- [SOR/2025-26, s. 19](#1511707-1516227){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1511707-1516227.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-405.21-20061214.html "Link to previous version of section 405.21"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Aircraft Familiarization]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991217 .Subheading}

**[[405.22]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-405.22 .sectionLabel}** No person shall
conduct flight training in an aircraft unless the person is familiar
with the flight characteristics, operating limitations and operational
performance data specified in the aircraft flight manual or equivalent
document.

##### [Training Aircraft Requirements]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991219 .Subheading}

**[[405.23]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-405.23 .sectionLabel}** No person shall
operate a training aircraft unless the aircraft meets the personnel
licensing standards.

##### [Flight Training at Aerodrome]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991221 .Subheading}

**[[405.24]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-405.24 .sectionLabel}** No person shall
operate a training aircraft at an aerodrome unless the aerodrome is
suitable for the aircraft

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} to be safely operated within the operating
  limitations and operational performance data specified in the aircraft
  flight manual or equivalent document

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} allowing for the actual aircraft weight and
    existing air temperature and wind conditions,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} with the power plant operation and landing gear
    and flap operation, if applicable, recommended by the manufacturer,
    and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} with smooth transition from take-off to the best
    rate-of-climb speed using normal piloting skills; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a helicopter, to carry out normal
  transitions from the hover to forward flight and from forward flight
  to the hover.

**\[405.25 to 405.30 reserved\]**

#### [Division IV --- Flight Training Operations]{.HTitleText3} {#h-991229 .Subheading}

##### [Training Flight Briefings]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991230 .Subheading}

**[[405.31]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-405.31 .sectionLabel}** No person shall
commence a training flight unless the trainee has received from the
flight instructor

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a pre-flight briefing; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} where new flight exercises are to be conducted during
  the flight, preparatory ground instruction.

##### [Authorization of Training Flight]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991234 .Subheading}

**[[405.32]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-405.32 .sectionLabel}** Before the
commencement of a training flight, the flight instructor who will
conduct or supervise the training shall

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} authorize the training flight; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} receive an acknowledgement of that authorization from
  the trainee.

##### [Pilot Training Record]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991238 .Subheading}

- **[[405.33]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-405.33
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A person who conducts flight
  training for the issuance of a private pilot licence, a commercial
  pilot licence or a flight instructor rating --- aeroplane or
  helicopter shall, for each trainee, maintain a pilot training record
  that meets the personnel licensing standards.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} On request from a trainee receiving training for the
  purposes referred to in subsection (1), the person responsible for
  maintaining the trainee's pilot training record shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} certify the accuracy of the entries; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} provide the trainee with the record.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} When a trainee has completed flight training,
  including all of the tests and written examinations required pursuant
  to Subpart 1, the person who conducted the flight training shall
  forward the trainee's pilot training record to the Minister.

**\[405.34 to 405.40 reserved\]**

### [Subpart 6 --- Flight Training Units]{.HTitleText2} {#h-991246 .Subheading}

#### [Division I --- General]{.HTitleText3} {#h-991247 .Subheading}

##### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991248 .Subheading}

- **[[406.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.01
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In this Subpart, [[Personnel
  Licensing and Training Standards respecting Flight Training
  Units]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a publication concerning flight
  training units.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Any reference in this Subpart to the personnel
  licensing standards is a reference to Standard 426 -- Personnel
  Licensing and Training -- Flight Training Units.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-173, s. 9
:::

##### [Application]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991254 .Subheading}

**[[406.02]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.02 .sectionLabel}** This Subpart
applies in respect of the operation of an aeroplane, helicopter, glider,
balloon, gyroplane or ultra-light aeroplane in a flight training service
toward obtaining any of the following:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} for aeroplanes,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a private pilot licence,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a commercial pilot licence,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a landplane or seaplane rating,

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a flight instructor rating,

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} a flight instructor rating --- aerobatic,

  - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} an instrument rating,

  - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} a multi-engine class rating,

  - [(viii)]{.lawlabel} a night rating,

  - [(ix)]{.lawlabel} a VFR over-the-top rating,

  - [(x)]{.lawlabel} a pilot permit --- recreational, or

  - [(xi)]{.lawlabel} experience in aerobatic manoeuvres;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} for helicopters,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a private pilot licence,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a commercial pilot licence,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a flight instructor rating,

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} an instrument rating,

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} a night rating,

  - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} a VFR over-the-top rating, or

  - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} a pilot permit --- recreational;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} for gliders,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a pilot licence,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a flight instructor rating,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a flight instructor rating --- aerobatic, or

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} experience in aerobatic manoeuvres;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} for balloons,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a pilot licence,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a flight instructor rating, or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a night rating;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} for gyroplanes,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a pilot permit,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a flight instructor rating, or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a night rating; and

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} for ultra-light aeroplanes,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a pilot permit,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a flight instructor rating, or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a passenger-carrying rating.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-319, s. 6
- SOR/2006-352, s. 14
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-406.02-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 406.02"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Requirement to Hold a Flight Training Unit Operator Certificate]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991295 .Subheading}

- **[[406.03]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.03
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (2) and (3),
  no person shall operate a flight training service in Canada using an
  aeroplane or helicopter in Canada unless the person holds a flight
  training unit operator certificate that authorizes the person to
  operate the service and complies with the conditions and operations
  specifications set out in the certificate.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A person who does not hold a flight training unit
  operator certificate may operate a flight training service if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the person holds a private operator registration
    document or an air operator certificate, the aircraft used for
    training --- in the case of the holder of an air operator
    certificate --- is specified in the air operator certificate, and
    the training is other than toward obtaining a pilot permit ---
    recreational, a private pilot licence, a commercial pilot licence or
    a flight instructor rating; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the trainee is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the owner, or a member of the family of the
      owner, of the aircraft used for training,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a director of a corporation that owns the
      aircraft used for training, and the training is other than toward
      obtaining a pilot permit --- recreational or a private pilot
      licence, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} using an aircraft that has been obtained from a
      person who is at arm's length from the flight instructor, and the
      training is other than toward obtaining a pilot permit ---
      recreational or a private pilot licence.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} In the case of flight training conducted under
  subparagraph (2)(b)(iii), the flight instructor shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} notify the Minister in writing of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of the person to receive the
      training,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the registration of the aircraft to be used,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the type of training to be conducted,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the location of the training operations, and

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} the name and licence number of the flight
      instructor; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} provide the information to the Minister

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} prior to commencing training operations,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} within 10 working days after any change to the
      information, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} when the training is discontinued.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-129, s. 10
- SOR/2014-131, s. 10
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-406.03-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 406.03"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Eligibility to Hold a Flight Training Unit Operator Certificate]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991317 .Subheading}

**[[406.04]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.04 .sectionLabel}** A person is
eligible to hold a flight training unit operator certificate if the
person is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a citizen, permanent resident or corporation of the
  United States of America or Mexico.

##### [Notification Requirement]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991321 .Subheading}

- **[[406.05]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.05
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall operate a flight
  training unit using a glider, balloon, gyroplane or ultra-light
  aeroplane in Canada unless the person notifies the Minister in writing
  of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the legal name, trade name and address of the
    operator of the flight training unit;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the base of operations;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the category of aircraft;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the type of flight training to be conducted; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the name of the flight instructor who will be
    responsible for operational control of the flight training
    operations.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The information referred to in subsection (1) shall
  be provided to the Minister by the flight training unit

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} prior to commencing flight training operations;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} within 10 working days after any change in the
    information; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} upon the service being discontinued.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-246, s. 8(F)](#1380122-1380748){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1380122-1380748.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-406.05-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 406.05"){.PITLink}
:::

**\[406.06 to 406.10 reserved\]**

#### [Division II --- Certification]{.HTitleText3} {#h-991334 .Subheading}

##### [Issuance or Amendment of a Flight Training Unit Operator Certificate]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991335 .Subheading}

- **[[406.11]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.11
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section 6.71 of the Act,
  the Minister shall, on receipt of an application submitted in the form
  and manner specified in the personnel licensing standards, issue or
  amend a flight training unit operator certificate where the applicant
  demonstrates to the Minister the ability to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} maintain an adequate organizational structure;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} maintain operational control;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} comply with maintenance requirements;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} meet the personnel licensing standards; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} conduct the operation safely.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), an applicant
  shall have

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a management organization capable of exercising
    operational control;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} managerial personnel who are employed on a
    full-time basis and who perform the duties related to the following
    positions:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} chief flight instructor,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} flight instructor,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} ground instructor, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} if the applicant does not hold an approved
      maintenance organization certificate, a maintenance manager;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} aircraft that are properly equipped for and flight
    crew members who are qualified for the type of flight training that
    is being conducted;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} an operational control system that meets the
    requirements of section 406.50;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a training program that meets the requirements of
    this Subpart;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} legal custody and control of at least one aircraft
    or, in the case of an applicant for a flight training unit operator
    certificate who conducts an integrated course, one aircraft of each
    class of aircraft that is to be operated;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an applicant for a flight training
    unit operator certificate who conducts an integrated course or who
    operates a sub-base, a flight training operations manual that meets
    the requirements of section 406.61 and, in the case of an applicant
    who conducts an integrated course, a training manual that meets the
    requirements of section 406.62; and

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} a maintenance control system approved under this
    Subpart.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2006-352, s. 15
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-406.11-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 406.11"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Contents of a Flight Training Unit Operator Certificate]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991358 .Subheading}

**[[406.12]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.12 .sectionLabel}** A flight training
unit operator certificate shall contain the following information:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the legal name, trade name and address of the flight
  training unit;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the number of the certificate;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the effective date of certification;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the date of issue of the certificate;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the general conditions identified in section 406.13;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} specific conditions with respect to

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the main base and, if applicable, for flight
    training units conducting training in accordance with a flight
    training operations manual, sub-bases,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the class and type of aeroplane or the type of
    helicopter, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the type of training authorized; and

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} where the flight training unit complies with the
  personnel licensing standards, operations specifications with respect
  to

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a flight training unit that operates
    aeroplanes or helicopters, the conduct of flight training operations
    on a temporary basis at a satellite base, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any other condition pertaining to the operation
    that the Minister deems necessary for aviation safety.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2006-352, s. 16
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-406.12-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 406.12"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [General Conditions of a Flight Training Unit Operator Certificate]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991374 .Subheading}

**[[406.13]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.13 .sectionLabel}** A flight training
unit operator certificate shall contain the following general
conditions:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the flight training unit shall maintain the
  organizational structure referred to in paragraph 406.11(1)(a);

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the flight training unit shall have the personnel
  referred to in the personnel licensing standards;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the flight training unit shall have aircraft that are
  properly equipped for the geographic area of operation and the type of
  authorized training;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the flight training unit shall maintain its aircraft
  in accordance with the maintenance requirements of Parts V and VI and
  Division IV of this Subpart;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the flight training unit shall conduct flight
  training in accordance with the provisions of Subpart 5 and Division V
  of this Subpart and, if the flight training unit conducts an
  integrated course or operates a sub-base, it shall also conduct flight
  training in accordance with the flight training operations manual;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} the flight training unit shall, when required to
  establish and maintain a training manual in accordance with section
  406.62, conduct training in accordance with that training manual; and

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} the flight training unit shall notify the Minister of
  any change in its legal name, trade name, base of operations or
  managerial personnel within 10 working days after the change.

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2015-160, s. 19\]]{.Repealed}

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-49, s. 27
- SOR/2006-352, s. 17
- SOR/2015-160, s. 19
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-406.13-20061214.html "Link to previous version of section 406.13"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Quality Assurance Program --- Integrated Course]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991386 .Subheading}

**[[406.14]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.14 .sectionLabel}** A flight training
unit that conducts an integrated course shall establish and maintain a
quality assurance program that meets the requirements of section 426.14
of the personnel licensing standards in order to ensure that the flight
training unit continues to comply with the conditions and specifications
in the flight training unit operator certificate.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2006-352, s. 18
- SOR/2015-160, s. 20
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-406.14-20061214.html "Link to previous version of section 406.14"){.PITLink}
:::

**\[406.15 to 406.18 reserved\]**

#### [Division III --- Personnel]{.HTitleText3} {#h-991391 .Subheading}

##### [Duties of Certificate Holder in Respect of Maintenance]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991392 .Subheading}

- **[[406.19]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.19
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The holder of an operator
  certificate issued in respect of a flight training unit that operates
  an aeroplane or a helicopter shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} appoint a person responsible for the maintenance
    control system;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} subject to subsection (4), ensure that the person
    responsible for the maintenance control system has achieved a grade
    of 70% or more in an open-book examination that demonstrates
    knowledge of the provisions of the [Canadian Aviation
    Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-96-433);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2022-246, s. 9\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} ensure that the person responsible for the
    maintenance control system performs the duties referred to in
    subsections 406.36(1) and 406.47(2) and (3);

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} provide the person responsible for the maintenance
    control system with the financial and human resources necessary to
    ensure that the holder of the flight training unit operator
    certificate meets the requirements of these Regulations; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2022-246, s. 9\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} ensure that corrective actions are taken in respect
    of any findings resulting from a quality assurance program
    established under section 406.47.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2022-246, s. 9\]]{.Repealed}

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2022-246, s. 9\]]{.Repealed}

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} The knowledge requirement set out in paragraph (1)(b)
  does not apply in respect of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a person responsible for the maintenance control
    system who held that position on January 1, 1997; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the holder of an aircraft maintenance engineer
    (AME) licence.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} The holder of a flight training unit operator
  certificate shall ensure that no person is appointed to be responsible
  for the maintenance control system or remains responsible for the
  system if, at the time of their appointment or during their tenure,
  they have a record of conviction for

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an offence under section 7.3 of the Act; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} two or more offences under any of sections 605.84
    to 605.86 not arising from a single occurrence.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-173, s. 11
- [SOR/2022-246, s. 9](#1380124-1380754){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1380124-1380754.html"}
:::

[Previous
Version](section-406.19-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 406.19"){.PITLink}
:::

**\[406.20 reserved\]**

##### [Appointment of Chief Flight Instructor]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991413 .Subheading}

- **[[406.21]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.21
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (3) and (4),
  a flight training unit shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} appoint a chief flight instructor; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} ensure that the person appointed as chief flight
    instructor meets the requirements set out in section 406.22.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A flight training unit shall inform the Minister
  within 10 working days after

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the appointment of a chief flight instructor; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} any change in the appointment of a chief flight
    instructor.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} With the authorization of the Minister, a flight
  training unit may, for a period of up to 60 days, continue flight
  training operations without a chief flight instructor if the flight
  training unit complies with the personnel licensing standards.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} With the authorization of the Minister, a flight
  training unit may, for a period of up to six months, continue flight
  training operations with a chief flight instructor who is subject to a
  prohibition regarding the exercise of the privileges of a permit,
  licence or rating pursuant to section 404.06, if the flight training
  unit complies with the personnel licensing standards.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2006-352, s. 19
:::

[Previous
Version](section-406.21-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 406.21"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Requirements for Chief Flight Instructor]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991425 .Subheading}

**[[406.22]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.22 .sectionLabel}** No person shall
act as a chief flight instructor unless the person

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} has the qualifications required for the position, as
  set out in the personnel licensing standards; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} fulfills the responsibilities of the position, as set
  out in subsections 426.22(4) and (5) of the personnel licensing
  standards.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2025-26, s. 20](#1511709-1516244){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1511709-1516244.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-406.22-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 406.22"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Requirements for Assistant Chief Flight Instructor]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991429 .Subheading}

**[[406.22.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.22.1 .sectionLabel}** No flight
training unit shall appoint a person as an assistant chief flight
instructor and no person shall act as an assistant chief flight
instructor unless the person

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} has the qualifications required for the position, as
  set out in the personnel licensing standards; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} acknowledges in writing that the person knows,
  accepts and will carry out the responsibilities of the position, as
  assigned in writing by the chief flight instructor.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2006-352, s. 20
:::

##### [Appointment of Check Instructor]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991435 .Subheading}

**[[406.22.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.22.2 .sectionLabel}** A flight
training unit conducting an integrated course in accordance with
Division VIII of this Subpart shall

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} appoint a check instructor; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} ensure that the person appointed as check instructor
  meets the requirements set out in section 406.22.3.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2006-352, s. 20
:::

##### [Requirements for Check Instructor]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991441 .Subheading}

**[[406.22.3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.22.3 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall act as a check instructor unless the person is a chief flight
instructor or

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} has the qualifications required for the position, as
  set out in the personnel licensing standards; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} acknowledges in writing that the person knows,
  accepts and will carry out the responsibilities of the position, as
  assigned in writing by the chief flight instructor.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2006-352, s. 20
:::

##### [Appointment of Flight Instructors]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991447 .Subheading}

**[[406.23]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.23 .sectionLabel}** No flight
training unit shall appoint a person as a flight instructor unless the
person is qualified in accordance with section 405.21.

##### [Requirements for Ground Instructors]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991449 .Subheading}

**[[406.24]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.24 .sectionLabel}** No flight
training unit shall appoint a person as a ground instructor and no
person shall act as a ground instructor unless the person holds a flight
instructor rating in the appropriate category or meets the personnel
licensing standards.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2006-352, s. 21
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-406.24-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 406.24"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Operational Personnel Records]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991453 .Subheading}

**[[406.25]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.25 .sectionLabel}** A flight training
unit shall, at its main base or sub-base, as applicable, establish,
maintain and retain for at least two years after an entry is made, for
each ground instructor, each flight instructor and every other member of
its operational personnel, a record that meets the personnel licensing
standards.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2006-352, s. 21
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-406.25-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 406.25"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Aircraft Familiarization]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991457 .Subheading}

**[[406.26]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.26 .sectionLabel}** No flight
training unit shall assign a person to conduct flight training in an
aircraft unless the person is familiar with the flight characteristics,
operating limitations and operational performance data specified in the
aircraft flight manual or equivalent document.

**\[406.27 to 406.30 reserved\]**

#### [Division IV --- Aircraft]{.HTitleText3} {#h-991460 .Subheading}

##### [Aircraft Registration Requirements]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991461 .Subheading}

**[[406.31]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.31 .sectionLabel}** No flight
training unit that is a person described in paragraph 406.04(a) shall
operate an aircraft in a flight training service in Canada unless

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the aircraft is registered in Canada under Division
  II of Subpart 2 of Part II or in another contracting state;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} where the aircraft is registered in another
  contracting state, the Minister has authorized its operation; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an aircraft other than an ultra-light
  aeroplane, the aircraft type is approved for operation in Canada.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-49, s. 28
:::

##### [Aircraft Flight Authority]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991468 .Subheading}

**[[406.32]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.32 .sectionLabel}** No flight
training unit shall operate an aircraft in a flight training service
unless

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a flight training unit that operates
  an aeroplane or a helicopter, a certificate of airworthiness that
  meets the requirements of Article 31 of the Convention has been issued
  for the aircraft pursuant to section 507.02;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a flight training unit that operates a
  glider, a balloon or a gyroplane, a flight authority has been issued
  for the aircraft pursuant to Subpart 7 of Part V; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the aircraft meets the requirements of section
  405.23.

##### [Safety Belt and Shoulder Harness Requirements]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991473 .Subheading}

**[[406.33]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.33 .sectionLabel}** No flight
training unit shall operate an aeroplane or a helicopter unless each
front seat, or each seat occupied by a trainee or flight instructor, is
equipped with a safety belt that includes a shoulder harness.

##### [Checklists]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991475 .Subheading}

**[[406.34]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.34 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose
of establishing safe aircraft operating procedures, a flight training
unit that operates an aeroplane or a helicopter shall establish and make
readily available to each flight crew member on board the aircraft the
checklist referred to in section 602.60 for each aircraft type that it
operates.

##### [Maintenance Control System]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991477 .Subheading}

**[[406.35]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.35 .sectionLabel}** A flight training
unit that operates an aeroplane or a helicopter shall establish and
comply with a maintenance control system that

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} consists of policies and procedures regarding the
  maintenance of aircraft operated by the flight training unit;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} meets the requirements of this Subpart; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} is described in the flight training unit's
  maintenance control manual (MCM).

##### [Person Responsible for Maintenance Control System]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991482 .Subheading}

- **[[406.36]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.36
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The person responsible for the
  maintenance control system appointed under paragraph 406.19(1)(a)
  shall, where a finding resulting from a quality assurance program
  established under section 406.47 is reported to them,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} determine what, if any, corrective actions are
    required and carry out those actions;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} keep a record of any determination made under
    paragraph (a) and the reason for it;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if management functions have been assigned to
    another person under subsection (2) or (3), communicate any
    determination regarding a corrective action to that person; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} notify the accountable executive of any systemic
    deficiency and of the corrective action taken.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The person responsible for the maintenance control
  system may assign the management functions for the entire quality
  assurance program established under section 406.47, including the
  authority to remove aircraft from operation under subsection (6), to
  another person if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that person meets the requirements set out in
    paragraph 406.19(1)(b) and subsection 406.19(5); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the assignment and its scope are described in the
    maintenance control manual (MCM) of a flight training unit that
    operates an aeroplane or a helicopter.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The person responsible for the maintenance control
  system may assign the management functions for specific maintenance
  control activities, including the authority to remove aircraft from
  operation under subsection (6), to another person if the assignment
  and its scope are described in the MCM of a flight training unit that
  operates an aeroplane or a helicopter.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} The responsibility of the person responsible for the
  maintenance control system is not affected by the assignment to
  another person of management functions under subsection (2) or (3).

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} If a flight training unit that operates an aeroplane
  or a helicopter is also the holder of an approved maintenance
  organization (AMO) certificate issued under section 573.02, the person
  responsible for the maintenance control system at the flight training
  unit shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} be the person responsible for maintenance at the
    AMO appointed under section 573.03; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} meet the requirements referred to in paragraph
    406.19(1)(b), subsection 406.19(5) and paragraph 573.03(1)(c).

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} The person responsible for the maintenance control
  system shall remove aircraft from operation if the removal is
  justified because of non-compliance with the requirements of these
  Regulations or because of a risk to aviation safety or the safety of
  the public.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-173, s. 12
- [SOR/2022-246, s. 10](#1380128-1380759){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1380128-1380759.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-406.36-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 406.36"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Maintenance Personnel and Facilities]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991499 .Subheading}

**[[406.37]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.37 .sectionLabel}** A flight training
unit shall provide the person who is responsible for its maintenance
control system with the staff, facilities, technical and regulatory
data, supplies and spare parts referred to in the personnel licensing
standards that are necessary for compliance with this Subpart.

##### [Maintenance Control Manual]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991501 .Subheading}

- **[[406.38]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.38
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A flight training unit that operates
  an aeroplane or a helicopter shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} establish and submit to the Minister for approval a
    maintenance control manual that contains the information set out in
    the personnel licensing standards;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} except where otherwise authorized by the Minister
    in writing where it is demonstrated that the granting of the
    authorization will not jeopardize the safety of the service,
    authorize the use of its maintenance control manual and comply with
    the policies and procedures contained therein;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} take steps to ensure that a copy of its maintenance
    control manual, or of the relevant portions of its maintenance
    control manual, is made available to each person who performs or
    certifies a function that is dealt with in the maintenance control
    manual or in any manual that is incorporated in the maintenance
    control manual pursuant to subsection (2);

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} submit amendments to its maintenance control manual
    to the Minister for approval when instructed to do so by the
    Minister, where

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the maintenance control manual does not meet the
      requirements of this Subpart, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the maintenance control manual contains policies
      or procedures, or a lack thereof, such that the flight training
      unit's maintenance control system no longer meets the requirements
      of these Regulations; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} insert amendments to its maintenance control manual
    into each copy of the manual within 30 days after approval of the
    amendments pursuant to paragraph (d).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may authorize the incorporation by
  reference in a maintenance control manual of detailed procedures
  manuals prepared by the flight training unit, where

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the policies affecting the detailed procedures
    remain in the maintenance control manual;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the incorporation is clearly indicated in the
    maintenance control manual;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the flight training unit ensures that the
    incorporated manuals meet the requirements of this section; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the person responsible for the flight training
    unit's maintenance control system, or the person to whom this
    function has been assigned pursuant to subsection 406.36(3), has
    certified in writing that the incorporated manuals meet the
    requirements of this section.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall approve a maintenance control
  manual and any amendments to the manual, where the personnel licensing
  standards are met.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2000-49, s. 1
:::

##### [Maintenance Arrangements]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991519 .Subheading}

- **[[406.39]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.39
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No flight training unit that
  operates an aeroplane or a helicopter shall permit a person or
  organization to perform maintenance on the flight training unit's
  aircraft unless the person or organization has adequate facilities,
  equipment, spare parts and personnel available at the site where the
  maintenance is to be performed and

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the person or organization holds an approved
    maintenance organization (AMO) certificate issued pursuant to
    section 573.02 that is rated in the category for the maintenance to
    be performed;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where the maintenance is to be performed outside
    Canada by a person or organization that does not hold an approved
    maintenance organization (AMO) certificate issued pursuant to
    section 573.02, the person or organization has been approved under
    the laws of a state that is party to an agreement with Canada that
    provides for recognition of the work performed; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in cases other than those described in
    paragraphs (a) and (b), the performance of the maintenance by the
    person or organization has been approved by the Minister as being in
    conformity with these Regulations.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A flight training unit that operates an aeroplane or
  a helicopter shall ensure that a maintenance arrangement made with a
  person or organization pursuant to subsection (1)

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} specifies the maintenance required and clearly
    defines the tasks to be performed; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is made in accordance with the procedures governing
    maintenance arrangements included in the maintenance control manual
    or is approved by the Minister as being in conformity with these
    Regulations.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where a flight training unit that operates an
  aeroplane or a helicopter makes a maintenance arrangement referred to
  in paragraph (1)(b), the Minister shall, in the following cases,
  authorize the arrangement by issuing a maintenance specification to
  indicate that the maintenance control procedures set out in the
  arrangement conform to the personnel licensing standards:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the issuance of a maintenance specification is
    either required by the agreement or requested by the foreign state;
    or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the maintenance is performed in a state that is not
    party to an agreement with Canada that provides for recognition of
    the work performed.

##### [Technical Dispatch Procedures]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991531 .Subheading}

**[[406.40]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.40 .sectionLabel}** A flight training
unit that operates an aeroplane or a helicopter shall establish and
comply with policies and procedures to ensure that an aircraft is not
operated unless it is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} airworthy;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} appropriately equipped, configured and maintained for
  its intended use; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} maintained in accordance with the flight training
  unit's maintenance control manual.

##### [Defect Recording, Rectification and Control Procedures]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991536 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2000-49, s. 2
- SOR/2025-26, s. 21

\]
:::

**[[406.41]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.41 .sectionLabel}** A flight training
unit that operates an aeroplane or a helicopter shall include in its
maintenance control system the procedures referred to in the personnel
licensing standards for

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} recording aircraft defects;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} ensuring that defects are rectified in accordance
  with the requirements of these Regulations;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} detecting defects that recur and identifying those
  defects as recurring defects; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} subject to sections 605.09 and 605.10, scheduling the
  rectification of defects whose repair has been deferred.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-119, s. 17](#1126726-1144201){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1126726-1144201.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-406.41-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 406.41"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Service Difficulty Reporting]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991544 .Subheading}

**[[406.42]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.42 .sectionLabel}** The holder of a
flight training unit operator certificate who operates an aeroplane or a
helicopter shall report to the Minister, in accordance with Division IX
of Subpart 21 of Part V, any reportable service difficulty related to
any aircraft that it operates.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2009-280, s. 22
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-406.42-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section 406.42"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Elementary Work]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991548 .Subheading}

**[[406.43]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.43 .sectionLabel}** No flight
training unit that operates an aeroplane or a helicopter shall authorize
a person to perform, without supervision, a task that is elementary work
set out in section 605.85 unless the person

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} has satisfactorily completed training for the task
  under a training program required by section 406.45; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} has previously performed that task under the direct
  supervision of the holder of an aircraft maintenance engineer (AME)
  licence or a training organization approved pursuant to Subpart 3.

##### [Servicing]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991552 .Subheading}

**[[406.44]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.44 .sectionLabel}** A flight training
unit that operates an aeroplane or a helicopter shall ensure that each
person who performs or requests the performance of servicing has
satisfactorily completed training, under a training program required by
section 406.45, for the servicing to be performed.

##### [Training Program]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991554 .Subheading}

**[[406.45]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.45 .sectionLabel}** A flight training
unit that operates an aeroplane or a helicopter shall implement a
training program to ensure that persons who are authorized to perform a
function under this Division are trained in respect of the regulations,
standards and flight training unit procedures applicable to that
function, as specified in the personnel licensing standards.

##### [Maintenance Personnel Records]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991556 .Subheading}

- **[[406.46]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.46
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A flight training unit that operates
  an aeroplane or a helicopter shall establish, maintain and retain for
  at least two years after an entry is made a record of maintenance
  personnel that meets the personnel licensing standards.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where an authorization is given or training is
  completed, the flight training unit shall provide a copy of each
  record required by subsection (1) to the person to whom the record
  refers.

##### [Quality Assurance Program]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991560 .Subheading}

- **[[406.47]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.47
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The holder of an operator
  certificate issued in respect of a flight training unit that operates
  an aeroplane or a helicopter shall, in order to ensure that its
  maintenance control system and all of the included maintenance
  schedules continue to be effective and to comply with these
  Regulations, establish and maintain a quality assurance program that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is under the sole control of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the person responsible for the maintenance
      control system appointed under paragraph 406.19(1)(a), or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the person to whom the management functions for
      the program have been assigned under subsection 406.36(2); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} meets the requirements of section 426.47 of the
    personnel licensing standards.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The person responsible for the maintenance control
  system shall ensure that records relating to the findings resulting
  from the quality assurance program are distributed to the appropriate
  manager for corrective action and follow-up in accordance with the
  policies and procedures specified in the maintenance control manual
  (MCM).

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The person responsible for the maintenance control
  system shall establish an audit system in respect of a quality
  assurance program that consists of the following:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an initial audit within 12 months after the date on
    which the flight training unit operator certificate is issued;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} subsequent audits conducted at intervals set out in
    the MCM;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a record of each occurrence of compliance or
    non-compliance with the MCM found during an audit referred to in
    paragraph (a) or (b);

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} procedures for ensuring that each finding of an
    audit is communicated to them and, if management functions have been
    assigned to another person under subsection 406.36(2) or (3), to
    that person;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} follow-up procedures for ensuring that corrective
    actions are effective; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a system for recording the findings of initial and
    periodic audits, corrective actions and follow-ups.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} The records required under paragraph (3)(f) shall be
  retained for the greater of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} two audit cycles; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} two years.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} If a flight training unit that operates an aeroplane
  or a helicopter is also the holder of an approved maintenance
  organization (AMO) certificate issued under section 573.02, the person
  responsible for the quality assurance program of the flight training
  unit under paragraph (1)(a) shall be the person responsible for the
  quality assurance program of the AMO.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} The duties related to the quality assurance program
  that involve specific tasks or activities within a flight training
  unit's activities shall be fulfilled by persons who are not
  responsible for carrying out those tasks or activities.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-173, s . 13
:::

**\[406.48 and 406.49 reserved\]**

#### [Division V --- Flight Training Operations]{.HTitleText3} {#h-991583 .Subheading}

##### [Operational Control System]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991584 .Subheading}

**[[406.50]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.50 .sectionLabel}** No flight
training unit that conducts flight training in accordance with a flight
training operations manual that has been approved by the Minister shall
operate an aircraft unless the flight training unit has an operational
control system that meets the personnel licensing standards and is under
the control of its chief flight instructor.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2006-352, s. 23
:::

##### [Aircraft Operations Requirements]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991588 .Subheading}

- **[[406.51]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.51
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A flight training unit that operates
  an aeroplane to conduct training for a private pilot licence, a
  commercial pilot licence or a flight instructor rating shall have
  access to at least one aeroplane that is certified under Part V for
  the spin manoeuvre.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A flight training unit that operates a helicopter to
  conduct training for a pilot permit --- recreational, a private pilot
  licence, a commercial pilot licence or a flight instructor rating
  shall have access to at least one helicopter that is configured for
  and capable of full-on autorotational landings.

##### [Facilities at Base of Operations]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991592 .Subheading}

**[[406.52]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.52 .sectionLabel}** A flight training
unit shall have facilities at a base of operations that meet the
personnel licensing standards.

##### [Dispatch of Aircraft]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991594 .Subheading}

**[[406.53]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.53 .sectionLabel}** No flight
training unit that operates an aeroplane or a helicopter shall permit a
person to conduct a take-off in an aircraft that is subject to the
operational control of the flight training unit unless the aircraft has
been maintained in accordance with a maintenance control system.

##### [Aircraft Operating over Water]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991596 .Subheading}

**[[406.54]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.54 .sectionLabel}** No flight
training unit shall permit a person to operate a land aircraft over
water, except when conducting a take-off or landing, beyond a point
where the land aircraft could reach shore in the event of an engine
failure.

##### [Solo Cross-country Routes]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991598 .Subheading}

**[[406.55]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.55 .sectionLabel}** No flight
training unit that operates an aeroplane or a helicopter shall permit a
person to conduct the solo cross-country flight required by Subpart 1
for the private pilot licence --- aeroplane or the private pilot licence
--- helicopter unless the flight training unit notifies the Minister in
writing of the planned route of the flight originating from the main
base or any satellite base.

##### [Daily Flight Record]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991600 .Subheading}

**[[406.56]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.56 .sectionLabel}** A flight training
unit that operates an aeroplane, a helicopter or a glider shall, for the
purpose of maintaining operational control, establish, maintain and
retain for at least two years after an entry is made a daily flight
record that meets the personnel licensing standards.

##### [Journey Log Entries]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991602 .Subheading}

**[[406.57]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.57 .sectionLabel}** A flight training
unit that operates an aeroplane, a helicopter or a glider shall
designate a person to make journey log entries in accordance with
section 605.94.

##### [Flight Training at a Satellite Base]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991604 .Subheading}

- **[[406.58]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.58
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A flight training unit that conducts
  flight training at a satellite base shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} assign a flight instructor, other than a Class 4
    flight instructor, to be responsible for flight training operations
    at the satellite base; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} ensure that a qualified flight instructor is on
    duty at that satellite base while a solo training flight is in
    progress.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A Class 4 flight instructor shall not conduct flight
  training at a satellite base unless a qualified Class 1 or Class 2
  flight instructor is on duty.

**\[406.59 and 406.60 reserved\]**

#### [Division VI --- Manuals and Course Certificates]{.HTitleText3} {#h-991611 .Subheading}

##### [Flight Training Operations Manual]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991612 .Subheading}

- **[[406.61]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.61
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every flight training unit that
  conducts an integrated course or operates a sub-base shall establish
  and maintain a flight training operations manual that includes the
  instructions and information necessary to enable the personnel
  concerned to perform their duties safely and that meets the personnel
  licensing standards.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The flight training operations manual may be issued
  in separate parts corresponding to specific aspects of operations.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Whenever the flight training operations manual no
  longer meets the personnel licensing standards, the flight training
  unit shall amend it to bring it into compliance with the standards.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} A flight training unit shall submit to the Minister
  its flight training operations manual and, if they relate to the
  information required by the personnel licensing standards, any
  separately issued parts and any subsequent amendments to them or to
  the manual.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} If the personnel licensing standards are met, the
  Minister shall approve the parts of a flight training operations
  manual that relate to the information required by the personnel
  licensing standards and any subsequent amendments to the parts.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} A flight training unit shall distribute its flight
  training operations manual, any separately issued parts and any
  subsequent amendments to the manual or parts in accordance with the
  personnel licensing standards.

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} The chief flight instructor shall maintain a master
  list of the holders of the flight training operations manual and
  ensure that the manual is distributed in accordance with the list.

- [(8)]{.lawlabel} The following operational personnel shall hold copies
  of the flight training operations manual and shall be responsible for
  its amendment:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the chief flight instructor;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the assistant chief flight instructor;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the check instructor; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the person responsible for the maintenance control
    system or the approved maintenance organization.

- [(9)]{.lawlabel} The chief flight instructor shall make manuals
  available to all other operational personnel who are involved in
  operational control, including flight instructors, students and, if
  applicable, flight dispatchers.

- [(10)]{.lawlabel} Every person who has been provided with a copy of
  the appropriate parts of a flight training operations manual pursuant
  to subsections (7) and (8) shall keep it up to date by inserting in it
  the amendments provided and shall ensure that the appropriate parts
  are accessible when the person is performing assigned duties.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2006-352, s. 24
:::

##### [Training Manual]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991630 .Subheading}

- **[[406.62]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.62
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every flight training unit that
  conducts an integrated course shall establish and maintain a training
  manual that meets the personnel licensing standards.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The training manual may be issued in separate parts
  corresponding to specific aspects of the integrated course.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Whenever the training manual no longer meets the
  personnel licensing standards, the flight training unit shall amend it
  to bring it into compliance with the standards.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} A flight training unit shall submit to the Minister
  its training manual and, if they relate to the information required by
  the personnel licensing standards, any separately issued parts and any
  subsequent amendments to them or to the manual.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} If the personnel licensing standards are met, the
  Minister shall approve the parts of a training manual that relate to
  the information required by the personnel licensing standards and any
  subsequent amendments to the parts.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2006-352, s. 24
:::

##### [Certificate of Enrolment]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991639 .Subheading}

- **[[406.63]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.63
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A flight training unit that conducts
  an integrated course shall provide to each trainee, at the start of
  the course, a certificate of enrolment that meets the personnel
  licensing standards.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A flight training unit that conducts an integrated
  course shall maintain a current list of the trainees enrolled in each
  integrated course conducted by the flight training unit.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2006-352, s. 24
:::

##### [Course Completion Certificate]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991645 .Subheading}

**[[406.64]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.64 .sectionLabel}** A flight training
unit that conducts an integrated course shall provide to each trainee,
on successful completion of the course, a course completion certificate
that meets the personnel licensing standards.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2006-352, s. 24
- SOR/2015-160, s. 21(F)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-406.64-20061214.html "Link to previous version of section 406.64"){.PITLink}
:::

**\[406.65 to 406.70 reserved\]**

#### [Division VII --- Training]{.HTitleText3} {#h-991650 .Subheading}

##### [Operational Personnel Training Program]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991651 .Subheading}

- **[[406.71]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.71
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section,
  [[competency check]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a certification by the
  chief flight instructor or an instructor delegated by the chief flight
  instructor that a flight instructor conducting training under an
  integrated course has demonstrated in flight an ability to perform
  both normal and emergency manoeuvres appropriate to the most complex
  single-engined aeroplane to be used for the flight instruction.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A flight training unit that conducts flight training
  in accordance with a flight training operations manual that has been
  approved by the Minister shall establish and maintain a ground and
  flight training program for operational personnel as follows:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} indoctrination training is required upon employment
    for all persons assigned to an operational control function,
    including chief flight instructors, assistant chief flight
    instructors, flight instructors and persons responsible for flight
    following;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the training referred to in paragraph (a) shall
    ensure that persons involved in the control of flight operations are
    aware of their responsibilities, know reporting relationships and
    are competent to fulfil their assigned duties related to flight
    training operations;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the training referred to in paragraph (a) shall
    include a review of the flight training operations manual and the
    training manual, as applicable;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} each flight instructor who conducts training in
    accordance with an integrated course shall, before receiving
    authorization to conduct the training, successfully complete, under
    the supervision of the chief flight instructor, assistant chief
    flight instructor or check instructor,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the indoctrination training referred in paragraph
      (a),

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a review of, and a briefing on, the contents of
      the flight training operations manual and the training manual, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} an initial competency check in each type of
      aircraft in which the flight instructor conducts training in
      accordance with the integrated course; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} each flight instructor who conducts training in
    accordance with an integrated course shall, every 12 months after
    the month in which the initial competency check was completed,
    successfully complete

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a recurrent competency check in one of the
      aircraft in which the flight instructor conducts training in
      accordance with the integrated course,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} an in-flight monitoring of a training flight
      conducted by the flight instructor,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a flight test toward the issuance of a flight
      instructor rating, multi-engine class rating or instrument rating,
      or

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a competency check in accordance with Part VI or
      a pilot proficiency check in accordance with Part VII, as
      applicable.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2006-352, s. 24
- SOR/2014-131, s. 11
- SOR/2015-160, s. 22
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-406.71-20140529.html "Link to previous version of section 406.71"){.PITLink}
:::

**\[406.72 to 406.74 reserved\]**

#### [Division VIII --- Integrated Course]{.HTitleText3} {#h-991670 .Subheading}

##### [Requirements]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991671 .Subheading}

**[[406.75]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.75 .sectionLabel}** An integrated
course shall be conducted under the supervision of the chief flight
instructor of a flight training unit that holds a flight training unit
operator certificate and shall be arranged by that flight training unit
in accordance with the personnel licensing standards.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2006-352, s. 24
- SOR/2015-160, s. 23
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-406.75-20061214.html "Link to previous version of section 406.75"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Prerequisite]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991675 .Subheading}

**[[406.76]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.76 .sectionLabel}** The flight
training unit shall ensure that an applicant, before being admitted to
an integrated course, has a secondary school diploma or equivalent in
accordance with the personnel licensing standards.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2006-352, s. 24
:::

##### [Transfer]{.HTitleText4} {#h-991679 .Subheading}

**[[406.77]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-406.77 .sectionLabel}** Any trainee
wishing to transfer to another flight training unit during an integrated
course shall apply to the other flight training unit for a formal
assessment of the further hours of training required at that flight
training unit. The assessment shall be recorded in the applicant's
training record.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2006-352, s. 24
:::

**\[406.78 and 406.79 reserved\]**

### [Subpart 7 --- \[Reserved\]]{.HTitleText2} {#h-991684 .Subheading}

### [Subpart 8 --- Conduct of Flight Tests]{.HTitleText2} {#h-991685 .Subheading}

#### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-991686 .Subheading}

- **[[408.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-408.01
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Any reference in this Subpart to the
  flight testing standards is a reference to Standard 428 --- Personnel
  Licensing and Training Standards respecting the Conduct of Flight
  Tests.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions apply in this Subpart.

  [[air flight test item]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[air flight test item]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a flight test
      item performed using an aeroplane, helicopter or synthetic flight
      training equipment, including the pre-flight inspection, start-up,
      run-up, taxiing and emergency procedures. ([exercice en
      vol]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[examiner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[examiner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person designated by the
      Minister to conduct flight tests for the issuance or renewal of
      flight crew permits, licences or ratings for an aeroplane or
      helicopter. ([examinateur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[ground flight test item]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[ground flight test item]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a flight
      test item performed prior to the pre-flight inspection of the
      aeroplane or helicopter. ([exercice au sol]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2011-284, s. 16
:::

#### [Application]{.HTitleText3} {#h-991695 .Subheading}

**[[408.02]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-408.02 .sectionLabel}** This Subpart
applies in respect of the conduct, using an aeroplane, helicopter or
synthetic flight training equipment, of flight tests required for the
issuance or renewal of a flight crew permit, licence or rating.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2011-284, s. 16
:::

**\[408.03 to 408.10 reserved\]**

#### [Record of Flight Test]{.HTitleText3} {#h-991700 .Subheading}

**[[408.11]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-408.11 .sectionLabel}** The Minister
shall maintain a record of each flight test in accordance with this
Subpart and the flight testing standards. The record shall contain the
following information:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} an assessment of the results of each flight test
  item;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the overall results; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} whether the candidate passed or failed the flight
  test.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2011-284, s. 16
:::

#### [Prerequisite for Flight Test]{.HTitleText3} {#h-991707 .Subheading}

**[[408.12]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-408.12 .sectionLabel}** Before conducting
a flight test or partial re-test, the examiner shall ensure that they
have received the documentation specified in section 1 of Schedules 1 to
18 to the flight testing standards, dated, if applicable, as specified
in that section.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2011-284, s. 16
:::

#### [Aircraft and Equipment Required for a Flight Test]{.HTitleText3} {#h-991711 .Subheading}

**[[408.13]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-408.13 .sectionLabel}** The examiner
shall ensure that the candidate who takes a flight test provides the
aircraft and equipment described in section 2 of Schedules 1 to 18 to
the flight testing standards.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2011-284, s. 16
:::

#### [Flight Test]{.HTitleText3} {#h-991715 .Subheading}

- **[[408.14]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-408.14
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In the case of a flight test
  conducted in accordance with Schedules 1 to 8 to the flight testing
  standards, a candidate successfully completes the flight test if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the candidate completes all of the items set out in
    section 5 of those schedules; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the candidate receives at least the passing grade
    for the permit, licence or rating specified in the following table
    and does not fail any flight test item for any of the reasons set
    out in subsection 408.18(1).

  <figure id="991720">
  <table
  class="table table-hover table-striped tablePointsize8 topdouble topbot">

  <th class="noBorderRight borderBottom bottom" scope="col">Permit,
