##### [Controlled Airspace]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111666 .Subheading}

**[[901.14]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.14 .sectionLabel}** Subject to
subsection 901.71(1), no pilot shall operate a remotely piloted aircraft
in controlled airspace.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111672){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111672.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 53](#1516932-1527700){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516932-1527700.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-901.14-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.14"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Inadvertent Entry into Controlled Airspace]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111673 .Subheading}

**[[901.15]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.15 .sectionLabel}** A pilot of a
remotely piloted aircraft shall ensure that the appropriate air traffic
control unit, flight service station or user agency is notified
immediately any time the aircraft is no longer under the pilot's control
and inadvertently enters or is likely to enter into controlled airspace.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111676){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111676.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 53](#1516932-1527703){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516932-1527703.html"}
- [SOR/2025-98, s. 24](#1522570-1525642){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1522570-1525642.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-901.15-20250327.html "Link to previous version of section 901.15"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Flight Safety]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111677 .Subheading}

**[[901.16]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.16 .sectionLabel}** A pilot that
operates a remotely piloted aircraft system shall immediately cease
operations if aviation safety or the safety of any person is endangered
or likely to be endangered.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111680){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111680.html"}
:::

##### [Right of Way]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111681 .Subheading}

**[[901.17]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.17 .sectionLabel}** A pilot of a
remotely piloted aircraft shall give way to power-driven
heavier-than-air aircraft, airships, gliders and balloons at all times.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111684){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111684.html"}
:::

##### [Avoidance of Collision]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111685 .Subheading}

**[[901.18]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.18 .sectionLabel}** No pilot shall
operate a remotely piloted aircraft in such proximity to another
aircraft as to create a risk of collision.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111688){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111688.html"}
:::

##### [Fitness of Crew Members]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111689 .Subheading}

- **[[901.19]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.19
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall act as a crew member
  of a remotely piloted aircraft system if the person

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is suffering or is likely to suffer from fatigue;
    or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is otherwise unfit to perform properly the person's
    duties.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall act as a crew member of a remotely
  piloted aircraft system

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} within 12 hours after consuming an alcoholic
    beverage;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} while under the influence of alcohol; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} while using any drug that impairs the person's
    faculties to the extent that aviation safety or the safety of any
    person is endangered or likely to be endangered.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111699){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111699.html"}
:::

##### [Visual Observers]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111700 .Subheading}

- **[[901.20]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.20
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No pilot shall operate a remotely
  piloted aircraft system if visual observers are used to assist the
  pilot in detecting and avoiding conflicting air traffic and other
  hazards unless reliable and timely communication is maintained between
  the pilot and each visual observer during the operation.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A visual observer shall communicate information to
  the pilot in a timely manner, during the operation, whenever the
  visual observer detects conflicting air traffic, hazards to aviation
  safety or hazards to persons on the surface.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} No visual observer shall perform visual observer
  duties for more than one remotely piloted aircraft at a time unless
  the aircraft are operated in accordance with subsection 901.40(1) or
  in accordance with a special flight operations certificate --- RPAS
  issued under section 903.03.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} No visual observer shall perform visual observer
  duties while operating a moving vehicle, vessel or aircraft.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111707){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111707.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 55](#1516936-1527705){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516936-1527705.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-901.20-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.20"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Compliance with Instructions]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111708 .Subheading}

**[[901.21]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.21 .sectionLabel}** Every crew member
of a remotely piloted aircraft system shall, during flight time, comply
with the instructions of the pilot.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111711){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111711.html"}
:::

##### [Carriage of Persons]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111712 .Subheading}

**[[901.22]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.22 .sectionLabel}** No pilot shall
operate a remotely piloted aircraft that carries persons on board.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111715){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111715.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 56](#1516938-1527708){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516938-1527708.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-901.22-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.22"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Procedures]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111716 .Subheading}

- **[[901.23]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.23
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No pilot shall operate a remotely
  piloted aircraft system unless the following procedures are
  established:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} normal operating procedures, including pre-flight,
    take-off, launch, approach, landing and recovery procedures; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} emergency procedures, including with respect to

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a control station failure,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} an equipment failure,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a failure of the remotely piloted aircraft,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a loss of the command and control link,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} a fly-away,

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} flight termination, and

    - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} the detection and avoidance of conflicting air
      traffic and other hazards.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the manufacturer of the remotely piloted aircraft
  system or the person who has made a declaration referred to in section
  901.194 in respect of that model of system provides instructions with
  respect to the topics referred to in paragraphs (1)(a) and (b), the
  procedures established under subsection (1) shall reflect those
  instructions.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} No pilot shall conduct the take-off or launch of a
  remotely piloted aircraft unless the procedures referred to in
  subsection (1) are reviewed before the flight by, and are immediately
  available to, each crew member.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} No pilot shall operate a remotely piloted aircraft
  system unless the operation is conducted in accordance with the
  procedures referred to in subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111731){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111731.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 57](#1516943-1527713){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516943-1527713.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-901.23-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.23"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Pre-flight Information]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111732 .Subheading}

**[[901.24]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.24 .sectionLabel}** A pilot of a
remotely piloted aircraft shall, before commencing a flight, be familiar
with the information that is relevant to the intended flight, including

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the results of the site survey conducted under
  section 901.27;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} any declaration referred to in section 901.194 made
  in respect of the model of remotely piloted aircraft system to be used
  for the flight; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the qualifications of all crew members.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111735){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111735.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 58](#1516952-1527718){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516952-1527718.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-901.24-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.24"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Maximum Altitude]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111736 .Subheading}

- **[[901.25]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.25
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), no pilot
  shall operate a remotely piloted aircraft at an altitude greater than

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} 400 feet (122 m) AGL; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} 100 feet (30 m) above any building or structure, if
    the aircraft is being operated at a distance of less than 200 feet
    (61 m), measured horizontally, from the building or structure.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A pilot may operate a remotely piloted aircraft at an
  altitude greater than those set out in subsection (1) if the operation
  is conducted in accordance with a special flight operations
  certificate --- RPAS issued under section 903.03.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111743){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111743.html"}
:::

##### [Horizontal Distance]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111744 .Subheading}

**[[901.26]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.26 .sectionLabel}** Unless the
operation is conducted under Division V, no pilot shall operate

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a small remotely piloted aircraft to conduct a VLOS
  operation at a distance of less than 100 feet (30 m), measured
  horizontally and at any altitude, from any person not involved in the
  operation; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a medium remotely piloted aircraft to conduct a VLOS
  operation at a distance of less than 500 feet (152.4 m), measured
  horizontally and at any altitude, from any person not involved in the
  operation.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111747){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111747.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 59](#1516954-1527722){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516954-1527722.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-901.26-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.26"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Site Survey]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111748 .Subheading}

**[[901.27]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.27 .sectionLabel}** No pilot shall
operate a remotely piloted aircraft system unless, before commencing
operations, they determine that the site for take-off, launch, landing
or recovery is suitable for the proposed operation by conducting a site
survey that takes into account the following factors:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the boundaries of the area of operation;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the type of airspace and the applicable regulatory
  requirements;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the altitudes and routes to be used on the approach
  to and departure from the area of operation;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the proximity of manned aircraft operations;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the proximity of aerodromes, airports and heliports;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} the location and height of obstacles, including
  wires, masts, buildings, cell phone towers and wind turbines;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} the predominant weather and environmental conditions
  for the area of operation; and

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} the horizontal distances from persons not involved in
  the operation.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111759){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111759.html"}
:::

##### [Other Pre-flight Requirements]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111760 .Subheading}

**[[901.28]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.28 .sectionLabel}** A pilot of a
remotely piloted aircraft shall, before commencing a flight,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} ensure that there is a sufficient amount of fuel or
  energy for safe completion of the flight;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} ensure that each crew member, before acting as a crew
  member, has been instructed

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} with respect to the duties that the crew member is
    to perform, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} on the location and use of any emergency equipment
    associated with the operation of the remotely piloted aircraft
    system; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} determine the maximum distance from the pilot the
  aircraft can travel without endangering aviation safety or the safety
  of any person.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111768){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111768.html"}
:::

##### [Serviceability of the Remotely Piloted Aircraft System]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111769 .Subheading}

**[[901.29]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.29 .sectionLabel}** No pilot shall
conduct the take-off or launch of a remotely piloted aircraft, or permit
the take-off or launch of a remotely piloted aircraft to be conducted,
unless the pilot ensures that

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the aircraft is serviceable;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the remotely piloted aircraft system has been
  maintained, and all mandatory actions have been completed, in
  accordance with the instructions of the manufacturer or of the person
  who has made a declaration referred to in section 901.194 in respect
  of that model of system; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} all equipment required by these Regulations or the
  manufacturer's instructions, including any system element necessary to
  support the operation of the remotely piloted aircraft system, is
  installed, if applicable, and serviceable.

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2025-70, s. 61\]]{.Repealed}

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111776){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111776.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 61](#1516958-1527725){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516958-1527725.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-901.29-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.29"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Availability of Manuals]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111777 .Subheading}

- **[[901.30]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.30
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No pilot shall conduct the take-off
  or launch of a remotely piloted aircraft unless the operating manuals
  applicable to the remotely piloted aircraft system of which the
  aircraft is an element are immediately available to crew members.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No pilot shall conduct the take-off or launch of a
  remotely piloted aircraft to conduct a BVLOS operation under Division
  VI unless the RPAS operator's RPAS operations manual is immediately
  available to crew members.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111780){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111780.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 62](#1516960-1527731){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516960-1527731.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-901.30-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.30"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Manufacturer's Instructions]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111781 .Subheading}

**[[901.31]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.31 .sectionLabel}** No pilot shall
operate a remotely piloted aircraft system unless it is operated in
accordance with the manufacturer's instructions.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111784){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111784.html"}
:::

##### [Control of Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111785 .Subheading}

**[[901.32]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.32 .sectionLabel}** No pilot shall
operate a remotely piloted aircraft system that is not designed to allow
pilot intervention in the management of a flight.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111788){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111788.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 64](#1516964-1527733){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516964-1527733.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-901.32-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.32"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Take-offs, Launches, Approaches, Landings and Recovery]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111789 .Subheading}

**[[901.33]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.33 .sectionLabel}** A pilot of a
remotely piloted aircraft shall, before take-off, launch, approach,
landing or recovery,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} ensure that there is no likelihood of collision with
  another aircraft, person or obstacle; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} ensure that the site set aside for take-off, launch,
  landing or recovery, as the case may be, is suitable for the intended
  operation.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111794){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111794.html"}
:::

##### [Minimum Weather Conditions]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111795 .Subheading}

- **[[901.34]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.34
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No pilot shall operate a remotely
  piloted aircraft to conduct a VLOS operation unless the weather
  conditions at the time of flight permit

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the operation to be conducted in accordance with
    the operating manuals applicable to the remotely piloted aircraft
    system of which the aircraft is an element; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the pilot or any visual observer to conduct the
    entire flight in visual-line-of-sight.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the ground visibility is four miles or less, no
  pilot shall operate a medium remotely piloted aircraft to conduct a
  VLOS operation at a distance of more than half of the ground
  visibility unless the operation is conducted in accordance with a
  special flight operations certificate --- RPAS issued under section
  903.03.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (4), no pilot shall operate a
  remotely piloted aircraft to conduct a BVLOS operation unless ground
  visibility is not less than three miles and the aircraft is operated
  clear of cloud.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} A pilot may operate a remotely piloted aircraft to
  conduct a BVLOS operation in cloud or when the ground visibility is
  less than three miles if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a declaration referred to in section 901.194 has
    been made in respect of the model of remotely piloted aircraft
    system of which the aircraft is an element and in respect of the
    technical requirements set out in section 922.10 of Standard 922 and
    the operating manuals applicable to the system allow for operation
    in those conditions; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the operation is conducted in accordance with a
    special flight operations certificate --- RPAS issued under section
    903.03.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111800){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111800.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 65](#1516966-1527743){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516966-1527743.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-901.34-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.34"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Icing]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111801 .Subheading}

- **[[901.35]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.35
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No pilot shall operate a remotely
  piloted aircraft system when icing conditions are observed, are
  reported to exist or are likely to be encountered along the route of
  flight unless the aircraft is equipped with de-icing or anti-icing
  equipment or the pilot has a means to detect icing.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No pilot shall operate a remotely piloted aircraft
  system with frost, ice or snow adhering to any of the critical
  surfaces of the remotely piloted aircraft.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (2), [[critical
  surfaces]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the wings, control surfaces,
  rotors, propellers, horizontal stabilizers, vertical stabilizers or
  any other stabilizing surfaces of the remotely piloted aircraft, as
  well as any other surfaces identified as critical surfaces in the
  operating manuals applicable to the system.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111806){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111806.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 66](#1516968-1527748){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516968-1527748.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-901.35-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.35"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Formation Flight]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111807 .Subheading}

**[[901.36]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.36 .sectionLabel}** No pilot shall
operate a remotely piloted aircraft in formation with other aircraft
except by pre-arrangement between the pilots of the aircraft in respect
of the intended flight.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111810){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111810.html"}
:::

##### [Prohibition --- Operation of Moving Vehicles, Vessels and Manned Aircraft]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111811 .Subheading}

**[[901.37]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.37 .sectionLabel}** No pilot shall
operate a remotely piloted aircraft while operating a moving vehicle,
vessel or manned aircraft.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111814){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111814.html"}
:::

##### [Use of First-person View Devices]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111815 .Subheading}

- **[[901.38]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.38
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No pilot shall operate a remotely
  piloted aircraft system using a first-person view device unless a
  visual observer maintains unaided visual contact with the airspace in
  which the remotely piloted aircraft is operating in order to detect
  conflicting air traffic and other hazards and take action to avoid
  them.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), [[first-person
  view device]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a device that generates and
  transmits a streaming video image to a control station display or
  monitor, giving the pilot of a remotely piloted aircraft the illusion
  of flying the aircraft from an onboard pilot's perspective.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111818){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111818.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 67](#1516970-1527756){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516970-1527756.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-901.38-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.38"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Night Flight Requirements]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111819 .Subheading}

- **[[901.39]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.39
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No pilot shall operate a remotely
  piloted aircraft system at night unless the remotely piloted aircraft
  is equipped with lights that are sufficient to allow the aircraft to
  be visible to the pilot or a visual observer, whether with or without
  night-vision goggles, and those lights are turned on.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No pilot shall operate a remotely piloted aircraft
  system using night-vision goggles unless the goggles are capable of,
  or the person has another means of, detecting all light within the
  visual spectrum.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111824){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111824.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 69](#1516977-1527758){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516977-1527758.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-901.39-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.39"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Multiple Remotely Piloted Aircraft]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111825 .Subheading}

- **[[901.40]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.40
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (2) and (3),
  no pilot shall operate more than one remotely piloted aircraft at a
  time unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the aircraft are operated to conduct a VLOS
    operation;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the aircraft are operated in accordance with the
    operating manuals applicable to the remotely piloted aircraft
    system;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the remotely piloted aircraft system is designed to
    permit the operation of multiple aircraft from a single control
    station; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} no more than five aircraft are operated at a time.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A pilot may operate more than five remotely piloted
  aircraft at a time if the operation is conducted in accordance with a
  special flight operations certificate --- RPAS issued under section
  903.03.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} A pilot may operate more than one remotely piloted
  aircraft at a time to conduct an operation that is not a VLOS
  operation if the operation is conducted in accordance with a special
  flight operations certificate --- RPAS issued under section 903.03.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111830){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111830.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 70](#1516979-1527767){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516979-1527767.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-901.40-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.40"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Advertised Events]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111831 .Subheading}

- **[[901.41]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.41
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No pilot shall operate a remotely
  piloted aircraft system at any advertised event except in accordance
  with a special flight operations certificate --- RPAS issued under
  section 903.03.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to the operation of a
  remotely piloted aircraft system for the purpose of an operation to
  save human life, a police operation, a fire-fighting operation or any
  other operation that is conducted in the service of a public
  authority.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111836){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111836.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 70](#1516979-1527772){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516979-1527772.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-901.41-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.41"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Handovers]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111837 .Subheading}

**[[901.42]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.42 .sectionLabel}** No pilot shall
hand over their responsibilities to another pilot during flight unless,
before the take-off or launch of a remotely piloted aircraft,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a pre-arrangement in respect of the handover has been
  made between the pilots; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a procedure has been developed to mitigate the risk
  of loss of control of the aircraft.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111842){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111842.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 71(F)](#1516981-1527773){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516981-1527773.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-901.42-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.42"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Payloads]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111843 .Subheading}

- **[[901.43]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.43
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), no pilot
  shall operate a remotely piloted aircraft system if the aircraft is
  transporting a payload that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} includes explosive, corrosive, flammable, or
    bio-hazardous material;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} includes weapons, ammunition or other equipment
    designed for use in war;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} could create a hazard to aviation safety or cause
    injury to persons; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} is attached to the aircraft by means of a line,
    unless the operation is conducted in accordance with the operating
    manuals applicable to the system.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A pilot may operate a remotely piloted aircraft
  system when the aircraft is transporting a payload referred to in
  subsection (1) if the operation is conducted in accordance with a
  special flight operations certificate --- RPAS issued under section
  903.03.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111852){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111852.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 72](#1516983-1527775){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516983-1527775.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-901.43-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.43"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Flight Termination System]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111853 .Subheading}

**[[901.44]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.44 .sectionLabel}** No pilot shall
activate a system that terminates the flight of a remotely piloted
aircraft if it will endanger or will likely endanger aviation safety or
the safety of any person.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111856){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111856.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 73](#1516987-1527777){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516987-1527777.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-901.44-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.44"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [ELT]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111857 .Subheading}

**[[901.45]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.45 .sectionLabel}** No pilot shall
operate a remotely piloted aircraft equipped with an ELT.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111860){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111860.html"}
:::

##### [Transponder and Automatic Pressure-altitude Reporting Equipment]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111861 .Subheading}

- **[[901.46]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.46
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), no pilot
  shall operate a remotely piloted aircraft system if the aircraft is in
  the transponder airspace referred to in section 601.03 unless the
  aircraft is equipped with a transponder and automatic
  pressure-altitude reporting equipment.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} An air traffic control unit may authorize a pilot to
  operate a remotely piloted aircraft that is not equipped in accordance
  with subsection (1) within the airspace referred to in section 601.03
  if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the air traffic control unit provides an air
    traffic control service in respect of that airspace;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the pilot made a request to the air traffic control
    unit to operate the aircraft within that airspace before the
    aircraft entered the airspace; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} aviation safety is not likely to be affected.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111869){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111869.html"}
:::

##### [Operations at or in the Vicinity of an Aerodrome, Airport or Heliport]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111870 .Subheading}

- **[[901.47]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.47
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No pilot shall operate a remotely
  piloted aircraft at or near an aerodrome that is listed in the Canada
  Flight Supplement or the Water Aerodrome Supplement in a manner that
  could interfere with an aircraft operating in the established traffic
  pattern.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section 901.73, no pilot shall operate a
  remotely piloted aircraft to conduct a VLOS operation if the aircraft
  is at a distance of less than

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} three nautical miles from the centre of an airport;
    and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} one nautical mile from the centre of a heliport.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} No pilot shall operate a remotely piloted aircraft to
  conduct a BVLOS operation if the aircraft is at a distance of less
  than five nautical miles from the centre of an aerodrome that is
  listed in the Canada Flight Supplement or the Water Aerodrome
  Supplement unless the operation is conducted in accordance with a
  special flight operations certificate --- RPAS issued under section
  903.03.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} No pilot shall operate a remotely piloted aircraft if
  the aircraft is at a distance of less than three nautical miles from
  the centre of an aerodrome operated under the authority of the
  Minister of National Defence unless authorized to do so by the
  Department of National Defence.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111878){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111878.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 74](#1516989-1527783){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516989-1527783.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-901.47-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.47"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Records]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111879 .Subheading}

- **[[901.48]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.48
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every owner of a remotely piloted
  aircraft system shall keep the following records:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a record containing the names of the pilots and
    other crew members who are involved in each flight and, in respect
    of the system, the time of each flight or series of flights; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a record containing the particulars of any
    mandatory action and any other maintenance action, modification or
    repair performed on the system, including

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the names of the persons who performed them,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the dates they were undertaken,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a modification, the
      manufacturer, model and a description of the part or equipment
      installed to modify the system, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} if applicable, any instructions provided to
      complete the work.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Every owner of a remotely piloted aircraft system
  shall ensure that the records referred to in subsection (1) are made
  available to the Minister on request and are retained for a period of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of the records referred to in paragraph
    (1)(a), 12 months after the day on which they are created; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of the records referred to in paragraph
    (1)(b), 24 months after the day on which they are created.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Every owner of a remotely piloted aircraft system who
  transfers ownership of the system to another person shall, at the time
  of transfer, also deliver to that person all of the records referred
  to in paragraph (1)(b).

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111893){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111893.html"}
:::

##### [Incidents and Accidents --- Associated Measures]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111894 .Subheading}

- **[[901.49]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.49
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A pilot that operates a remotely
  piloted aircraft system shall immediately cease operations if any of
  the following incidents or accidents occurs until such time as an
  analysis is undertaken as to the cause of the occurrence and
  corrective actions have been taken to mitigate the risk of recurrence:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} injuries to any person requiring medical attention;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} unintended contact between the aircraft and
    persons;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} unanticipated damage incurred to the airframe,
    control station, payload or command and control links that adversely
    affects the performance or flight characteristics of the aircraft;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} any time the aircraft is not kept within horizontal
    boundaries or altitude limits;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} any collision with or risk of collision with
    another aircraft;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} any time the aircraft becomes uncontrollable,
    experiences a fly-away or is missing; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} any incident not referred to in paragraphs (a)
    to (f) for which a police report has been filed or for which a Civil
    Aviation Daily Occurrence Report has resulted.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The pilot of the remotely piloted aircraft system
  shall keep, and make available to the Minister on request, a record of
  any analyses undertaken under subsection (1) for a period of 12 months
  after the day on which the record is created.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111906){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111906.html"}
:::

##### [Dropping of Objects]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1527784 .Subheading}

**[[901.50]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.50 .sectionLabel}** No pilot shall
create a hazard to persons or property on the surface by dropping an
object from a remotely piloted aircraft in flight.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 75](#1516991-1527790){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516991-1527790.html"}
:::

##### [Service Difficulty Reporting]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1527791 .Subheading}

**[[901.51]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.51 .sectionLabel}** The pilot of a
remotely piloted aircraft system of a model for which a declaration
referred to in section 901.194 has been made and for which an acceptance
letter has been issued under section 901.196 shall ensure that any
reportable service difficulty that is discovered with respect to the
system is reported to the person who has made the declaration as soon as
feasible after the discovery.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 75](#1516991-1527794){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516991-1527794.html"}
:::

**\[901.52 reserved\]**

#### [Division IV --- Basic Operations]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1111908 .Subheading}

##### [Application]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111909 .Subheading}

**[[901.53]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.53 .sectionLabel}** This Division
applies in respect of the operation of small remotely piloted aircraft
to conduct a VLOS operation in uncontrolled airspace and at a distance
of not less than 100 feet (30 m), measured horizontally and at any
altitude, from any person not involved in the operation.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111912){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111912.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 76](#1516993-1527797){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516993-1527797.html"}
:::

[Previous
Version](section-901.53-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.53"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Pilot Requirements]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111913 .Subheading}

- **[[901.54]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.54
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), no person
  shall operate a remotely piloted aircraft system under this Division
  unless the person

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is at least 14 years of age; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} holds

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a pilot certificate --- small remotely piloted
      aircraft (VLOS) --- basic operations issued under section 901.55,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a pilot certificate --- remotely piloted
      aircraft --- advanced operations issued under section 901.64, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a pilot certificate --- remotely piloted
      aircraft --- level 1 complex operations issued under section
      901.90.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply if the operation of the
  remotely piloted aircraft system is conducted under the direct
  supervision of a person who is permitted to operate such a system
  under this Division, Division V or Division VI.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111922){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111922.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 77](#1516995-1527803){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1516995-1527803.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-901.54-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.54"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Issuance of Pilot Certificate --- Small Remotely Piloted Aircraft (VLOS) --- Basic Operations]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111923 .Subheading}

**[[901.55]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.55 .sectionLabel}** The Minister
shall, on receipt of an application, issue a pilot certificate --- small
remotely piloted aircraft (VLOS) --- basic operations if the applicant
demonstrates to the Minister that the applicant

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} is at least 14 years of age; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} has successfully completed the examination "Remotely
  Piloted Aircraft Systems --- Basic Operations" in accordance with the
  document entitled Knowledge Requirements for Pilots of Remotely
  Piloted Aircraft Systems, 250 g up to and including 150 kg, Basic and
  Advanced Operations, TP 15263, published by the Minister.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111928){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111928.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 78](#1517000-1527805){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1517000-1527805.html"}
:::

[Previous
Version](section-901.55-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.55"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Recency Requirements]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111929 .Subheading}

- **[[901.56]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.56
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No holder of a pilot certificate ---
  small remotely piloted aircraft (VLOS) --- basic operations, a pilot
  certificate --- remotely piloted aircraft --- advanced operations or a
  pilot certificate --- remotely piloted aircraft --- level 1 complex
  operations shall operate a remotely piloted aircraft system under this
  Division unless the holder has, within the 24 months preceding the
  flight,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} been issued a pilot certificate --- small remotely
    piloted aircraft (VLOS) --- basic operations under section 901.55, a
    pilot certificate --- remotely piloted aircraft --- advanced
    operations under section 901.64 or a pilot certificate --- remotely
    piloted aircraft --- level 1 complex operations under section
    901.90; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} successfully completed

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} any of the examinations referred to in paragraph
      901.55(b), 901.64(b) or 901.90(d),

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any of the flight reviews referred to in
      paragraph 901.64(c) or 901.90(e), or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} any of the recurrent training activities set
      out in section 921.04 of Standard 921 --- Remotely Piloted
      Aircraft.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The person referred to in subsection (1) shall keep a
  record of all activities referred to in paragraph (1)(b), including
  the dates on which they were completed, for at least 24 months after
  the day on which they were completed.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111939){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111939.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 79](#1517002-1527812){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1517002-1527812.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-901.56-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.56"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Access to Certificate and Proof of Recency]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111940 .Subheading}

**[[901.57]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.57 .sectionLabel}** No pilot shall
operate a remotely piloted aircraft system under this Division unless
both of the following are easily accessible to the pilot during the
operation of the system:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the pilot certificate --- small remotely piloted
  aircraft (VLOS) --- basic operations issued under section 901.55, the
  pilot certificate --- remotely piloted aircraft --- advanced
  operations issued under section 901.64 or the pilot certificate ---
  remotely piloted aircraft --- level 1 complex operations issued under
  section 901.90; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} documentation demonstrating that the pilot meets the
  recency requirements set out in section 901.56.

##### [Examination Rules]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111946 .Subheading}

**[[901.58]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.58 .sectionLabel}** No person shall,
in respect of an examination taken under this Division,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} copy or remove from any place all or any portion of
  the text of the examination;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} give help to or accept help from any person during
  the examination, unless authorized by the Minister for accommodation
  purposes; or

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} complete all or any portion of the examination on
  behalf of any other person.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111952){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111952.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 81](#1517009-1527816){.wb-lbx

##### [Retaking of Examination]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111953 .Subheading}

**[[901.59]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.59 .sectionLabel}** No person who
fails an examination taken under this Division shall retake the
examination for a period of 24 hours after the examination.

#### [Division V --- Advanced Operations]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1111958 .Subheading}

##### [Application]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111959 .Subheading}

**[[901.62]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.62 .sectionLabel}** This Division
applies in respect of the following operations of a remotely piloted
aircraft system:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the operation of a small remotely piloted aircraft to
  conduct a VLOS operation

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in controlled airspace,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} at a distance of less than 100 feet (30 m) but not
    less than 16.4 feet (5 m), measured horizontally and at any
    altitude, from any person not involved in the operation,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} at a distance of less than 16.4 feet (5 m),
    measured horizontally and at any altitude, from any person not
    involved in the operation, or

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} within three nautical miles from the centre of an
    airport or within one nautical mile from the centre of a heliport;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the operation of a small remotely piloted aircraft to
  conduct an extended VLOS operation in uncontrolled airspace;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the operation of a small remotely piloted aircraft to
  conduct a sheltered operation;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the operation of a medium remotely piloted aircraft
  to conduct a VLOS operation in uncontrolled airspace and at a distance
  of 500 feet (152.4 m) or more, measured horizontally and at any
  altitude, from any person not involved in the operation;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the operation of a medium remotely piloted aircraft
  to conduct a VLOS operation in uncontrolled airspace and at a distance
  of less than 500 feet (152.4 m) but not less than 100 feet (30 m),
  measured horizontally and at any altitude, from any person not
  involved in the operation;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} the operation of a medium remotely piloted aircraft
  to conduct a VLOS operation at a distance of less than 100 feet
  (30 m), measured horizontally and at any altitude, from any person not
  involved in the operation; and

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} the operation of a medium remotely piloted aircraft
  to conduct a VLOS operation in controlled airspace.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1111966){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1111966.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 83](#1517013-1527832){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1517013-1527832.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-901.62-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.62"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Pilot Requirements]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111967 .Subheading}

- **[[901.63]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.63
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), no person
  shall operate a remotely piloted aircraft system under this Division
  unless the person

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is at least 16 years of age; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} holds either

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a pilot certificate --- remotely piloted aircraft
      --- advanced operations issued under section 901.64, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a pilot certificate --- remotely piloted
      aircraft --- level 1 complex operations issued under section
      901.90.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply if the operation of the
  remotely piloted aircraft system is conducted under the direct
  supervision of a person who is permitted to operate such a system
  under this Division or Division VI.

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} is at least 16 years of age;

##### [Recency Requirements]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111984 .Subheading}

- **[[901.65]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.65
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No holder of a pilot certificate ---
  remotely piloted aircraft --- advanced operations or a pilot
  certificate --- remotely piloted aircraft --- level 1 complex
  operations shall operate a remotely piloted aircraft system under this
  Division unless the holder has, within the 24 months preceding the
  flight,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} been issued a pilot certificate --- remotely
    piloted aircraft --- advanced operations under section 901.64 or a
    pilot certificate --- remotely piloted aircraft --- level 1 complex
    operations under section 901.90; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} successfully completed

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} any of the examinations referred to in paragraph
      901.55(b), 901.64(b) or 901.90(d),

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any of the flight reviews referred to in
      paragraph 901.64(c) or 901.90(e), or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} any of the recurrent training activities set
      out in section 921.04 of Standard 921 --- Remotely Piloted
      Aircraft.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The person referred to in subsection (1) shall keep a
  record of all activities completed in accordance with paragraph
  (1)(b), including the dates on which they were completed, for at least
  24 months after the day on which they were completed.

##### [Access to Certificate and Proof of Recency]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1111995 .Subheading}

**[[901.66]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.66 .sectionLabel}** No pilot shall
operate a remotely piloted aircraft system under this Division unless
both of the following are easily accessible during the operation of the
system:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the pilot certificate --- remotely piloted aircraft
  --- advanced operations issued under section 901.64 or the pilot
  certificate --- remotely piloted aircraft --- level 1 complex
  operations issued under section 901.90; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} documentation demonstrating that the pilot meets the
  recency requirements set out in section 901.65.

**[[901.67]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.67 .sectionLabel}** No person shall
commit an act referred to in paragraphs 901.58(a) to (c) in respect of
an examination taken under this Division.

**[[901.68]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.68 .sectionLabel}** No person who
fails an examination or a flight review taken under this Division shall
retake the examination or flight review for a period of 24 hours after
the examination or review.

##### [Declaration --- Permitted Operations]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1112009 .Subheading}

**[[901.69]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.69 .sectionLabel}** No pilot shall
operate a remotely piloted aircraft system under this Division to
conduct any of the following operations unless a declaration to the
Minister has been made in accordance with section 901.194 in respect of
that model of system and in respect of each of the technical
requirements set out in Standard 922 that is applicable to the
operation:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the VLOS operation of a small remotely piloted
  aircraft in controlled airspace;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the VLOS operation of a small remotely piloted
  aircraft at a distance of less than 100 feet (30 m) but not less than
  16.4 feet (5 m), measured horizontally and at any altitude, from any
  person not involved in the operation;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the VLOS operation of a small remotely piloted
  aircraft at a distance of less than 16.4 feet (5 m), measured
  horizontally and at any altitude, from any person not involved in the
  operation;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the operation of a small remotely piloted aircraft to
  conduct a sheltered operation in controlled airspace;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the VLOS operation of a medium remotely piloted
  aircraft at a distance of 500 feet (152.4 m) or more, measured
  horizontally and at any altitude, from any person not involved in the
  operation;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} the VLOS operation of a medium remotely piloted
  aircraft at a distance of less than 500 feet (152.4 m) but not less
  than 100 feet (30 m), measured horizontally and at any altitude, from
  any person not involved in the operation;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} the VLOS operation of a medium remotely piloted
  aircraft at a distance of less than 100 feet (30 m), measured
  horizontally and at any altitude, from any person not involved in the
  operation; or

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} the VLOS operation of a medium remotely piloted
  aircraft in controlled airspace.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1112017){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1112017.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 89](#1517028-1527863){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1517028-1527863.html"}
:::

Version](section-901.69-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.69"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Operation of a Modified Remotely Piloted Aircraft System]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1112018 .Subheading}

- **[[901.70]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.70
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No pilot shall conduct any of the
  operations described in section 901.69 using a remotely piloted
  aircraft system that has been modified in any way unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the pilot is able to demonstrate to the Minister
    that, despite the modification, the system continues to meet the
    technical requirements set out in Standard 922 that are applicable
    to the operation; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if applicable, the modification was performed in
    accordance with the instructions of the manufacturer of the part or
    equipment used to modify the system.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No pilot shall conduct an operation described in
  paragraph 901.69(f) or (g) using a remotely piloted aircraft system
  that has been modified in any way unless the modification was
  performed in accordance with the instructions of the person who has
  made a declaration referred to in 901.194 in respect of that model of
  system.

::: HistoricalNote

##### [Operations in Controlled Airspace]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1112024 .Subheading}

- **[[901.71]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.71
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No pilot shall operate a remotely
  piloted aircraft in controlled airspace under this Division unless an
  authorization has been issued by the provider of air traffic services
  in the area of operation and, if requested, the following information
  has been provided to that provider:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the date, time and duration of the operation;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the category, registration number and physical
    characteristics of the aircraft;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the vertical and horizontal boundaries of the area
    of operation;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2025-70, s. 91\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2025-70, s. 91\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2025-70, s. 91\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the name, contact information and pilot certificate
    number of any pilot of the aircraft;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the procedures and flight profiles to be followed
    in the case of a lost command and control link;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the procedures to be followed in emergency
    situations;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} the process and the time required to terminate the
    operation; and

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} any other information required by the provider of
    air traffic services that is necessary for the provision of air
    traffic management.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite section 901.25, a pilot may operate a
  remotely piloted aircraft in controlled airspace under this Division
  at an altitude above those referred to in that section if an
  authorization to that effect has been issued by the provider of air
  traffic services in the area of operation.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} No pilot shall operate a remotely piloted aircraft in
  controlled airspace under this Division unless the authorization
  referred to in subsection (1) is easily accessible to the pilot during
  the operation.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1112040){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1112040.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 91](#1517032-1527874){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1517032-1527874.html"}
:::

Version](section-901.71-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.71"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Compliance with Air Traffic Control Instructions]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1112041 .Subheading}

**[[901.72]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.72 .sectionLabel}** The pilot of a
remotely piloted aircraft operating in controlled airspace under this
Division shall comply with all of the air traffic control instructions
directed at the pilot.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1112044){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1112044.html"}
:::

##### [Operations at or in the Vicinity of an Airport or Heliport --- Established Procedure]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1112045 .Subheading}

**[[901.73]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.73 .sectionLabel}** No pilot shall
operate a remotely piloted aircraft system under this Division if the
remotely piloted aircraft is at a distance of less than three nautical
miles from the centre of an airport or less than one nautical mile from
the centre of a heliport unless the operation is conducted in accordance
with the established procedure with respect to the safe use of remotely
piloted aircraft systems that is applicable to that airport or heliport.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1112048){.wb-lbx

##### [Extended VLOS Operations and Sheltered Operations]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1527878 .Subheading}

- **[[901.74]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.74
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No pilot shall operate a remotely
  piloted aircraft system under this Division to conduct an extended
  VLOS operation or a sheltered operation unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the pilot and control station are located at the
    site set aside for take-off, launch, landing or recovery at the time
    of those activities;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the remotely piloted aircraft is at a distance of
    not more than two nautical miles from the pilot, the control station
    and the visual observer at any time during the flight; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the operation is conducted at a distance of at
    least 100 feet (30 m), measured horizontally and at any altitude,
    from any person not involved in the operation.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No pilot shall operate a remotely piloted aircraft
  system under this Division to conduct an extended VLOS operation
  unless a visual observer maintains unaided visual contact with the
  airspace in which the remotely piloted aircraft is operating in a
  manner sufficient to detect conflicting air traffic and other hazards
  and take action to avoid them.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 93](#1517040-1527886){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1517040-1527886.html"}
:::

##### [Visual Observers]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1527887 .Subheading}

**[[901.75]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.75 .sectionLabel}** No visual
observer shall perform visual observer duties with respect to an
extended VLOS operation under this Division unless they

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} hold

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a pilot certificate --- small remotely piloted
    aircraft (VLOS) --- basic operations issued under section 901.55,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a pilot certificate --- remotely piloted aircraft
    --- advanced operations issued under section 901.64, or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a pilot certificate --- remotely piloted aircraft
    --- level 1 complex operations issued under section 901.90;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} maintain unaided visual contact with the airspace in
  which the remotely piloted aircraft is operating in a manner
  sufficient to detect conflicting air traffic and other hazards and
  take action to avoid them; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} remain at a distance of not more than two nautical
  miles from the remotely piloted aircraft at all times during the
  flight.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 93](#1517040-1527896){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1517040-1527896.html"}
:::

#### [Division VI --- Level 1 Complex Operations]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1527920 .Subheading}

##### [Application]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1527921 .Subheading}

**[[901.87]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.87 .sectionLabel}** This Division
applies in respect of the following operations of a remotely piloted
aircraft system:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the operation of a small remotely piloted aircraft or
  a medium remotely piloted aircraft to conduct a BVLOS operation in
  uncontrolled airspace and at a distance of not less than 1 km from a
  populated area; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the operation of a small remotely piloted aircraft to
  conduct a BVLOS operation in uncontrolled airspace over a sparsely
  populated area or at a distance of less than 1 km from a populated
  area.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-11, s. 23](#1045417-1112130){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045417-1112130.html"}
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 94](#1517042-1527925){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1517042-1527925.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-901.87-20190109.html "Link to previous version of section 901.87"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Requirement for RPAS Operator Certificate]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1527926 .Subheading}

**[[901.88]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.88 .sectionLabel}** No person shall
operate a remotely piloted aircraft system under this Division unless
the person

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} is an RPAS operator or an employee, an agent or
  mandatary or a representative of an RPAS operator; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} complies with the conditions in the RPAS operator
  certificate issued to the RPAS operator.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 94](#1517042-1527931){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1517042-1527931.html"}
:::

##### [Pilot Requirements]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1527932 .Subheading}

- **[[901.89]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.89
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), no person
  shall operate a remotely piloted aircraft system under this Division
  unless the person

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is at least 18 years of age; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} holds a pilot certificate --- remotely piloted
    aircraft --- level 1 complex operations issued under section 901.90.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply if the operation of the
  remotely piloted aircraft system is for the purpose of training and is
  conducted under the direct supervision of a person who is 18 years of
  age or older and who is permitted to operate a remotely piloted
  aircraft system under this Division.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 94](#1517042-1527946){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1517042-1527946.html"}
:::

##### [Issuance of Pilot Certificate --- Remotely Piloted Aircraft --- Level 1 Complex Operations]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1527947 .Subheading}

**[[901.90]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.90 .sectionLabel}** The Minister
shall, on receipt of an application, issue a pilot certificate ---
remotely piloted aircraft --- level 1 complex operations if the
applicant demonstrates to the Minister that the applicant

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} is at least 18 years of age;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} has successfully completed the examination "Remotely
  Piloted Aircraft Systems --- Advanced Operations" in accordance with
  the document entitled Knowledge Requirements for Pilots of Remotely
  Piloted Aircraft Systems, 250 g up to and including 150 kg, Basic and
  Advanced Operations, TP 15263, published by the Minister;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} has completed 20 hours of RPAS ground school
  instruction delivered by a training provider referred to in section
  901.182 and covering the subjects set out in the document entitled
  Knowledge Requirements for Pilots of Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems
  --- Level 1 Complex Operations, TP 15530, published by the Minister;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} has, after completion of the instruction referred to
  in paragraph (c), successfully completed the examination "Remotely
  Piloted Aircraft Systems --- Level 1 Complex Operations" in accordance
  with the document entitled Knowledge Requirements for Pilots of
  Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems --- Level 1 Complex Operations, TP
  15530, published by the Minister; and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} has, within 12 months before the date of application,
  successfully completed a flight review in accordance with section
  921.07 of Standard 921 --- Remotely Piloted Aircraft conducted by a
  person qualified to act as a flight reviewer under subsection
  901.175(2).

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 94](#1517042-1527955){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1517042-1527955.html"}
:::

##### [Recency Requirements]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1527956 .Subheading}

**[[901.91]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.91 .sectionLabel}** No holder of a
pilot certificate --- remotely piloted aircraft --- level 1 complex
operations shall operate a remotely piloted aircraft system under this
Division unless the holder has, within the 24 months preceding the
flight,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} been issued a pilot certificate --- remotely piloted
  aircraft --- level 1 complex operations under section 901.90; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} successfully completed

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} any of the examinations referred to in paragraph
    901.55(b), 901.64(b) or 901.90(d),

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any of the flight reviews referred to in paragraph
    901.64(c) or 901.90(e), or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} any of the recurrent training activities set out
    in section 921.04 of Standard 921 --- Remotely Piloted Aircraft.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 94](#1517042-1527972){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1517042-1527972.html"}
:::

##### [Access to Certificate and Proof]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1527973 .Subheading}

**[[901.92]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.92 .sectionLabel}** No pilot shall
operate a remotely piloted aircraft system under this Division unless
the following are easily accessible during the operation:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the pilot certificate --- remotely piloted aircraft
  --- level 1 complex operations issued under section 901.90; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} documentation demonstrating that the pilot meets the
  recency requirements set out in section 901.91.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 94](#1517042-1527978){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1517042-1527978.html"}
:::

##### [Examination Rules]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1527979 .Subheading}

**[[901.93]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.93 .sectionLabel}** No person shall
commit an act referred to in paragraphs 901.58(a) to (c) in respect of
an examination taken under this Division.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 94](#1517042-1527982){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1517042-1527982.html"}
:::

##### [Retaking of an Examination or Flight Review]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1527983 .Subheading}

**[[901.94]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.94 .sectionLabel}** No person who
fails an examination or a flight review taken under this Division shall
retake the examination or flight review for a period of 24 hours after
the examination or review.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 94](#1517042-1527986){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1517042-1527986.html"}
:::

##### [Declaration --- Permitted Operations]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1527987 .Subheading}

- **[[901.95]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.95
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No pilot shall operate a remotely
  piloted aircraft system under this Division unless a declaration to
  the Minister has been made in accordance with section 901.194 in
  respect of that model of system and in respect of each of the
  technical requirements set out in Standard 922 that is applicable to
  the operation.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), a pilot may operate a
  remotely piloted aircraft system under this Division without a
  declaration having been made in respect of the technical requirements
  set out in section 922.10 of Standard 922 if a visual observer
  maintains unaided visual contact with the airspace in which the
  remotely piloted aircraft is operating in a manner sufficient to
  detect conflicting air traffic and other hazards and take action to
  avoid them and the operation is conducted in accordance with the
  Standard 923 --- Vision-Based Detect and Avoid.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 94](#1517042-1527997){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1517042-1527997.html"}
:::

##### [Operation of a Modified Remotely Piloted Aircraft System]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1527998 .Subheading}

- **[[901.96]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-901.96
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No pilot shall operate a remotely
  piloted aircraft system under this Division if the system has been
  modified in any way unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the pilot is able to demonstrate to the Minister
    that, despite the modification, the system continues to meet the
    technical requirements set out in Standard 922 that are applicable
    to the operation; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if applicable, the modification was performed in
    accordance with the instructions of the manufacturer of the part or
    equipment used to modify the system.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No pilot shall conduct an operation described in
  paragraph 901.87(b) using a remotely piloted aircraft system that has
  been modified in any way unless the modification was performed in
  accordance with the instructions of the person who has made a
  declaration referred to in section 901.194 in respect of that model of
  system.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2025-70, s. 94](#1517042-1528005){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1517042-1528005.html"}
:::

**\[901.110 to 901.132 reserved\]**
