- --- SOR/2025-70, s. 68

  - [68]{.lawlabel} The Regulations are amended by adding the following
    after section 901.38:

    :::: section
    ::: AmendedText
    ###### [Anti-collision Lights]{.HTitleText4} {#anti-collision-lights .SchedHeadL4}

    - - [901.38.1]{.lawlabel} [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection
        (3), no pilot shall operate a remotely piloted aircraft to
        conduct a BVLOS operation unless the aircraft is equipped with
        anti-collision lights and those lights are turned on.

      - [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1),
        anti-collision lights shall

        - [(a)]{.lawlabel} be white in colour;

        - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for operations at night, be visible using
          night-vision goggles;

        - [(c)]{.lawlabel} flash at a rate of not less than 40, and not
          more than 100, cycles per minute;

        - [(d)]{.lawlabel} be visible in all directions within 75
          degrees above and below the horizontal plane of the aircraft,
          with the exception of solid angles of obstructed visibility
          totalling not more than 0.5 steradians; and

        - [(e)]{.lawlabel} have an intensity such that they are visible
          in all directions from a distance of not less than one mile.

      - [(3)]{.lawlabel} Anti-collision lights may be turned off if the
        pilot determines that, because of operating conditions, doing so
        would be in the interests of aviation safety.
    :::
    ::::

        aircraft or medium remotely piloted aircraft for which the
        Minister determines that a special flight operations certificate
        --- RPAS is necessary to ensure aviation safety or the safety of
        any person.
      :::
      ::::

- --- SOR/2025-70, s. 97

  - [97]{.lawlabel} Sections 903.02 and 903.03 of the Regulations are
    replaced by the following:

    :::: section
    ::: AmendedText
    - - [903.02]{.lawlabel} [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of an
        application for a special flight operations certificate ---
        RPAS, the operation, other than for the purpose of providing a
        commercial air service, of a remotely piloted aircraft system
        that includes a remotely piloted aircraft that is not registered
        in accordance with Division III is a very low-complexity
        operation.

      - [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of an application for a
        special flight operations certificate --- RPAS, the operation of
        a remotely piloted aircraft system at an advertised event is a
        low-complexity operation.

      - [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of an application for a special
        flight operations certificate --- RPAS, the following operations
        are medium-complexity operations:

        - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the operation of a remotely piloted aircraft
          having an operating weight of more than 150 kg (331 pounds);

        - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the operation by a person described in
          subsection 900.09(2) of a remotely piloted aircraft system for
          the purpose of providing a commercial air service;

        - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the operation, for the purpose of providing a
          commercial air service, of a remotely piloted aircraft system
          that includes a remotely piloted aircraft that is not
          registered in accordance with Division III;

        - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the operation of a remotely piloted aircraft
          at an altitude greater than one of the altitudes referred to
          in subsection 901.25(1), unless the operation at a greater
          altitude is authorized under subsection 901.71(2);

        - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the operation of more than five remotely
          piloted aircraft at a time to conduct a VLOS operation, or the
          operation of more than one remotely piloted aircraft at a time
          to conduct an operation that is not a VLOS operation, from a
          single control station; and

        - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the operation of a remotely piloted aircraft
          outside of Canadian Domestic Airspace.

      - [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of an application for a special
        flight operations certificate --- RPAS, the following operations
        are high-complexity operations:

        - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the operation of a remotely piloted aircraft
          system without the pilot or a visual observer having the
          aircraft in visual line-of-sight if the operation is not a
          sheltered operation or an extended VLOS operation conducted
          under Division V or a BVLOS operation conducted under Division
          VI;

        - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the operation of a remotely piloted aircraft
          to transport any of the payloads referred to in subsection
          901.43(1);

        - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the operation of a remotely piloted aircraft
          to conduct a BVLOS operation within five nautical miles of an
          aerodrome that is listed in the Canada Flight Supplement or
          the Water Aerodrome Supplement;

        - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the operation, in weather conditions that do
          not meet the conditions set out in section 901.34, of a
          remotely piloted aircraft to conduct a BVLOS operation or of a
          medium remotely piloted aircraft to conduct a VLOS operation;

        - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the operation of a remotely piloted aircraft
          that carries persons on board; and

        - [(f)]{.lawlabel} any other operation of a remotely piloted
          aircraft system for which the Minister determines that a
          special flight operations certificate --- RPAS is necessary to
          ensure aviation safety or the safety of any person.

      - [(5)]{.lawlabel} If the application for a special flight
        operations certificate --- RPAS is in respect of several
        operations, the highest complexity level applies except in the
        case of an application in respect of two or more
        medium-complexity operations, in which case the application is
        deemed to be in respect of a high-complexity operation.

      - [(6)]{.lawlabel} A person who proposes to operate a remotely
        piloted aircraft system to conduct very low-complexity or
        low-complexity operations shall apply to the Minister for a
        special flight operations certificate --- RPAS by submitting the
        following information:

        - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the legal name, trade name, if any, address
          and contact information of the applicant;

        - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the means by which the person responsible for
          the operation can be contacted;

        - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the operations for which the application is
          made;

        - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturer and model of the system and
          the registration number, if any, referred to in paragraph
          900.16(3)(a);

        - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the pilot certificate number issued to any
          crew member; and

        - [(f)]{.lawlabel} any other information requested by the
          Minister pertinent to the safe conduct of the operations.

      - [(7)]{.lawlabel} A person who proposes to operate a remotely
        piloted aircraft system to conduct medium-complexity or
        high-complexity operations shall apply to the Minister for a
        special flight operations certificate --- RPAS by submitting the
        following information:

        - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the legal name, trade name, if any, address
          and contact information of the applicant;

        - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the means by which the person responsible for
          the operation can be contacted;

        - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the operations for which the application is
          made;

        - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturer and model of the system and
          the registration number, if any, referred to in paragraph
          900.16(3)(a), as well as a complete description of the
          remotely piloted aircraft that is an element of the system,
          including its performance, operating limitations and
          equipment;

        - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a detailed plan describing how the operations
          are to be carried out;

        - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a risk assessment for the operation that
          accounts for both ground and air risks;

        - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the pilot certificate number issued to any
          crew member or a description of the means by which the
          applicant will ensure that all crew members hold the necessary
          certificates and qualifications;

        - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the standard procedures for crew members in
          the case of operations requiring more than one crew member;

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the instructions for maintaining the system
          in a state that is fit and safe for flight;

        - [(j)]{.lawlabel} the type, manufacturer, model and operating
          limitations of the detect and avoid system to be used, if any,
          and the procedures respecting the detection and avoidance of
          conflicting air traffic and other hazards; and

        - [(k)]{.lawlabel} any other information requested by the
          Minister pertinent to the safe conduct of the operations.

    ###### [Application to Amend a Special Flight Operations Certificate --- RPAS]{.HTitleText4} {#application-to-amend-a-special-flight-operations-certificate-rpas .SchedHeadL4}

    - - [903.02.1]{.lawlabel} [(1)]{.lawlabel} The holder of a special
        flight operations certificate --- RPAS may apply to the Minister
        to amend the certificate to change

        - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the dates and alternate dates of the
          operations;

        - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the location of the operations;

        - [(c)]{.lawlabel} its validity period;

        - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the pilot certificate number issued to a crew
          member;

        - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the type, manufacturer, model and operating
          limitations of the detect and avoid system to be used and the
          procedures respecting the detection and avoidance of
          conflicting air traffic and other hazards; and

        - [(f)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a certificate in respect of an
          operation set out in subsections 903.02(1) or (2), the
          manufacturer and model of the remotely piloted aircraft system
          and the registration number referred to in paragraph
          900.16(3)(a).

      - [(2)]{.lawlabel} An application to amend a special flight
        operations certificate --- RPAS shall include the following
        information:

        - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the number of the certificate;

        - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the validity period of the certificate; and

        - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the change that is the subject of the
          application.

    ###### [Issuance or Amendment of Special Flight Operations Certificate --- RPAS]{.HTitleText4} {#issuance-or-amendment-of-special-flight-operations-certificate-rpas .SchedHeadL4}

    - [903.03]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall, on receipt of an
      application submitted in accordance with section 903.02 or
      903.02.1, issue or amend a special flight operations certificate
      --- RPAS if the applicant demonstrates to the Minister the ability
      to perform the proposed operations without adversely affecting
      aviation safety or the safety of any person.

    ###### [Contents of Special Flight Operations Certificate --- RPAS]{.HTitleText4} {#contents-of-special-flight-operations-certificate-rpas .SchedHeadL4}

    - [903.04]{.lawlabel} A special flight operations certificate ---
      RPAS shall contain the following information:

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of the certificate holder;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the number of the certificate;

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the date of issue of the certificate;

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the validity period of the certificate;

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the type of operations authorized; and

      - [(f)]{.lawlabel} any condition pertaining to the operations that
        the Minister considers necessary for aviation safety or the
        safety of any person.
